programme.title: Granddad's Fight - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Grandad and Colonel Stinkmeaner have a beef. One man's blind. One man's feeble. Both are really, really old. Let "The Slugfest In Woodcrest" commence!

programme.title: A Date With the Health Inspector - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — District Attorney and law-abiding citizen Tom Dubois fits the description of the elusive "X-Box Killer" and is arrested. Huey has to find the real killer before Tom is shipped off to "real" prison where he will most assuredly become "someone's girlfriend."

programme.title: The Story of Gangstalicious - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Riley's favorite rapper, Gangstalicious, is shot and hospitalized in Woodcrest. When Riley goes to visit the rapper, he finds more than he anticipated ... like maybe rappers that make songs like "Thuggin' Luv" aren't necessarily as tough as they seem. Go figure.

programme.title: A Huey Freeman Christmas - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — A well meaning teacher offers Huey the chance to direct the school Christmas play, and Huey decides to release his vision to the world: "The Adventures of Black Jesus."

programme.title: The Real - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — While Riley is busy convincing two reality shows that Granddad's blind and running a homeless shelter, Huey is being shadowed by a secret government agent. But is he real?

programme.title: Return of the King - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When Martin Luther King Jr. comes out of a coma after 32 years and finds himself thrust into the 21st and life in the post "September 11th" lunacy, his "turn the other cheek" philosophy quickly takes him from beloved national hero to dispised terrorist sympathizer.

programme.title: The Itis - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Grandad opens "The Itis", the only soul food restaurant in Woodcrest. White people didn't expect it. They also didn't expect high cholesterol, heart disease, and obesity.

programme.title: Let's Nab Oprah - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Huey has to stop Riley and a small gang of misfit idiots from nabbing the talk show deity, Oprah.

programme.title: Riley Wuz Here - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When Riley's affinity for grafitti goes too far, Grandad sends him to an art teacher that actually encourages him to do grafitti, only painting murals instead. Meanwhile, Huey discovers a black woman died from watching too much black TV, and decides to watch black TV for 2 weeks to see if that was the cause.

programme.title: Wingmen - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When Grandad's oldest friend, and possibly his worst friend, Moe, dies, the Freemans go back home and Grandad wants the possession Moe left him. Meanwhile, Huey is eager to see his friend again but both Grandad and Huey both discover to put the past behind them and focus on the future.

programme.title: The Block is Hot - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Its February, and its record temperatures of 90 degrees. Luckily, Jazmine has her lemonade stand open, and does pretty well. Her success catches the eye of corporate tycoon Ed Wuncler. Despite several warnings from Huey, Jazmine then learns the true meaning of "capitalism" when Wuncler decides to buy the stand.

programme.title: The Passion of Reverend Ruckus - S01E15
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — While Ruckus spreads the word of White Jesus to get into White Heaven, Huey desperately tries to save his friend from death row.

programme.title: ... Or Die Trying - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Granddad, Huey, Riley and Jazmine must avoid guards after they sneak in to a theatre to watch Soul Plane 2: The Blackjacking.

programme.title: Tom, Sarah, and Usher - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — While on a date with Tom Dubois, Sarah Dubois meets the singing sensation, Usher. Sarah starts being obsessed with Usher, and Tom begins to think Sarah is cheating on him. Sarah kicks Tom out of the house and Tom moves in with the Freemans. A pimp Named Slick Back returns in this episode to try to help Tom get Sarah back.

programme.title: Thank You for Not Snitching - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Two men are invading homes, and Riley and Granddad are refusing to speak to the police. It gets worse when Granddad's car, Dorothy, gets stolen by the robbers. If Riley and Granddad still refuse, worse things may be in store.

programme.title: Stinkmeaner Strikes Back - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Huey has a dream of Stinkmeaner and Granddad says that he was a menace and he sent him to hell like he deserves. Stinkmeaner's spirit later inhabits Tom Dubois' body and goes looking for revenge against Granddad. Huey must stop him from killing Granddad.

programme.title: The Story of Thugnificent - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — The infamous rapper Thugnificent moves to the neighbourhood with his friends Macktastic and Flonominal, eventually leading to Granddad becoming annoyed with his new neighbours. Their feud inspires Thugnificent to create a diss-track called "Eff Granddad".

programme.title: Attack of the Killer Kung-Fu Wolf Bitch - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — After many failed attempts at online dating, Granddad finally meets a beautiful woman named Luna… who just happens to be a psycho.

programme.title: Shinin' - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Riley joins Thugnificent's Lethal Injection crew. Meanwhile, a local bully steals Riley's prized chain.

programme.title: Ballin' - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Riley learns a lesson in good sportsmanship after he joins a basketball team.

programme.title: Invasion of the Katrinians - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Jericho Freeman, Granddad's cousin, and his family, who were displaced by Hurricane Katrina, arrive at the Freeman's home looking for a place to stay. Granddad reluctantly allows the family to stay, but is soon trying to get rid of them.

programme.title: Home Alone - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Granddad takes a vacation, leaving the boys alone, but just who is in charge?

programme.title: The S Word - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — A teacher calls Riley a "nigga" in class, causing Robert to decide that he wants to sue for restitution.

programme.title: The Story of Catcher Freeman - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Huey and Riley listen to different perspectives on the story of their ancestor Catcher Freeman.

programme.title: The Story of Gangstalicious Part 2 - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Granddad worries about Riley's sexuality when he notices that he begins to dress and act like "in-the-closet" rapper, Gangstalicious.

programme.title: The Hunger Strike - S02E14
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Huey goes on a hunger strike in a boycott of BET, and receives some high-profile support.

programme.title: The Uncle Ruckus Reality Show - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Uncle Ruckus is given his own reality show by BET.

programme.title: It's a Black President, Huey Freeman - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — The Freemans are filmed for a German documentary about the 2008 election of Barack Obama.

programme.title: Bitches to Rags - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When his new album tanks, Thugnificent is faced with the horror of getting a real job.

programme.title: The Red Ball - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Kickball legend Huey Freeman returns after a self-imposed exile from the game.

programme.title: The Story of Jimmy Rebel - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Ruckus finds his musical soul mate in famed racist Country-Western singer Jimmy Rebel. But can the ebony and ivory of racist music really live together in perfect harmony?

programme.title: Stinkmeaner 3: The Hateocracy - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — The Freemans are in trouble when Stinkmeaner's gang decide to come after them in retaliation for his death.

programme.title: Smokin With Cigarettes - S03E06
programme.desc:
Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When Riley befriends juvenile felon Lamilton Taeshawn, he is having the best time of his life as they go around, causing trouble. Things take a turn for the worst when Lamilton wants to cause more than just trouble when he shows Riley a real handgun...
A parody of the now infamous web video where the little boy steals his grandma's Durango and goes joy riding after she refuses to buy him chicken wings at the grocery store.

programme.title: The Fundraiser - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Riley organizes a fundraiser with Cindy McPhearson and other kids from Woodcrest.

programme.title: Pause - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Granddad is cast as the leading man by mega-superstar of stage and screen, Winston Jerome. But when the theater group turns out to be a homoerotic evangelical cult, it's up to Huey and Riley to put a pause to it.

programme.title: A Date With the Booty Warrior - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Having conquered his fear of prison rape, Tom volunteers to lead Huey, Riley, and some classmates on a trip to jail as part of a Scared Stiff program. But when a riot breaks out, Tom has to get the kids, and his delicate backside, out of jail in one piece.

programme.title: The Story of Lando Freeman - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — There's a new handyman in the neighborhood undercutting Uncle Ruckus... which is all good for Granddad and his garden until the man claims to be his long lost son, Lando. Will Granddad take responsibility and be a father to his child? Not without a talk show paternity test.

programme.title: Lovely Ebony Brown - S03E11
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Grandad meets a young black woman who asks him out on a date, and the only person who can spoil Grandad's new romance, is Grandad.

programme.title: Mr. Medicinal - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — After a checkup, a doctor warns Granddad that he could die any day if he doesn't get his stress levels down. Not wanting to become dependent on pills, he decides to take Thugnificent's suggestion and turns to marijuana.

programme.title: The Fried Chicken Flu - S03E13
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When a chicken franchise run out of its newest recipe introduction, things go from bad to worse when a viral outbreak is linked to the same chicken. Thankfully, Huey has prepared a survival outline in just such an emergency, but it's all threatened when no one can seem to stick to the simple plan.

programme.title: The Color Ruckus - S03E14
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — On a final visit to Woodcrest, Ruckus's terminally ill Nana wants to die in Robert Freeman's house.

programme.title: It's Goin Down - S03E15
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — A terror attack near Woodcrest is imminent, and retired domestic terrorist Huey Freeman is the main suspect. With super-agent Jack Flowers on his tail and Ed and Rummy on the loose, can anyone save the day?

programme.title: Pretty Boy Flizzy - S04E01
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Pretty Boy Flizzy is arrested for armed robbery while in town, and Tom agrees to be his lawyer.

programme.title: Good Times - S04E02
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Ed Wuncler has unique ideas about how Granddad can repay the millions he owes on his house.

programme.title: Breaking Granddad - S04E03
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — The Freemans sell an explosive hair product and contend with the black market.

programme.title: Early Bird Special - S04E04
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Granddad is hired by pimps to escort lonely women at a nursing home.

programme.title: Freedom Ride or Die - S04E05
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — A young Granddad is held as an unwilling freedom rider on a trip through the racist South.

programme.title: Granddad Dates a Kardashian - S04E06
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Granddad begins dating a long-lost Kardashian sister and winds up on a reality show.

programme.title: Freedomland - S04E07
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — The Freemans get trapped in a slavery-amusement park.

programme.title: I Dream of Siri - S04E08
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Grandpa's personal assistant program on his phone becomes obsessed with him.

programme.title: Stinkmeaner: Begun the Clone War Has - S04E09
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Stinkmeaner becomes a celebrity after a video of his fight with Granddad goes viral.

programme.title: The New Black - S04E10
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Riley is targeted after using offensive language.

programme.title: The Garden Party - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When the owner of Granddad's house invites Granddad and the kids to his garden party, Huey tries to start trouble by saying Jesus was black and comparing Ronald Regan to the devil. Meanwhile, Riley and the owner's grandson (a soldier back from Iraq) play with guns and Granddad runs into the self-loathing black butler Uncle Rukus.

programme.title: The Trial of Robert Kelly - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When the trial of R&B star R. Kelly comes to town and Tom Dubois is the ADA, Huey and Riley are on opposing sides of the hot-button "underage peeing" issue. Meanwhile, Granddad and Uncle Ruckus argue about white people during a game of checkers.

programme.title: Guess Hoe's Coming to Dinner - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Huey and Riley try to convince Grandad that his new girlfriend Cristal (like the champagne) is actually a prostitute. Of course, Grandad doesn't believe them, even when she spends all his money. But when A Pimp Named Slickback shows up, the truth is revealed.

programme.title: Granddad's Fight - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Grandad and Colonel Stinkmeaner have a beef. One man's blind. One man's feeble. Both are really, really old. Let "The Slugfest In Woodcrest" commence!

programme.title: A Date With the Health Inspector - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — District Attorney and law-abiding citizen Tom Dubois fits the description of the elusive "X-Box Killer" and is arrested. Huey has to find the real killer before Tom is shipped off to "real" prison where he will most assuredly become "someone's girlfriend."

programme.title: The Story of Gangstalicious - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Riley's favorite rapper, Gangstalicious, is shot and hospitalized in Woodcrest. When Riley goes to visit the rapper, he finds more than he anticipated ... like maybe rappers that make songs like "Thuggin' Luv" aren't necessarily as tough as they seem. Go figure.

programme.title: A Huey Freeman Christmas - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — A well meaning teacher offers Huey the chance to direct the school Christmas play, and Huey decides to release his vision to the world: "The Adventures of Black Jesus."

programme.title: The Real - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — While Riley is busy convincing two reality shows that Granddad's blind and running a homeless shelter, Huey is being shadowed by a secret government agent. But is he real?

programme.title: Return of the King - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When Martin Luther King Jr. comes out of a coma after 32 years and finds himself thrust into the 21st and life in the post "September 11th" lunacy, his "turn the other cheek" philosophy quickly takes him from beloved national hero to dispised terrorist sympathizer.

programme.title: The Itis - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Grandad opens "The Itis", the only soul food restaurant in Woodcrest. White people didn't expect it. They also didn't expect high cholesterol, heart disease, and obesity.

programme.title: Let's Nab Oprah - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Huey has to stop Riley and a small gang of misfit idiots from nabbing the talk show deity, Oprah.

programme.title: Riley Wuz Here - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When Riley's affinity for grafitti goes too far, Grandad sends him to an art teacher that actually encourages him to do grafitti, only painting murals instead. Meanwhile, Huey discovers a black woman died from watching too much black TV, and decides to watch black TV for 2 weeks to see if that was the cause.

programme.title: Wingmen - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — When Grandad's oldest friend, and possibly his worst friend, Moe, dies, the Freemans go back home and Grandad wants the possession Moe left him. Meanwhile, Huey is eager to see his friend again but both Grandad and Huey both discover to put the past behind them and focus on the future.

programme.title: The Block is Hot - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Its February, and its record temperatures of 90 degrees. Luckily, Jazmine has her lemonade stand open, and does pretty well. Her success catches the eye of corporate tycoon Ed Wuncler. Despite several warnings from Huey, Jazmine then learns the true meaning of "capitalism" when Wuncler decides to buy the stand.

programme.title: The Passion of Reverend Ruckus - S01E15
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — While Ruckus spreads the word of White Jesus to get into White Heaven, Huey desperately tries to save his friend from death row.

programme.title: ... Or Die Trying - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — Granddad, Huey, Riley and Jazmine must avoid guards after they sneak in to a theatre to watch Soul Plane 2: The Blackjacking.

programme.title: Tom, Sarah, and Usher - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 2005 · TV-MA — While on a date with Tom Dubois, Sarah Dubois meets the singing sensation, Usher. Sarah starts being obsessed with Usher, and Tom begins to think Sarah is cheating on him. Sarah kicks Tom out of the house and Tom moves in with the Freemans. A pimp Named Slick Back returns in this episode to try to help Tom get Sarah back.

programme.title: Forget the Herring - S03E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Rose Hiney connects with Jonathan on new leads. George and Ray attempt to right their unrightable wrongs.

programme.title: Nothing I Can't Handle by Running Away - S03E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — In the series finale, George celebrates Emily and Bernard’s wedding; and Ray is comforted by his son, Spencer. Meanwhile, Jonathan considers breaking up with his new girlfriend, but when he’s kidnapped, an army of Super Ray fans spring into action.

programme.title: Stockholm Syndrome - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Broken up after his breakup with his girlfriend Suzanne, Jonathan Ames reads through Farewell My Lovely, his favorite book by Raymond Chandler. Enlivened by the novel, Ames places an online advertisement as an unlicensed private investigator. His first unwitting client who seeks his services is a 19-year-old girl looking for her missing sister.

programme.title: The Alanon Case - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — As Jonathan tries to mend his relationship with Suzanne, another case falls onto his lap. This time, he is tasked by a woman named Jennifer to gather proof of her boyfriend Gary's infidelity. Jonathan, who learns his new client loves to drink as much as he does, tracks down Gary and stumbles upon an unsatisfying outcome.

programme.title: The Case of the Missing Screenplay - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — While attending a New York film society function, George introduces Jonathan to a filmmaker, who asks him to rewrite a screenplay. Later, he goes out with a party girl and leaves the script at her home, which happens to be a shrink's office. Jonathan asks Ray to pose as a patient to recover the script. Meanwhile, George encounters his ex-wife and her smug new husband.

programme.title: The Case of the Stolen Skateboard - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Jonathan is hired to reclaim a kid's stolen skateboard from the neighborhood bully while Ray helps out a lesbian couple who wants to start a new family. George tries to woo a young publicist at the opening of a new restaurant in Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Case of the Lonely White Dove - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — A recently-paroled Russian enlists the services of Jonathan to search for the object of his infatuation, a songstress known only as "The Lonely White Dove." He checks out the bar where she sings and convinces Suzanne, Ray, and Leah to have dinner there the following night without revealing his primary intention. George gets in touch with his feminine side to boost his magazines' dipping sales.

programme.title: The Case of the Beautiful Blackmailer - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Jonathan is enlisted to retrieve a sex tape that a female escort is using to extort money from a married New Jersey man. With Ray and George in tow, Jonathan ends up in a motel room with the escort, who attempts to blackmail him as well. Can the very stoned Ray and George save Jonathan's neck before the woman's enraged brother breaks it?

programme.title: The Case of the Stolen Sperm - S01E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Concerned over the sudden disappearance of the two lesbians who have been buying his sperm, Ray enlists Jonathan to help him track the couple down. After breaking into their apartment, Jonathan learns the pair has flown the coop--but not without leaving behind a clue that both shocks and intrigues Ray. Meanwhile, George ignores Jonathan's warnings by publishing a disparaging editorial about Richard Antrem (Oliver Platt), sending his publishing rival into a fit of rage at the local watering hole.

programme.title: Take a Dive - S01E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Having picked up the gauntlet thrown down by Richard – and having thwarted a blackmail bid aimed at getting Jonathan to take a dive – the Edition team gear up for a tripleheader boxing challenge against their GQ rivals. But with the bouts only hours away, the women in their lives offer some compelling reasons why winning isn’t everything.

programme.title: Escape from the Dungeon! - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Jonathan is hired by a police officer to erase the hard drive of an S&M club computer to prevent potentially embarrassing information from coming out as the officer has received word that the club is about to be raided. Leah breaks it off with Ray. George is asked to cut back on expensive meals to prevent the Magazine from going under.

programme.title: Make it Quick, Fitzgerald! - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Jonathan is hired by Richard Antrem, George's nemesis and boxing foe, to investigate Richard's suspicions that his wife Priscilla, George's ex, is having an affair. Jonathan's insecurities resurface when Stella announces she's not over her first love. George has a new female urologist; Ray plots to win back Leah by penning a comic book.

programme.title: The Gowanus Canal Has Gonorrhea! - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — George worries about remaining “intact” after getting some sobering news from his new urologist, Dr. Kenwood. A bad day for Jonathan gets worse when a pair of S&M henchmen kidnap him. They demand a ransom which calls “GI” George & Ray to action.

programme.title: I've Been Living Like a Demented God! - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — A professor hires Jonathan to track down a valuable item. George finds an alibi to explain the results of his drug test. Flushed with cash from his “Super Ray” comic book, Ray heads to the bar – and meets a familiar barfly.

programme.title: Forty-Two Down! - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Jonathan attempts to repair the relationship between a poet/limousine driver and his wife. Ray has a meeting with Kevin Bacon.

programme.title: The Case of the Grievous Clerical Error! - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Leah hires Jonathan to help find her new dog, “Little Ray.” Ray joins Jonathan in the search for the dog, getting some inside help. A reflective George heads to the hospital for surgery.

programme.title: Escape from the Castle! - S02E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — A dermatologist enlists Jonathan to deliver a letter to his intended at an Asian health spa. Jonathan takes Ray to the spa for his birthday, with George and his new chauffeur Vikram in tow.

programme.title: Super Ray is Mortal! - S02E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — A mad stalker imperils Ray on the eve of the Brooklyn Comic Con. With the help of Officer Drake, he and Jonathan piece together leads to track down the perp. George decides to make a stand at work. Jonathan has another battle with his nemesis, Louis Greene.

programme.title: The Blonde in the Woods - S03E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — After celebrating the release of his new book, Jonathan learns some distressing familial news. George reunites with his daughter Emily and Ray spends time with his biological son Spencer. Meanwhile, Jonathan's latest case leaves him in a precarious position.

programme.title: Gumball! - S03E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — On the run from the police, Jonathan and Ray turn to Howard (Patton Oswalt) for help with trying to find out who framed Jonathan for murder, while George runs interference for them in his own inimitable, marijuana-induced way.

programme.title: The Black Clock of Time - S03E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Already nervous about his appearance on "The New Dick Cavett Show," Jonathan is thrown for a loop when another scheduled guest happens to be his nemesis, Louis Greene (John Hodgman). Meanwhile, Ray's attentiveness as a father is tested; and George is floored by Emily and Bernard's latest news.

programme.title: We Could Sing a Duet - S03E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — George urges Jonathan to show Emily what it's like to be out with a younger man, but they wind up on a stakeout with a wannabe gumshoe (Brett Gelman) impersonating Jonathan. Meanwhile, George goes out on the town with Bernard, but is shocked to learn that Richard Antrem (Oliver Platt) is a competing restaurateur; and Ray is drawn to an older woman (Olympia Dukakis) after a fight with Leah.

programme.title: I Keep Taking Baths Like Lady Macbeth - S03E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Jonathan and George see a "friendship" counselor (Sarah Silverman). George begins taking singing lessons from Josephine (Mary Steenburgen), a delightful pothead. Jonathan attempts to win back George's affection. Ray becomes irresistible to women.

programme.title: Two Large Pearls and a Bar of Gold - S03E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Jonathan's college sweetheart hires him to guard her wedding jewels and remind her of their prenuptial pact.

programme.title: Forget the Herring - S03E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — Rose Hiney connects with Jonathan on new leads. George and Ray attempt to right their unrightable wrongs.

programme.desc: Comedy · 2009 · TV-MA — In the series finale, George celebrates Emily and Bernard’s wedding; and Ray is comforted by his son, Spencer. Meanwhile, Jonathan considers breaking up with his new girlfriend, but when he’s kidnapped, an army of Super Ray fans spring into action.

programme.title: The Four Last Things - S03E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — A suspected killer whom Bosch has pursued for several years turns up dead in an apparent suicide. Edgar discovers that Harry has a complicated history with the dead man. When the case is later ruled a homicide, Detective Jimmy Robertson develops troubling theories about the culprit.

programme.title: God Sees - S03E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Bosch learns more about the dark past and murder of Billy Meadows. The credibility of a key witness threatens to undermine the Holland case. Edgar manoeuvres to handle damning evidence. Dangerous men target Bosch.

programme.title: El Compadre - S03E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Bosch clashes with his fellow detectives. Irving weighs his career options just as his personal life takes a turn. The killers behind the Meadows murder clean up loose ends. Questions swirl about whether Bosch is an avenging angel.

programme.title: Blood Under the Bridge - S03E05
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — The secret effort to smear Bosch intensifies. Harry and his colleagues struggle to uncover who's trying to frame him. Irving closes a chapter in his personal life, but is ensnared in departmental politics. Bosch digs into the history of former soldiers under suspicion. Killers pull off a major score.

programme.title: Birdland - S03E06
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — News explodes that the LAPD is investigating one of its own in a murder case. Bosch homes in on the motive behind a string of homicides. Robertson's doubts about Bosch deepen. Edgar discovers another disturbing link between Harry and a murder victim. Irving assists the investigation of the "Koreatown Killer."

programme.title: Right Play - S03E07
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Bosch and Robertson work a promising lead in the Gunn case. Further evidence gets the team closer to solving the Meadows murder. Irving does damage control on another crisis related to Bosch. Edgar takes action. The Holland case is on the brink.

programme.title: Aye Papi - S03E08
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Bosch operates behind-the-scenes to expose wrongdoers. Killers are in the wind. Edgar deals with the fallout of a crucial choice.

programme.title: Clear Shot - S03E09
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — The department rallies when a threat hits close to home. There's a pivotal turn in the Holland case. Bosch is forced to face a dark truth. Irving embraces a lifelong goal. There's no honor among thieves.

programme.title: The Sea King - S03E10
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — In this final of the third season: Bosch's relentless pursuit in the Meadows case reaches a climax. Bosch and Edgar talk about a startling discovery. An unexpected visitor drops in on Bosch and Maddie. Harry learns that his history is far from settled.

programme.title: Ask the Dust - S04E01
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Three months after discovering a startling new lead, Det. Harry Bosch is still pursuing the truth behind his mother's cold case. A murder of a high-profile attorney puts the city on edge so Chief Irvin Irving creates a Task Force with Bosch in charge. Bosch must contend with two former adversaries.

programme.title: Dreams of Bunker Hill - S04E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Bosch pulls out all the stops to try and get to the bottom of the Elias murder as quickly as possible while keeping the IA investigators on his Task Force in the dark. Eleanor Wish is back in the game with the Feds, and Det. Jerry Edgar preps for his first day back on the job.

programme.title: Devil in the House - S04E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — As the Task Force tries to clear the growing number of suspects, they discover a potentially explosive false alibi. Det. Santiago Robertson must put his personal relationships aside for the sake of the case. Edgar struggles rebalancing work and family. Bosch has an unlikely late night visitor.

programme.title: Past Lives - S04E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Det. Francis Sheehan comes clean to Bosch, Robertson suspects a leak in the investigation, and Edgar joins the Task Force. Social unrest surrounding the Elias murder grows and Irving is pressured to intervene. Eleanor asks Bosch for parenting advice and confesses the truth about her marriage to Reggie Woo.

programme.title: The Coping - S04E05
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — Bosch struggles to manage all the things he's lost and to keep the darkness at bay, from himself, and from Maddie. The Task Force bears down on two suspects. Acting Captain Grace Billets gets tangled in station politics and petty opposition, no longer everyone's best friend.

programme.title: The Wine of Youth - S04E06
programme.desc: Crime · 2015 · TV-MA — The search for Sheehan intensifies, as pressure mounts to solve the Elias murder. The Task Force waits for ballistics to confirm their suspicions. programme.title: Creep Signed His Kill - S05E10

programme.title: Musical Nightmares - S07E14
programme.desc: Reality · 2014 · TV-14 — A rock-n-roller with a droopy eye wants to get back on stage, while a 21-year-old ravaged by a predatory doctor looks for a second chance at a mommy makeover, and a transgender woman inspires a doctor dance party and sings about her boobie greed.

programme.title: I Dream of Implants - S07E15
programme.desc: Reality · 2014 · TV-14 — The Human Doll, aka Justin Jedlica, drops by to update the doctors on his 8 new leg implants, while a woman who always aspired to be a telenovela actress needs a miracle after destroying her nose because of vanity, and a mother who lost 200 pounds still hates her body after getting triple T's, "Terrible Tijuana Titties."

programme.title: The Comeback Patients - S07E16
programme.desc: Reality · 2014 · TV-14 — A fellow doctor was duped into getting silicone injections in her face and her complications are staggering, while a woman who almost died from her tummy tuck seeks to erase the scars from her past, and a former patient surprises the doctors with her shocking transformation.

programme.title: My Baby Valentine - S06E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory becomes upset when Topanga seems less interested in spending Valentine's Day with him than with consoling Amy about the last stages of her pregnancy, so when Topanga decides to cheer Amy up with a baby shower, Cory takes charge. Unfortunately his concept of a baby shower turns out to be a female version of a bachelor party, complete with a pizza-guy stripper, but the disgusted guests are distracted when Amy's waters break and she is rushed to hospital for a premature delivery -- one which the new Matthews baby may not survive. Meanwhile, Shawn is still on the road to nowhere; Morgan is less than happy about the arrival of a new sibling; and Jack and Rachel worry about the effect of revealing their new relationship to Eric -- who announces he already knows, and is moving out.

programme.title: Resurrection - S06E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — While everyone anxiously awaits news about newly born Joshua Matthews, Cory's continued self-absorption alienates Topanga, who now considers herself a member of the Matthews family. Even Eric's little friend Tommy views Joshua as his new "brother." It's only when Shawn returns and is accepted by the elder Matthews as "family" does Cory realize where his true values lie. (And, of course, the baby turns out to be fine, though the anxiety of the other parents of premature infants is not minimized.)

programme.title: Can I Help to Cheer You? - S06E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Topanga is in wedding plan mode, and persuades (strongarms) Cory into accompanying her, Shawn and Angela to a posh ceremony in the hall of her dreams -- where an unhappy father of the bride offers Cory a million dollars to marry his daughter. Meanwhile, Tommy pleads with a heartbroken Eric to adopt him so he won't have to move to California, and Eric pretends to no longer want Tommy so he can be happy with his new family.

programme.title: Bee True - S06E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — The series returns to form as Cory and Shawn unite for the last time as a "bad boy" team to help Mr. Feeny, whose hesitation in declaring his feelings for Dean Bolander looks like a fatal mistake when her ex-husband Curtis returns from an expedition bent on winning her back. Shawn and Cory trash the interloper's lab and blame in on a jealous rage by Feeny -- who then saves Dean Bolander's life for real by swatting the rare bee brought back by Curtis just before it stings his highly allergic love. She explains that she was not taken in for a moment by the boys' ruse -- just impressed that Feeny's students care about him so much. Meanwhile, Rachel challenges Jack to take her out on a real date.

programme.title: The Truth About Honesty - S06E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — When Cory and Topanga make an agreement to tell the truth about everything and everyone, their totally honest pact creates tension at Rachel and Jack's first dinner party. When the party guests play a game that forces them to also tell the truth, personal feelings are revealed that they would rather keep to themselves.

programme.title: The Psychotic Episode - S06E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — When Cory has nightmares where the recurring theme finds him trying to kill Shawn in imaginative ways, he goes to Feeny for an interpretation. Meanwhile, Eric finds a new, but odd, roommate -- one who seems to have seen Hitchcock's "Psycho" once too often.

programme.title: State of the Unions - S06E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — While Cory deals with his anxieties about his impending marriage, Topanga's parents (real-life couple Annette O'Toole and Michael McKean) come for a visit and reveal some unexpected news: they are on the brink of separating. Meanwhile, Feeny pops the question to Dean Bolander (real-life husband and wife William Daniels and Bonnie Bartlett), and they agree to get married in the Matthews living-room; and a self-pitying Eric asks Shawn for advice on how to cope with losing Rachel to Jack.

programme.title: Show Me the Love - S07E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Conclusion of last season's cliffhanger. Distraught to learn that her parents are getting divorced, Topanga tells Cory she wants to call off their wedding, so he and Shawn travel to Pittsburgh in an attempt to persuade her parents to get back together-only to learn that Jedediah has left Rhiannon for another woman. Eric gets a new haircut.

programme.title: For Love and Apartments - S07E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Since both couples-Cory and Topanga, Shawn and Angela-have split up, the girls decide to challenge the boys to a wresting match which will decide who gets to keep the apartment. Pro wrestler Mankind refs the match, which the girls win handily-and Eric vows revenge on Topanga for beating him up so easily.

programme.title: Angela's Men - S07E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Angela, who has been mysteriously reluctant to get back together with Shawn, deals with her reasons after a surprise visit from her military father. Shawn tries to impress Angela by going through basic training, but she is unmoved until Sgt. Moore reveals the reason for her pessimism: he was deserted by Angela's mother, and she fears she will do the same to Shawn. Meanwhile, Cory persists in getting Topanga to renew their engagement.

programme.title: No Such Thing as a Sure Thing - S07E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — On the eve of the big game, Eric gets Jack in over his head with a bookie, while Topanga decides to put her money on Cory.

programme.title: You Light Up My Union - S07E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Jack and Eric learn the art of dealing with each other when they take over as managers of the student union. Meanwhile, Rachel reads the guys the riot act after Cory and Shawn pry into her diary.

programme.title: They're Killing Us - S07E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Topanga and Cory hash out their wedding woes, which include his selection for best man and her dress-hating bridesmaids. Meanwhile, Alan and Amy try to cut costs by hiring Feeny as the big day's musical attraction.

programme.title: It's About Time - S07E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory and Topanga's big day hits a major hitch after Eric alters their wedding locale and Shawn quits as best man.

programme.title: The Honeymooners - S07E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Eric follows Cory and Topanga to their tropical honeymoon, a destination where the newlyweds consider relocating, permanently. But as the days go by, each of the trio discovers the true meaning of family and friends and the comforts of home.

programme.title: The Honeymoon Is Over - S07E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — The honeymoon is over for Cory and Topanga: the newlyweds realize they have no home to call their own, after Shawn moves into the girls' apartment and the Matthews refuse to take them in.

programme.title: Picket Fences - S07E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory and Topanga realize that a house is not for them after Shawn sells them on working together to fix up their apartment. Meanwhile, Angela and Rachel play the roommate shuffle once again; and Jack and Eric get a new boss at the student union.

programme.title: What a Drag! - S07E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Jack and Eric find life a drag when they pose as women-ugly women-to escape the clutches of a campus goon. Meanwhile, Topanga can't paint over her horror when Cory redecorates the apartment.

programme.title: Family Trees - S07E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Shawn struggles to accept the fact that he has no idea who his parents are. Meanwhile, Eric puts together a surprise party for his dad, who has an even bigger surprise for the despondent Shawn.

programme.title: The Provider - S07E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory and Topanga's love nest turns into a battle zone after she lands a better job than his at-home telemarketing gig. Meanwhile, Eric gets his money's worth out of a lucky penny, until he passes it on to his brother.

programme.title: I'm Gonna Be Like You, Dad - S07E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Topanga develops an acute case of Cory-itis after he overreacts to his low score in a magazine's health quiz (which indicates he should already be dead). Meanwhile, Eric joins the family business and shocks his father by doing well at it-while Amy, in turn, is shocked at Alan's lack of faith in his son.

programme.title: The War (1) - S07E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — A fierce war of pranks ensues after Cory and Shawn diss Rachel (Shawn parks in her parking spot). Cory, Shawn and Topanga takes on Rachel, Angela and Jack, with Eric acting as a neutral spy in both camps.

programme.title: Seven the Hard Way (2) - S07E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — After a war of harmless pranks goes too far and threatens to break up the old gang, Feeney steps in to help mend fences. But he finds that even his intervention may not be enough to reunite the once-tight teens. We they see into the future, a few years later, to see what everyone will be like if they go their separate ways.

programme.title: She's Having My Baby Back Ribs - S07E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — When Topanga diets to stem a slight weight gain, Cory panics that her new size may be due to a different type of baby fat. Meanwhile, Eric has a hard time watching his own weight.

programme.title: How Cory and Topanga Got Their Groove Back - S07E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory and Topanga try to shed their humdrum personas by hosting a bash on the same night as the school's biggest party of the year. Meanwhile, Jack concocts a get-rich-quick scheme after a bump on the head bestows Eric with telepathic powers.

programme.title: Brotherly Shove - S07E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Family ties threaten to choke Eric and Cory when they argue over what to sell-and what to save-at a Matthews garage sale. Meanwhile, Jack and Shawn try to become more brotherly, but can't find anything in common to bond over.

programme.title: As Time Goes By - S07E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — A stressed-out Topanga is sucked back in time into a black and white 1940s world where she cannot remember her past. She hopes the suave owner of the Shangri-La cafe and its eccentric patrons (portrayed by the show's cast) can provide clues to her identity.

programme.title: Angela's Ashes - S07E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — When Angela's father says he wants to take her to Europe for a year, Cory thinks Shawn isn't being honest with himself if he lets the girl that he loves go away. Meanwhile, graduating seniors Eric, Jack and Rachel figure out their plans after college.

programme.title: Brave New World (1) - S07E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — In the clip-filled finale, Cory wrestles with his fear of moving to New York for Topanga's internship, triggering-in flashbacks-a host of memories. When he finally opts to take Manhattan, it turns out that Shawn, Jack and Eric have all made big moving plans of their own.

programme.title: Brave New World (2) - S07E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — In the clip-filled finale, Cory wrestles with his fear of moving to New York for Topanga's internship, triggering-in flashbacks-a host of memories. When he finally opts to take Manhattan, it turns out that Shawn, Jack and Eric have all made big moving plans of their own. But before anyone leaves town, the crew makes one last stop: Mr. Feeny's classroom. There, they bid an emotional farewell to their mentor, who offers them one last bit of advice before they go out and meet the world. They tell Mr. Feeny they love him and they will miss him dearly. Mr. Feeny replies and "I love you" but they have already gone.

programme.title: Pilot - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory Matthews winds up with detention after trying to listen to a Phillies game in class, while his teacher, Mr. Feeny, is trying to teach the class the great value that love has in all of their lives. However, Cory doesn't find love and girls such a good thing when his older brother, Eric, takes a girl to a Phillies game instead of him. This prompts Cory to move into his treehouse.

programme.title: On the Fence - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory is worried about the class water gun war, as he has no heavy-duty water gun to compete with. However, he soon strikes up a deal with Mr. Feeny, who makes Cory a deal: if he paints Mr. Feeny's shutters, he will give Cory the money to buy a new water gun. However, Cory rushes in haste to buy the water gun, and he gets green paint all over the fence.

programme.title: Father Knows Less - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — While Alan and Cory stay up late to watch a baseball game, Cory fails a test the next day at school, and Mr. Feeny refuses to let him make it up.

programme.title: Cory's Alternative Friends - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory becomes friends with his school's outcasts when he changes his hair and finds that the consequences are very fatal.

programme.title: Killer Bees - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory is determined to be in the geography bee when he finds out that the winner gets to be bat-boy at the opening game of the world series. But, when he and Minkus trade places in the academic world, they end up trading places in the social world, too. Meanwhile, Eric is embarrassed when his parents show up at the same concert as he and a date.

programme.title: Boys II Mensa - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory cheats on an I.Q. test, and is labeled the smartest kid in class. However, the consequences for getting away with it are worse than getting caught; Cory may be transferred into a new school for smart kids. Meanwhile, Eric takes Morgan to pick out a Halloween costume, and she ends up being a zombie.

programme.title: Grandma Was a Rolling Stone - S01E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory gives up fishing with his dad when his grandma comes to town and makes him some great promises. But he's disappointed when she doesn't come through for him and Alan goes fishing with Shawn instead. Meanwhile, Eric uses Morgan to get the attention of Feeny's attractive niece.

programme.title: Teacher's Bet - S01E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — When Cory insists that teaching is easy in comparison to learning, Mr. Feeny agrees to temporarily switch roles on a bet, allowing Cory to handle social studies for one week.

programme.title: Class Pre-Union - S01E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Mr. Feeny has his class predict what their lives will be like by their class reunion. Meanwhile, Morgan trades her mother's gold necklace for a plastic one and has to get it back.

programme.title: Santa's Little Helper - S01E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Chet, Shawn's father, loses his job, and Cory vows that Shawn will have a Christmas gift this year. Morgan is also traumatized when a shopping mall Santa suffers a heart attack as she gets onto his lap.

programme.title: The Father/Son Game - S01E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — The father/son softball game is coming up and Cory and Eric don't want to play. They try to come up with a plan, but before they can Alan finds out how they feel. He tells them that the game was cancelled, but Cory finds out (from Topanga) that the game, in fact, was played. Cory and Eric feel bad and make amends with Alan, planning a make-up game for the following weekend.

programme.title: Once in Love with Amy - S01E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory and Eric are convinced that Amy is having an affair when they find provocative clothing in her bowling bag, and do not open their mind up to any other possibility.

programme.title: She Loves Me, She Loves Me Not - S01E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory's classmate Topanga develops a crush on Eric when he visits Mr. Feeny's class as a guest speaker.

programme.title: The B-Team of Life - S01E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory and Minkus are put on the Basketball B-Team for their school, which, subsequently, never gets to play.

programme.title: Model Family - S01E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Eric decides to quit his job at his father's store when he gets a modeling job at the mall. Alan wants to stop him, but Amy wants him to learn on his own. Meanwhile, Cory, Topanga, Shawn, and Minkus have to pretend to be a family for a school project.

programme.title: Risky Business - S01E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Cory and Shawn gamble on race horses and make a lot of money. But Cory realizes not every risk is worth it when he leaves Morgan home alone. Meanwhile, Cory's parents exchange Valentines. Also, Eric tries to get the attention of a girl.

programme.title: The Fugitive - S01E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — Shawn is forced to stay in Cory's room, in secrecy, because of a cherry bomb prank gone wrong in Alan's grocery store mailbox, which keeps him from going home. Shawn finally comes clean and goes back home. Shawn and Cory both learn valuable lessons. Shawn learns that he is not forced to be a bad kid and can be on Cory's "side of the line."

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Night - S01E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1993 · TV-G — When Cory and Shawn try and sneak an R-rated movie into the house while everyone will be out, their plans are in jeopardy when Mr. Feeny substitutes for their baby-sitter.

programme.title: Love and the Older Man - S04E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — When the family dentist, Dr. Vogel, asks Mike if Marcia would be interested in babysitting his kids, Marcia misinterprets the request as a date.

programme.title: Law and Disorder - S04E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Bobby is crestfallen when he is picked to be safety monitor at school. But with Mike's and Carol's encouragement, Bobby becomes determined to do the job well but goes overboard, becoming the most unwelcome person both at school and at home.

programme.title: Greg Gets Grounded - S04E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Bobby tells his parents that Greg nearly got into a freeway accident because he was reading the cover of a new record. Mike and Carol suspend Greg's car privileges for a week, but Greg has plans to take out his girlfriend Rachel. When Greg decides that his father's directive has a "loophole" and takes a buddy's car to procure rock concert tickets for the date, Mike really hits the roof and grounds him. Greg talks his way out of the severe punishment but is bound by "exact words" ... and it leads to a drive-in movie date that neither Greg nor Rachel will ever forget.

programme.title: Amateur Night - S04E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — The Brady kids want to buy a silver platter for their parents' wedding anniversary. But short on money, they perform on a TV amateur contest.

programme.title: Bobby's Hero - S04E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — The principal calls home to alert Mike and Carol to the fact that Bobby's playing Jesse James at school. This leads Mike and Carol to learn just how obsessed Bobby about his "idol" and try to dissuade him from worshiping a cold hearted killer.

programme.title: The Subject Was Noses - S04E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Marcia has a big problem when she inadvertently makes two dates for the same night. One with Charlie and the other with Doug, the big man on campus. She makes a excuse to Charlie to go out with Doug but quickly learns Doug was only interested in having a pretty girl on his arm after Marcia is hit in the face with a football.

programme.title: How to Succeed in Business? - S04E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Peter is ecstatic when he gets a job at Martinelli's bike shop. However, his wanting to do a thorough job inhibits his speed and work begins piling up as well as customers begin to demand their bikes. This leads Mr. Martinelli to give Peter the axe.

programme.title: The Great Earring Caper - S04E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Peter's new detective kit comes in handy when Cindy touches and then loses a pair of antique earrings that Marcia was borrowing from Carol that she warned her not to touch. This leads Peter and Cindy on an all out search for the missing earrings.

programme.title: You're Never Too Old - S04E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Both Robert Reed puts in double duty as Grandpa Brady as does Florence Henderson when she portrays Grandma Hutchins in an episode where the Brady kids play matchmakers and try to get Grandpa Brady and Grandma Hutchins together. However, their efforts may all be for naught when an argument erupts between Grandma and Grandpa during a romantic dinner.

programme.title: You Can't Win 'Em All - S04E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Both Bobby and Cindy have the opportunity to try out to be on a televised children's quiz show, if they get a certain score on a written test. However, an overconfident Bobby doesn't study at all and fails, while Cindy is chosen and her ego alienates the rest of the Brady kids.

programme.title: Room at the Top - S04E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — When the family cleans out the attic, both Greg and Marcia realize what a great room it would be and they both begin fighting over who gets it. This leads to yet another battle between the sexes.

programme.title: Adios, Johnny Bravo - S05E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — A musical agent spots Greg and offers him the chance of becoming solo star Johnny Bravo, but he soon learns the real reason he was selected -- he's a perfect fit for a garish suit.

programme.title: Mail Order Hero - S05E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Bobby lies to his friends by telling them he knows NFL legend Joe Namath. So Cindy sends a bogus letter to Namath stating that Bobby is dying and that his last wish is to meet the football star.

programme.title: Snow White and the Seven Bradys - S05E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — To earn money for a retirement gift for a teacher, the Brady family puts on a production of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs. But a mistake in dates threatens the performance by leaving the Bradys with no theater in which to perform.

programme.title: Never Too Young - S05E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — After Bobby defends a girl at school, she rewards him with a kiss and he immediately sees skyrockets. But after a second kiss, she tells Bobby that she may have the mumps.

programme.title: Peter and the Wolf - S05E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Greg's date can only go out with him if he can get a date for her visiting cousin. So Greg gets Peter to wear a fake moustache and act like an older man on the double date.

programme.title: Getting Greg's Goat - S05E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Greg and his friends steal a rival school's mascot goat, but things get out of control when the goat proves to be too hard to handle.

programme.title: Marcia Gets Creamed - S05E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Marcia loves her new job at the ice cream parlor -- until the shiftless Peter fouls things up and Jan outperforms her.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper - S05E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — After Bobby pushes Peter out of the way of a falling ladder, Peter volunteers to be Bobby's slave for life. But Bobby takes advantage of the situation.

programme.title: Quarterback Sneak - S05E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Marcia's new beau, the quarterback of the rival Fairview team, uses her to get to Greg's Westdale playbook.

programme.title: Try, Try Again - S05E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — After a string of failures, Jan becomes she has no talent -- until she discovers tap dancing, which drives the Brady family crazy.

programme.title: The Cincinnati Kids - S05E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Mike brings along the family on a business trip to an amusement park in Cincinnati. But when a mix-up occurs with Mike's blueprints, the Bradys must scour the park to find them.

programme.title: The Elopement - S05E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — The family mistakenly believes that Sam and Alice are eloping, so they plan a wedding reception.

programme.title: Miss Popularity - S05E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Jan is competing in a popularity contest at school. However, she finds herself making promises to her classmates that she can't keep.

programme.title: Kelly's Kids - S05E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — This failed backdoor pilot attempt finds the Bradys' friends, the Kellys, adopting three ethnically diverse boys and dealing with an inhospitable neighbor.

programme.title: The Driver's Seat - S05E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Greg and Marcia settle a bet about their driving skills by participating in a head-to-head competition, with the whole family cheering them on.

programme.title: Out of This World - S05E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — After meeting an astronaut, Bobby and Peter claim to have spotted a UFO and camp out in the backyard to get it on film.

programme.title: Welcome Aboard - S05E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — When Carol tells Mike she's expecting an addition to the family, eavesdropping Cindy and Bobby think that Carol is pregnant and pass the rumor along to the rest of the family. But the new addition isn't a baby, it's Carol's nephew Oliver, a clumsy boy who seems to bring trouble wherever he goes.

programme.title: Two Petes in a Pod - S05E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Peter meets a schoolmate who looks and sounds exactly like him. When Peter finds he has two dates for the same night, he hatches a plan to use his doppelganger to stand in for him.

programme.title: Top Secret - S05E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — When an FBI agent visits to check Mike's security clearance, Bobby and Oliver become convinced that Mike is working on plans for a top-secret project. They also suspect Sam of being an international spy scheming to steal the plans.

programme.title: The Snooperstar - S05E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Marcia plants a bogus story in her diary to trap the snooping Cindy, which leads Cindy to believe a talent scout wants her to be the next Shirley Temple.

programme.title: The Hustler - S05E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — When Mike's boss, Mr. Matthews, sends the family a pool table, Bobby becomes obsessed with pool, challenging all comers including Mr. Matthews himself.

programme.title: The Hair-Brained Scheme - S05E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Wanting to get rich quick, Bobby begins selling bottles of hair tonic. But the tonic turns Greg's hair orange just days before his high-school graduation. In what happened to be the final episode of the series, series star Robert Reed got himself written out of the episode when he objected to the episode's plotline and writing and neither he nor the Schwartzes would budge.

programme.title: The Honeymoon - S01E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — In the series opener, Mike Brady, a widower with three boys, marries Carol Martin, a widow with three girls. Just as the minister says "I do" the boy's dog, Tiger gets loose and chases the girl's cat through the wedding party. Chaos breaks loose which prompts Carol and Mike to yell at their kids to control their pets. Guilt over yelling at their kids comes into play later during Mike and Carol's honeymoon.

programme.title: Dear Libby - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — An article in an advice column, Dear Libby, draws Marcia's attention. In the article, an anonymous person is in the same situation as Mike and Carol is in and this particular person is unhappy. This leads Marcia to draw the conclusion that Mike or Carol wrote the letter. She later shows the article to the other kids and they devise a plot to keep their newly formed family together.

programme.title: Eenie, Meenie, Mommy, Daddy - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Cindy has been cast as the fairy princess in the school play. She's excited that her mom and new dad will be able to see her in the production until she learns she can only invite one parent. Torn between who she should choose, Cindy fakes an injury to get out of being in the play.

programme.title: Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — No longer feeling needed around the Brady household, Alice makes up a story about an ailing aunt in Seattle in order to leave. Later the family finds out the truth and put "Operation Alice" in effect in an attempt to make her stay.

programme.title: Katchoo - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Jan comes down with a mysterious allergy and Carol and Alice try to determine just what is causing it. They deduce that the cause is Tiger, the family dog. Or is it?

programme.title: A Clubhouse is Not a Home - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — With more and more of the girls belongings being moved over from storage, the boys become fed up and take to their 'No Girls Allowed' clubhouse in the backyard which sparks the first of many battles between the sexes. This leads the girls to try to build their own clubhouse.

programme.title: Kitty Karry-All is Missing - S01E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — When Cindy's doll, Kitty Karry-All turns up missing, she accuses Bobby. This leads to a mock trial with Alice as the judge to determine Bobby's guilt or innocence. Then later Bobby's kazoo turns up missing and he blames Cindy.

programme.title: A-Camping We Will Go - S01E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Mike and Carol prepare for a family camping trip. However, the boys are not thrilled that the girls will be coming along. Meanwhile, the girls aren't exactly thrilled about sleeping in the wilderness. Later on the trip, things go awry when the girls mess up the boys fishing plans and freak out when they hear owl hoots.

programme.title: Sorry, Right Number - S01E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — With nine people in the house, Mike gets frustrated when he can never get any time on the phone for himself. He decides to install a second phone line, but that only makes the problem worse. Thanks to one of Alice's ideas, Mike decides to install a pay phone in the family room. The plan works ... until Mike needs to use the phone one day to set up an appointment with a hard-to-please, heavily scrutinizing developer ... and when the phone company cuts the call off and Mike doesn't have a dime, the developer isn't too amused at all. But in the end, the pay phone proves its worth, both for Mike's blood pressure and securing a multi-million-dollar contract for Mike's firm.

programme.title: Every Boy Does It Once - S01E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — After watching "Cinderella" on TV, Bobby becomes concerned about stepmothers—especially since Carol asks him to sweep out the fireplace. Soon after, feeling worthless, Bobby decides to run away.

programme.title: Vote for Brady - S01E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Both Greg and Marcia rush home after school with the news that they're both running for student body president. May the best candidate win, as the boys and girls each take sides and soon each one of them is accusing the other of sabotage. Later, rudeness and apathy abound as each candidate rehearses their campaign speech, leading to a stern lecture from Mike about family unity and how they will be a family far longer than either Greg or Marcia will be class president. It's a speech that Greg take seriously when he fires his campaign manager for recommending that they spread a lie around school that Marcia was seen in the balcony of the local movie theater with an older boy. Marcia (who witnessed the exchange without Greg knowing it) realizes that, while Greg is indeed intensely competitive, he also has integrity and will stick up for his siblings ... and then understands that Greg is the best for the job after all.

programme.title: The Voice of Christmas - S01E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Carol is to sing in church on Christmas, but days before the event, she loses her voice. Later at the mall, a hopeful Cindy asks a Santa Claus to bring Carol's voice back by Christmas. Meanwhile, Alice and the kids find it a difficult task hiding Christmas gifts in the house.

programme.title: Is There a Doctor in the House? - S01E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Peter comes home from school with the measles, so naturally, Carol calls the doctor, her doctor, who happens to be a woman. Meanwhile, Mike calls his doctor, a man. Soon all the kids come down with the measles and the household is in an uproar in yet another battle of the sexes, as the girls want a female doctor and the boys want a male doctor.

programme.title: Father of the Year - S01E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Marcia enters Mike in a "Father of the Year" contest through the newspaper. However, in order to do this she's had to sneak around. When Mike catches her and she's unable to explain, he grounds her from the family ski trip.

programme.title: 54-40 and Fight - S01E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — The Brady family learns that a trading stamp company is going out of business. A fight breaks out over who should get all of the saved stamps, the boys or the girls. If the girls get them, they'll buy a sewing machine and if the boys get them, they'll buy a rowboat.

programme.title: Mike's Horror-Scope - S01E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — The day after Carol reads Mike's horoscope, which states "a strange woman will enter your life tomorrow," Beebe Gallini enters Mike's office and proves to be a most difficult client. Soon, Mike finds himself spending more time at the office than at home with Carol and the kids.

programme.title: The Undergraduate - S01E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — When Greg begins constant daydreaming and his grades start to drop the Brady's quickly think something is wrong. They soon deduce he has puppy love, for a certain girl named Linda. However, they are having an incredibly hard time finding the right Linda but soon the Bradys quickly learn just who this Linda is.

programme.title: Tiger, Tiger! - S01E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — One afternoon, Bobby briefly leaves Tiger unattended and returns to find him missing. Soon a city wide search is on. Meanwhile, a string of burglaries in the neighborhood has Alice paranoid. Could the robbers have lured Tiger away in order to rob the Brady house?

programme.title: The Big Sprain - S01E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Carol is out of town visiting her sick Aunt Mary and Alice is all prepared to take care of the Brady home. However, she sprains her ankle, after tripping on Chinese checkers, putting Mike and the kids in charge of the household duties. Meanwhile, her boyfriend Sam finds himself in a dilemma over whether or not to take someone else to the upcoming Meatcutters Ball.

programme.title: Brace Yourself - S01E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Marcia is distraught after getting braces and becomes convinced she's ugly. This compounds when her boyfriend Alan breaks their upcoming date, thinking it's due to her braces. Meanwhile, the Brady kids try their best to make Marcia not feel so self-conscious but with little success.

programme.title: The Hero - S01E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — While shopping at Driscoll's Toy Store, Peter looks up to see a wall about to fall on a little girl. He quickly pushes her out of the way. This leads to immediate media attention and Peter is named a hero. However, Peter lets all the attention go to his head, annoying his friends and his brothers and sisters.

programme.title: The Possible Dream - S01E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Marcia's sense of security is shattered when Cindy inadvertently gives away her diary to a book collection. Marcia is especially concerned since in it, she confessed a secret desire for Desi Arnaz, Jr.

programme.title: To Move or Not to Move - S01E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — With constant complaints about the size of the house bombarding Mike and Carol, Mike puts the house up for sale and looks into buying a new one. Immediately after this, the Brady house seems to be haunted.

programme.title: The Grass is Always Greener - S01E24
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Mike and Carol switch roles for a day in order to prove a day with the opposite sex involves much less work. Their duties: Carol must help the boys with baseball practice and Mike must help Marcia with a cooking badge.

programme.title: Lost Locket, Found Locket - S01E25
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Jan receives a mysterious locket in the mail with no indication of who sent it. While the Bradys are trying to figure out who sent it, the locket mysteriously vanishes.

programme.title: The Dropout - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1969 · TV-G — Don Drysdale's tips for Greg on his baseball playing go to his head. Which leads to Greg deciding to not go to college and he even starts to think about dropping out of high school.

programme.title: Dinner Party - S02E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak, Mom, Dad and Thunderclese have been inivited over to dinner at the neighbor's house. The neighbor include Franklin (A nervous dad whose nose always seems to be growing) Rhodna (A mother who lives in a steel box that keeps talking about everyone's judgement) and the son (A big fat guy that looks like a baby that can barley move around).

programme.title: We Ski in Peace - S02E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak wants to go to work with Father for ""Go To Work with your Father Day"". Brak's mom tells Brak the truth that Father doesn't work. Father shows mother a secret underground base, where he works for no money keeping Earth safe. Brak's mom forces him to get a real job at the local Ice Cream Shop. Meanwhile, Alien Ants from Outer Space attack while Father is away from his old job...

programme.title: Braklet, Prince of Spaceland - S03E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — The Brak Family Players present their take on the classic Hamlet story.

programme.title: Coma - S03E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak's father offers to help Thundercleese win the heart of his true love. Zorak burns things.

programme.title: Shadows of Heat - S03E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak's father enlists the aid of a secret agent to pull off a caper.

programme.title: Splat - S03E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Mom and Dad are involved in an accident that must be kept secret.

programme.title: Enter the Hump - S03E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — After being bitten by a radioactive camel, Dad is given super-powers.

programme.title: Sexy New Brak Show Go - S03E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak wins a cereal contest, giving him his own TV show.

programme.title: All That I Desire You - S03E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — The Brak Family Players present their take on a soap opera. Mom was blinded in a freak accident; Dad is an oil millionaire (but also a famous billionaire secret even to him). Brak has married his love, Connie. Zorak is a skin-bleached breast surgeon.

programme.title: Cardburkey - S03E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak decides that living in a cardboard box will help land him an impressive girlfriend.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Zorak convinces Brak he will be more popular at school if he steals the mascot from rival Jerkwater High School.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak promises to take care of Mr. Thundercleese's goldfish, Mr. Tickles, while he is away. Goldfish eat ham don't they?

programme.title: Time Machine - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak and Zorak didn't finish their homework on time, so they borrow Thundercleese's time machine to go back in time to set things right.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Zorak makes Brak jealous when he develops a wonderful singing voice after accidentally having a pink lump knocked out of his throat.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak is upset because Zorak made him get rid of his lobster doll, Hippo.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — When an alien blob named Mobab falls in love with Mom and takes her away to his home planet, Dad realizes how much he needs her and he and Brak go into outer space to save her.

programme.title: Expiration Day - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Thundercleese finds his powers have been deactivated by his creators, which is a bad thing as there is an asteroid heading for Earth. Dad and Brak go off to get Thundercleese's powers back in time to save the world, and blast Zorak to pieces.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak and company attempt to raise money to save Senor Science by putting on a musical.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Dad and Zorak engage in a good old fashioned staring contest.

programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Zorak has set up a booth were children give him money to beat them up. Unfortunately, the business has been taken over by Butch.

programme.title: President Dad - S02E04

programme.title: Feud - S02E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Dad and Thundercleese are in the midst of a neighborhood feud. Weird Al Yankovic guest stars.

programme.title: Runaway - S02E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak gets grounded and decides to run away from home. Special guest Space Ghost arrives at the house to arrest Brak for crimes he has committed in the future.

programme.title: The New Brak - S02E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak has a devoted admirer which is initially quite flattering. But, when the admirer starts imitating him, Brak worries that he might be replaced.

programme.title: Pepper - S02E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Dad believes the Mothership will take him away to be king of the alien world. Meanwhile, Zorak begins a relationship with an interesting alien named Pepper. Sisto joins the aliens on the Mothership for dinner.

programme.title: Dinner Party - S02E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak, Mom, Dad and Thunderclese have been inivited over to dinner at the neighbor's house. The neighbor include Franklin (A nervous dad whose nose always seems to be growing) Rhodna (A mother who lives in a steel box that keeps talking about everyone's judgement) and the son (A big fat guy that looks like a baby that can barley move around).

programme.title: We Ski in Peace - S02E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2000 · TV-14 — Brak wants to go to work with Father for ""Go To Work with your Father Day"". Brak's mom tells Brak the truth that Father doesn't work. Father shows mother a secret underground base, where he works for no money keeping Earth safe. Brak's mom forces him to get a real job at the local Ice Cream Shop. Meanwhile, Alien Ants from Outer Space attack while Father is away from his old job...
