programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis' school is putting on a play which Mr. Wilson ends up being in (not by choice) because him and Tommy (who is also in the play) get handcuffed together before the play starts.

programme.title: The Fifty-Thousandth Customer - S03E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Finch is having a contest that when the fifty-thousandth customer walks in his store they will win 5 minutes of free shopping of which Mr. Wilson is determined to be the one who wins.

programme.title: Dennis and the Pee Wee League - S03E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson coaches Dennis' Pee Wee League baseball team because Dennis' dad (who originally was the coach) got sick.

programme.title: Mr. Wilson's Inheritance - S03E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson wants to represent Scotland for Dennis' School

programme.title: Dennis Is a Genius - S03E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — The school test scores mistake Dennis as a genius.

programme.title: The Lucky Piece - S03E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson tricks Dennis into taking a silver coin that says GOOD LUCK and a horseshoe on it instead of 50 cents that he owes him for cutting his lawn. Mrs. Wilson is very angry with him about it. So, she and Alice start a scheme of their own by making lucky things happen to Dennis all day. Mr. Wilson soon starts to believe that the coin was lucky after all and is sorry he ever let it go. He then realizes that it was all a charade to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: The Fifteen Foot Christmas Tree - S03E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis, Henry and Mr. Wilson go out in the woods and cut down a big Christmas tree which ends up getting almost destroyed by the time they get it home.

programme.title: Dennis' Bank Account - S03E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis opens a bank account at the bank of where Mr. Wilson works at and causes a lot of chaos at the bank.

programme.title: Through Thick and Thin - S03E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis' cub scouts are putting on a circus of which Mr. Wilson is the Lion in the circus, which is suppose to be a secret from everyone.

programme.title: Calling All Bird Lovers - S03E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson holds a bird lovers session at his home Where a woman does bird calls that sounds just like a bird.

programme.title: Silence Is Golden - S03E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson agrees to give Dennis his magnifying glass if he doesn't talk around him for the day.

programme.title: Dennis Has a Fling - S03E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis is put on the spot when he askes both Mr. Wilson and Mr. Mactavish to represent Scotland in his school project.

programme.title: Frog Jumping Contest - S03E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis enters his frog in the frog jumping contest with Mr. Wilson as his partner who has a bet with Sgt. Mooney that Dennis' frog will beat his.

programme.title: Where There's a Will - S03E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson gives Dennis a Gold watch in his will. Soon after that Mr. Wilson begins to feel old and is convinced that he has short time to live.

programme.title: Mr. Wilson's Uncle - S03E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson's Uncle comes to visit him and convinces him that he isn't in shape, so he starts a physical fitness program and forces Mr. Mitchell and Mr. Wilson to be in it.

programme.title: A Quiet Evening - S03E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson plans to have a quiet evening at home, but his plans change when Henry needs a sitter for Dennis.

programme.title: The Private Eye - S03E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson gets his wallet taken by a pick pocket, So Dennis and Tommy try to find the crook for the police.

programme.title: Mr. Wilson's Housekeeper - S03E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson hires a housekeeper for Mrs. Wilson but soon regrets it when the housekeeper tries to tell Mr. Wilson what he can and can't do in his home. Mr. Wilson then tries to get rid of her.

programme.title: A Dog's Life - S03E24
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — A big shaggy dog followes Mr. Wilson home and Mr. Wilson tries to get rid of it.

programme.title: Dennis' Documentary Film - S03E25
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis does a documentary film of the town for a school project with Mr. Wilson's help.

programme.title: Horseless Carriage Club - S03E26
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson takes Dennis and his friends up to the lake and back in an old car. Mr. Wilson then gets elected president of the Horseless Carriage Club.

programme.title: Junior Pathfinders Ride Again - S03E27
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson attempts to start a fire like the pioneers did for Dennis' Junior Pathfinders club and nearly burns down the place.

programme.title: The Treasure Chest - S03E28
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson buys a treasure chest at an auction thinking that it has buried treasure in it. Mr. Wilson later discovers a treasure map drawn by Dennis. Although Mr. Wilson thinks the map is authentic so he plans to take a trip to the island and dig for the treasure.

programme.title: Wilson Goes to the Dentist - S03E29
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis convinces Mr. Wilson to go to the Dentist for his tooth because Dennis thinks he can get a basketball from the Dentist until he learns that the Dentist only gives away prizes to child patients.

programme.title: The Man Next Door - S03E30
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson thinks his next door neighbor is the stocking bandit and tries to prove it.

programme.title: Dennis and the Dodger - S03E31
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Quigley coaches Dennis' baseball team with help from Sandy Koufax.

programme.title: Dennis' Lovesick Friend - S03E32
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis helps Mr. Wilson's Uncle Ned plant flower bulbs in his yard in order to get out of playing house with Margaret Wade.

programme.title: John Wilson's Cushion - S03E33
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — George Wilson's brother John Wilson comes to visit, only he has trouble working without his old cushion.

programme.title: John Wilson Wins a Chicken - S03E34
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis and his friends win John Wilson a chicken, which John wants to cook for dinner and the children try to talk him out of it.

programme.title: The Bully - S03E35
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis is all set for a big day. He is scheduled to have a fight with Gifford - the school bully.

programme.title: The Club Initiation - S03E36
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis wants to join an older boys club, but in order to do so he has to take an initiation.

programme.title: Community Picnic - S03E37
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — The Neighborhood Community puts on a carnival in the park with different winning contests to participate in.

programme.title: Dennis and the Witch Doctor - S03E38
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. Wilson is doing a magazine article on voodoo, Dennis gets the wrong idea and tells the whole neighborhood that Mr. Wilson is a Witch Doctor, Soon the whole town gets the wrong idea about Mr. Wilson.

programme.title: The Chinese Girl - S04E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Mr. and Mrs. Wilson have a Chinese girl that is staying with them while Mr. Wilson is interviewing the girls father for a magazine article.

programme.title: You Go Your Way - S04E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis hears Mr.& Mrs. Wilson argue and spreads it around the Neighborhood and soon some of the neighbors think that the Wilson's have split up.

programme.title: Dennis and the Circular Circumstances - S04E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1959 · TV-PG — Dennis gets a job for a day delivering Circulars for Mrs. Elkins. But, When he swaps territories with another kid, he gets blamed for throwing the circulars in a trash can.

programme.title: Episode 4 - S03E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren sets out to get two people communicating with each other despite speaking different languages and performs a routine spanning the canals of Venice. He also invites Robbie Williams to a remote location in the East End for a spot of body piercing.

programme.title: Episode 5 - S03E05
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren travels to Vienna, where he performs a perplexing effect on the giant Ferris wheel featured in Orson Welles' The Third Man. He also manipulates a cinema audience to forget a film they have just watched, while Stephen Merchant takes part in a game of fifty-fifty chance.

programme.title: Episode 6 - S03E06
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren performs an old séance trick for Meera Syal, makes an amputee feel sensation in their missing limb and demonstrates a memory feat in Monaco.

programme.title: Episode 1 - S01E01
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren makes a taxi driver forget about an obvious destination. He also plays chess against nine of the U.K.'s top chess players.

programme.title: Episode 2 - S01E02
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — On the Street: Derren could read how many fingers someone was holding up (behind their back and then in their pockets). Then he made them read how many fingers he held up. Martin Kemp: Derren guessed what object Martin was going to choose from 150 objects, before he had chosen it. Penalty Shoot-Out: Derren predicts, split-seconds before the penalty is taken, where a mid-fielder is going to kick the ball into the goal, five times. He gets it right every time. Memory: Derren draws a building almost perfectly from memory, but it turns out to be a mirror image. Penalty Light Test: A goalie guesses every time which button the mid-fielder presses, as they turn on the same lights at the same time.

programme.title: Episode 3 - S01E03
programme.desc:
Documentary · 2004 — Leaving wallet ringed with yellow circle containg cash on Regent Street.
Identifying three pieces of music conducted, without any orchestra, by Robin Stapleton selected from list of Derren's CD collection.
Invisible Man hypnosis routine with film student.
Street Work: Member of the crowd mindreading the address of another bystander after a little instruction from Derren.
Orchestra playing a piece (after having started randomly) which was chosen by the conductor and only transmitted to them by his "mental conducting."

programme.title: Episode 4 - S01E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren uses a voodoo doll to restrict a woman's movements and makes a primary teacher transmit her thoughts to her pupils.

programme.title: Episode 5 - S01E05
programme.desc:
Documentary · 2004 — Street Work: Member of the crowd mindreading the name of another bystander's pet after a little instruction from Derren.
Undertaker sorting a pile of photographs. Based on the photographs' subjects, Derren reveals that he had unwittingly sorted them into people that were dead, and those that were alive. Derren decribes the process as having been "out of this world."
Michel Roux, Jr cooks a meal which reminds him of a specific occasion, Derren then describes the scene he has pictured and gives the breeds and names of the two dogs in the memory.
A butcher, baker and candlestick maker arrange furniture in a room and then select a toy each. Derren then shows them a room in a dolls' house laid out in the same way with their three figures holding the chosen toys.

programme.title: Episode 6 - S01E06
programme.desc:
Documentary · 2004 — Street Work: Repeatedly identifying the finger thought of by a member of the public, having the subject tell how many fingers Derren is holding up out of sight.
Predicting words given by a psychologist during a word dissociation game. Final prediction of a free choice word.
Derren stopping woman walking across a room by clenching his fist out of her sight. Woman stopping pedestrian walking past the window by clenching her fist.
Derren correctly predicting 'secret' drawing from a dissociated drawing (like the word dissociation game) drawn by the psychologist.
Derren predicting item to be selected from a supermarket by a supermarket designer with a label on his back. The route around the supermaket had also been predicted on an envelope sent earlier in the week.

programme.title: Episode 1 - S02E01
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren uses his fingers to see. He also gives Simon Pegg the present he always wanted.

programme.title: Episode 2 - S02E02
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren steals wallets without stealing them.

programme.title: Episode 3 - S02E03
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren guesses numbers and amazes an horologist.

programme.title: Episode 4 - S02E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren shows of a quick counting technique and puts someone in a very realistic zombie game.

programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren shows some card tricks to a cardmaker. He also identifies the owner of a cell phone by the ringtone.

programme.desc: Documentary · 2004 — Derren makes people drunk without the use of alcohol nor drugs. He also impersonates "The Brown Raja who sees all" at a fair.

programme.title: Pilot - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — Lower-level cabinet member Tom Kirkman becomes President of the United States after a catastrophic attack on the U.S. Capitol. Kirkman must keep the country and his family safe while leading the search for the those responsible for the attack.

programme.title: The First Day - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — Hours after the attack on the Capitol, President Kirkman steps into his role as Commander-in-Chief in the midst of chaos and confusion. programme.title: The Confession - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — President Kirkman and his staff work to keep a high-level security breach of the White House a secret just as he’s about to give his first television interview. The FBI continues to investigate the Capitol bombing but Agent Hannah Wells starts to develop her own theories about who was really behind the attack.

programme.title: The Enemy - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — Kirkman learns who is behind the attack and needs to grapple not only with the prospect of war, but brewing domestic troubles as well. programme.title: The Mission - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — Realizing his attempts at diplomacy with Algeria have failed, President Kirkman makes the difficult decision of sending Navy SEALs on a mission that will define his presidency. Agent Hannah Wells discovers more secrets than answers.

programme.title: The Interrogation - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — When shots ring out at The White House during a Governors Summit, President Kirkman’s plans at electing a new Congress are thrown into turmoil. Agent Hannah Wells continues investigating the Capitol bombing and makes one of her most shocking discoveries yet.

programme.title: The Traitor - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — When an American track-and-field coach heads to Russia, President Kirkman is thrust into a hostage exchange involving the CIA and the Russian government. Agent Hannah Wells and Deputy Director Atwood’s investigation into the Capitol bombing uncovers information that puts Atwood and his family’s life at risk.

programme.title: The Results - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — On the eve of the country voting to elect a new House of Representatives, an unexpected development forces Kirkman to consider cancelling the elections entirely. News about Majid Nassar’s death leaks out, and Kirkman has to handle the fallout.

programme.title: The Blueprint - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — When classified government documents are leaked online, President Kirkman searches for the party responsible only to find that they have taken refuge inside a foreign embassy and are beyond even his reach. programme.title: The Oath - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — President Kirkman fears there could be a traitor in the White House when he discovers shocking information connected to the Capitol Bombing. programme.title: Warriors - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 2016 · TV-PG — The nation reels from the aftermath of the shooting on the steps of the Capitol while Emily struggles with the knowledge there may be a traitor in the White House. programme.title: The End of the Beginning - S01E12

programme.title: Backfire - S01E13

programme.title: What Kind of Bad? - S01E05
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Looking for a way out of his construction gig, Bobby tries to change Vincent’s mind about Rudy’s offer. Darlene returns from a trip home with a new girl, disappointing Abby. Roughed up by a john, Candy contemplates a change of careers. After getting busted, Paul explores the underbelly, and the exhilaration, of gay life in the city. With an assist from Alston, Sandra scores a key interview with a pimp.

programme.title: Why Me? - S01E06
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — An end-of-the-year crackdown by police in and around The Deuce sparks Vincent and Bobby. Candy tries to persuade Harvey, her adult-film director, that she can do more than act. Rudy witnesses a pivotal lower-court ruling on obscenity, and enlists Frankie and Big Mike to protect his interests in the peeps. Alston tries to convince Sandra that he’s not just a “source.”

programme.title: Au Reservoir - S01E07
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — With police pushing their business off the streets, C.C., Larry, Rodney and other pimps worry about becoming obsolete. Candy eyes a different job on Harvey’s set as Lori struggles with the demands of porn acting. At her wit’s end, Ashley hangs out with Frankie and, later, washes up on Abby’s door. Bobby is smitten with an employee while dealing with shakedowns, flare-ups and a medical emergency. Frankie is tasked by Rudy to turn a peep-show concept into reality. Alston finds himself singled out by the 14th Precinct’s new captain, McDonagh. Abby asks Vincent to be her escort at her family’s lavish party.

programme.title: My Name Is Ruby - S01E08
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Vincent balks at getting in deeper with Rudy, as expansion fever hits Frankie and Bobby. Candy gets a taste of directing, and enjoys the red-carpet perks of a major premiere. Alston finds himself in limbo at his precinct. Abby changes up the Hi-Hat’s clientele. Sandra faces editorial and legal hurdles. Barbara and Thunder Thighs connect with the wrong sort of clients. Vincent settles a score. C.C. encourages Ace, a former pimp, to get back in the game.

programme.title: Our Raison d'Etre - S02E01
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Times Square, 1977. Vincent is now proprietor of a new mob-backed disco. Abby has brought the nascent punk-rock culture into the Hi-Hat. Frankie remains a problem, “borrowing” money from Show Land to pay off his debts. Candy looking to make more artful, ambitious adult films. C.C. pulls a con on the director of a porn film to get Lori more money. Paul looks to sever mob ties from his current bar. Alston is approached by a civil servant appointed by Mayor Koch to clean up Times Square.

programme.title: There's an Art to This - S02E02
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Confronted with the changing realities of prostitution and porn, C.C. doubles down on his assets, while fellow pimp Larry Brown eyes a new opportunity. Growing creatively frustrated, Candy turns to Genevieve Furie, a onetime porn director who’s graduated to slasher films, for filmmaking advice. After a customer is mugged outside his bar, Paul is approached by Matty the Horse, a rival of Rudy’s, who promises Paul the mob protection he deserves. Following a nostalgic road trip to Coney Island with Vincent, Abby attends a meeting of activists, and recognizes a familiar face from Times Square.

programme.title: Seven-Fifty - S02E03
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Lori envisions a sunny future in LA after attending the AFFA Erotica Awards with Harvey and Candy, who’s looking to connect with west-coast producers who are willing to turn her fairy tale into reality. Paul and Kenneth approach Vincent about a loan for a new nightclub, free from mob ties. Goldman visits Alston’s precinct to share the mayor’s vision for cleaning up the Deuce. Frankie wins a hand of poker, but risks losing his job. Back in NYC, Ashley pushes her reform agenda on Abby, while trying to avoid C.C.. Larry Brown and Darlene learn a bitter lesson about supply and demand. Rudy sends a message to his rivals, but invites retaliation.

programme.title: What Big Ideas - S02E04
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Ashley and Abby resolve to track down the identity of a 16-year-old sex worker killed in a recent fire. Vincent is shaken after witnessing the brutal side of Rudy’s operation. Frustrated by the progress on her new film, Candy recruits new faces to help with the production. Frankie finds his dry-cleaning business a less-than-perfect fit. Larry Brown shows off his improvisational skills. Lori looks to forge a deal with Kiki while keeping C.C. in the loop.

programme.title: All You'll Be Eating is Cannibals - S02E05
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Temporarily flush with cash, Frankie is tapped by Candy to be a co-producer on Red Hot. Lori eyes a plum role in the film, but still feels the burden of being under C.C.'s yoke. With Rudy's blessing, Big Mike and Black Frankie hit a gambling house in the Bronx. Bobby finds himself stigmatized at home and at the Hi-Hat after a surprise raid overseen by Alston. Paul encounters resistance to his elaborate renovation plans. Out of rehab, Shay is convinced to move in with a nurturing Irene. As she and Abby deliver on their promise to provide medical care to sex workers, Ashley decides to confront her past...and doesn't blink.

programme.title: We're All Beasts - S02E06
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Candy shoots her opus guerilla-style on the streets of New York. Vincent makes a confession to Abby, along with a promise to change. Ashley and Abby help a prostitute escape the Deuce, with a little help from Vincent. Larry Brown gets a promotion. Paul celebrates the opening of his new upscale club. Bobby turns to Vincent to find work for his wayward eldest son, Joey.

programme.title: The Feminism Part - S02E07
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Trapped by his own success, Vincent envisions an idyllic rural life with Abby. Candy is frustrated by her mob backers' misogyny and weighs telling her son, Adam, what she really does for a living. Shay reverts to form, to Irene's dismay. Joey falls in love. Darlene deals with unexpected news. Lori hits a roadblock in her quest for adult-film stardom. Alston faces a dilemma involving his old partner, Flanagan. Paul and Kenneth arrive at a crossroads.

Candy puts the finishing touches on Red Hot in advance of its premiere.

programme.title: Inside the Pretend - S02E09

Lori is afraid to go to LA without C.C.'s permission. Paul turns to a familiar source to help finance Tod's dream. Darlene comes clean. Goldman and Alston's plan for cleaning up Times Square hits a roadblock.

programme.title: The Camera Loves You - S03E01
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — On the eve of 1985, a worn-out Vincent reconnects with his ex-wife, Andrea, as his open relationship with Abby grows more distant. Despite becoming a family man, Frankie continues his risky side hustles. With the newly dominant VHS format shaking up their industry, Candy and Harvey travel to Las Vegas for an adult film convention where they disagree on how to navigate a fast-changing future. Fresh out of rehab, Lori is put back to work. Alston makes a very specific request of Goldman in their quest to revitalize Midtown. Now a bartender at the Hi-Hat, Loretta becomes an active member of Women Against Pornography.

programme.title: Morta di Fame - S03E02
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Frankie takes his amateur porn business to the next level and ends up in a confrontation with Rudy, who pushes Vincent to up his profits. Candy brainstorms a new film based on the experiences of her fellow sex workers and finds that her new beau Hank is not shaken by her past. Abby and Loretta take care of Shay when she shows up to the Hi-Hat in bad shape. Lori is advised be more compliant after she dares to stand up for herself on set. Alston is tasked with finding the mysterious owner of a prime piece of Midtown real estate. With the future of his businesses up in the air, Paul worries about his partner Tod's health.

programme.title: Normal Is a Lie - S03E03
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Abby befriends a graffiti artist named Pilar and takes a surprising trip downtown. Candy sets a firm line with Hank when it comes to money. As Todd’s health worsens, he reexamines his priorities and asks for Paul’s support. Melissa is forced to face her past. Alston explores different strategies for getting a shady SRO owner to sell. Bobby pays Joey a visit on Wall Street as Joey’s latest money-making scheme grows bigger. Tensions rise between Frankie and Rudy as a buyer complains about Frankie’s product.

programme.title: They Can Never Go Home - S03E04
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — Lori returns to New York for an audition and runs into some familiar faces. While searching for actors for her new film, Candy speaks to her critics at a Women Against Pornography meeting. As things heat up with Jennifer, Alston takes a drastic step to deliver for Goldman. Melissa leaves the city. Abby grows closer to Pilar as her relationship with Vincent wanes. Vincent and Frankie celebrate an eventful birthday.

programme.title: You Only Get One - S03E05
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — With his club shuttered, a distraught Vincent follows a lead down a dangerous path. Paul reaches out to Tod's parents. Candy battles Harvey over her latest script and reunites with her estranged son, Adam. Lori hits the feature dancing circuit with mixed results. Abby reflects on her choices when she gets an unexpected visitor. Bobby does right by Black Frankie. Alston defends the plan to clean up Midtown. Gene reckons with his conflicted personal life.

programme.title: This Trust Thing - S03E06
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — In the wake of a personal loss, Candy finds the emotional core of her latest movie. Abby confronts Vincent after she makes an alarming discovery. Paul turns to activism as the AIDS epidemic continues to ravage New York's gay community. Vincent tips off Rudy to Tommy's disloyalty. Lori realizes she's on her own when both Greg and Kiki let her down. Bobby learns why the women who worked for him have abandoned the French Parlor.

programme.title: That's a Wrap - S03E07
programme.desc: Drama · 2017 · TV-MA — A struggling Lori turns to Candy for help before revisiting The Deuce. Candy makes a surprising deal to secure funding for her film. programme.title: Face Off - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — It's kill or be killed in the final act of Kevin's life imitating art nightmare, and Kevin and his village square off against the enemy, hoping to put an end to their deadly charade; Kevin comes face-to-face with his would-be killer.

programme.title: The Peanut Man - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — After his latest dramatic flop, Kevin enlists Oscar-winner Jillian Jones to introduce him to prestigious filmmaker Jackson Pepper; Pepper doubts Kevin's commitment as an actor but entices him with the opportunity of an exciting part.

programme.title: The Relatively Small Package - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Jordan King plays the role of thief-stealing bonds, nuclear codes, and more-all as an elaborate audition for filmmaker Jackson Pepper; when her latest task leads her to Jackson Pepper's mansion, she finds a frantic Kevin Hart and her next assignment.

programme.title: The Fisher King - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Kevin and Jordan grapple with Jackson Pepper's death and his motives, stunned by their twisted role research; FBI agent John Fisher investigates the crime scene with a rookie; surveillance footage incriminates Kevin, with Jordan as his accomplice.

programme.title: The Vacuum from Sarasota - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Reeling from the accident, Kevin and Jordan face a twist: the woman they hit orchestrated the entire accident to study for a role and she is not dead; seeking answers with their new companion, Pearl, they visit Roger Richards, an ex-cop.

programme.title: The Legend of Lionel Pendergrass - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Kevin dons a disguise as forensics expert Lionel Pendergrass; Jordan and Pearl bond as they wait in the getaway car; despite Fisher's suspicions-and some questionably feigned bowel movements-Kevin escapes with the surveillance tapes.

programme.title: The Face of Guffey Light - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — As dawn breaks, Fisher drives Kevin, Jordan, and Pearl to an unknown location; Pearl recognizes the agent from beer commercials; this prompts Fisher to reveal an elusive backstory of how he became an FBI agent for a Jackson Pepper role.

programme.title: The Code of Hammurabi - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Trapped between a gun and a hot place by Agent Fisher, Kevin delivers a heartfelt monologue, moving even their hard-ass captor; Jordan frees them, knocking out Fisher; Jackson Pepper appears, alive, revealing his staged death.

programme.title: Man on Fire - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Kevin meets his action star mentor, Coach Ron Wilcox, as he enters a world of pain.

programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Things get up close and personal for Kevin and Jordan as Coach Ron teaches a master class in lovemaking.

programme.desc: Action · 2020 · TV-MA — Kevin is still convinced Ron is involved in something sinister. When Josh Hartnett arrives for a lesson in firearms, Kevin attempts to escape for his life.
