programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Blake asks Steven to be his campaign manager. He is deeply disappointed when Steven declines his offer, expressing no interest in exposing his private life to public scrutiny. Attributing Jeff and Fallon's intimacy with Blake to their giving him grandchildren, Adam continues to pressure Dana into starting a family. Alone, following Alexis' surprise catered dinner, Sean Rowan carefully studies an old news clip of Blake's custody trial for Steven's son, Danny. Alexis is hounded by a reporter, Rebecca Payne, from an unscrupulous tabloid. Rebecca is seeking a comment on Alexis' recent decline in support for her gubernatorial candidacy. Sammy Jo is saddened by the realization that her and Steven's relationship will never have the closeness she has longed for. Taking up Alexis offer of a place to stay, Sean Rowan shows up at her Carlton hotel suite. Giving in to lust, they are drawn together in heated passion. Jeff is surprised by Blake's request to have him as his campaign manager. Intrigue

programme.title: The Surrogate (1) - S08E05

Tortured by a secret from her past explaining her inability to bear children, Dana struggles about whether to tell Adam, and risk losing his love. Jeff accepts Blake's request to be his campaign manager, after learning Fallon has sent for L.B. Alexis commits Colbyco to fight Blake's proposal of saving valuable timberland as a national park, depriving her of a resource for her newspaper. Using Blake's campaign pledge of saving the acres as depriving the state of badly needed jobs, Alexis sets out to undermine his public opinion. Researching the possibility of a surrogate mother, Dana sets up a meeting for her and Adam with a prospective candidate, Karen Atkinson. All of Adam's doubts to using a surrogate vanish when he sees her. A beautiful, single mother of two gorgeous children, Dana becomes jealous of Adam's obvious interest in her. Seeking more from life than what working for Dex has to offer, Leslie accepts Alexis' job proposition. Sensing the hostility between Jeff and Fallon, Blake invites them to dinner. Sharing a terse glance, they decline his offer. Jeff retreats to the study to work on countering Alexis' viperous editorial against Blake. Working late, he gives in to Leslie's playful persuasion, accompanying her to dinn

programme.title: The Primary - S08E07
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Distraught over Blake's meteoric rise in pre-election popularity, Alexis gives in to Sean's persuasions, and he flies her off to a remote cabin on the Pacific coast of Mexico. programme.title: The Setup - S08E09
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Prodded on by Alexis' incessant questioning, Dana reluctantly explains the reason for her infertility was due to a botched abortion many years before. Suspecting Dana is manipulating Adam to selfishly benefit her own future, Alexis schemes to prevent Dana from legally becoming the mother of Adam's surrogate child. But when Fallon walks in on Leslie and Jeff innocently finishing business matters, she is convinced their marriage is over. programme.title: The Fair - S08E10
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — As Alexis' grand fair draws near, Sean assures her that all is going according to plan. Left alone with Dana while Adam and Alexis dance, Sean threatens to blackmail Dana with the truth about her abortion if she does not gather secret information on the Carringtons. After misinterpreting Sammy Jo's plea for him to not quit the team as meaning something more, Josh asks her to marry him. Devastated by her rejection, Josh reverts to his alcohol and drug addiction. programme.title: The New Moguls - S08E11
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Krystle asks Cora Van Husen to relinquish information on the scandalous video of Blake in her brothel. Though reluctant at first, Cora hands a copy of the tape over. Calling a press conference to prove the tap had been tampered with, Blake is finally vindicated. A seething Alexis vows to never give up her campaign against him. programme.title: The Spoiler - S08E12
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Following Josh Harris' drug overdose death, Sammy Jo carries a burden of guilt. Realizing her obsession to be with Steven is depriving her of an intimate relationship, Sammy Jo asks Steven to move out of her Delta Rho ranch. Steven is pressured by the press and Jeff to administer drug testing on his team. Troubled by crisis in his personal and professional life, Steven welcomes the surprise visit of his old friend, Chris Deegan. Steven is shocked by the team's decision to volunteer for the tests in order to alleviate the stress it has placed on Steven and on Blake's campaign. After Dex returns from Natumbe, Steven reprimands him and Fallon for going against his orders. Sean's amorous moves are shot down by a brooding Alexis. programme.title: The Interview - S08E13
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Following a night of lovemaking with Leslie, Sean hears a news report on Alexis' bid for governor. Seeing an opportunity to avenge his father's death, Sean returns to Alexis in order to curry favor. Alexis asks Sean to assume control of Colbyco so she can concentrate on the election. Adam turns to Karen for solace and confides his worry that the baby she's carrying will come to a bad end. Karen reassures Adam and gives him an innocent kiss which Dana witnesses and misinterprets. programme.title: Images - S08E14
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Ignoring Blake's objections, Krystle continues her investigation into Alexis' deathbed marriage to Cecil Colby. Cecil's nurse approaches Krystle and volunteers information concerning his death. Krystle learns Alexis wielded her influence over the hospital administrators to persuade Cecil's doctor to allow the highly unusual wedding. Leslie follows Sean to his father's gravesite and discovers his true identity as Joseph Aynders' son. Threatening to reveal his charade, Leslie coerces Sean to accept her as an equal partner in his scheme. Heeding Sammy Jo's advice, Dana returns to Adam. Realizing he almost her forever, Adam holds Dana in a desperate embrace. After Dana tells Adam of Sean's blackmail, he calls Sean, promising to kill him if he hurts Dana again. programme.title: The Rifle - S08E15
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Sean prepares to leave for Natumbe to finalize his deal with Harry Thrasher. Leslie convinces Sean to let her join him on the trip. Alexis tries to persuade Gerald Wilson, Cecil's personal lawyer, to work for Colbyco. Instead of helping Alexis, Gerald gives Krystle a copy of Cecil's original will. Krystle learns the will was changed soon after Cecil and Alexis were married. Krystle thinks she finally has solid evidence against Alexis. Recovering from her wounds, Alexis tells Blake she has decided to withdraw from the election. But when she becomes aware of her sudden rise in popularity, she reconsiders. Determined to unleash his frustrated sexual energy on Leslie, Sean drags her into Alexis' bedroom. Struggling against him, Leslie's bracelet falls off and rolls unseen under the bed. Unaware that Alexis has reconsidered against dropping out of the election, Sean panics. Deciding to speed his plan up, he flies to Natumbe. Thinking Sean is skimming profits off the top of the Vitron oil deal, Leslie follows him, demanding a piece of the action. Karen's husband, Jesse, shows up and tells her he never signed the final divorce papers, making them still legally married. programme.title: The Warning - S08E17
programme.desc: Drama · 1981 · TV-PG — Alexis waits for the right moment to crush Sean and Leslie's intimacy. Suspecting that Alexis knows about her and Sean's passionate rendezvous, Leslie vows to take Sean down with her if she loses her job. Outraged by her threat, Sean plants a venomous snake in her hotel room. Arriving just in time, he grabs the snake and holds it close to her, emphasizing his distaste for the game she is playing. Fearful that Jesse will complicate the legal procedures for taking custody of Karen's surrogate baby, Adam bribes him to leave town. Finding out about the bribe, Karen loses all faith in Jesse and his promise that he has changed. Realizing his mistake, Jesse gives the money back. After hearing Jesse tell Adam all he wants is Karen, Sean warns him to keep their bargain to make Adam's life a living hell by suing for custody of Karen's child. programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — The League of Heroes declares Jim an unfit superhero, and forces Jim and Peter to switch their roles. Meanwhile, Evil the Cat is trying to destroy the Earth with the help of a cursed song and two dime-store lounge singers.

programme.title: Wizard of Ooze - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Professor Monkey-for-a-Head builds a doom machine for Queen Slug-for-a-Butt that transports Jim to an alternate universe. The alternate universe has several characters from the regular universe.

programme.title: For Whom the Jingle Bell Tolls - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Queen Slug-For-A-Butt tries to enslave mankind by implanting a microchip into Santa Claus' head, brainwashing him into implanting more chips all over the universe. programme.title: Sidekicked - S01E01
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Earthworm Jim fires Peter Puppy after he let Professor Monkey-For-A-Head get away. Jim auditions new sidekicks while he attempts to rescue Princess What's-Her-Name from Psy-Crow.

programme.title: The Book of Doom - S01E02
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Due to a printing error, one of Jim's pop-up story books has the secret of universal conquest, and Evil the Cat will do anything to get it.

programme.title: Assault and Battery - S01E03
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Jim's suit malfunctions when his "Battery of the Gods" runs out of juice. He must find the Gods and get a new battery before Queen-Slug-For-A-Butt mashes Turlawk into jelly.

programme.title: Day of the Fish - S01E04
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — The League of Superheroes runs out of sugar, so Jim flies of to La Planeta de Agua to get some. Bob the Killer Goldfish takes advantage of Jim and steals his super suit so he can conquer the Earth.

programme.title: Conqueror Worm - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — A freak accident with a photocopy of Jim's face leads to the creation of Evil Jim. Jim must bust out of prison and stop Evil Jim from destroying the Turlawk shopping mall.

programme.title: Upholstered Peril - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Mysterious purple couches are turning the world's population into mindless zombies. With Peter as a mindless Zombie, Jim enlists the help of boy-genius Grayson to stop this evil plot by Professor Monkey-for-a-Head.

programme.title: Sword of Righteousness - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Jim becomes a great warrior after finding a magical sword in a vending machine sandwich. Will this help him battle Psy-Crow and his Orb of Quite Remarkable Power?

programme.title: The Egg Beater - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Jim accidentally leaves Mrs. Bleveridge's egg beater on a distant planet, so he takes her on a trip across the universe to get back the egg beater.

programme.title: Trout! - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Jim must seek the Fur-Bearin' trout and protect him from Queen-Slug-For-A-Butt's fur-powered death machine.

programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Evil the Cat releases a beast named "Rosebud" to assist him in destroying the universe. However, Rosebud is a little too mellow to go with Evil's sinister plot, even though he knows "The Great Secret of the Universe."

programme.title: Bring Me the Head of Earthworm Jim - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Professor Monkey-for-a-Head and Psy-Crow steal Jim's super suit, and Jim uses a weak duplicate to try to get it back.

programme.title: Queen What's Her Name - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Princess What's-Her-Name finally dethrones the evil Queen and takes her place as the ruler of Insectika. Unfortunately, being a stuck-up debutante is not the Princess' cup of tea.

programme.title: The Anti-Fish - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Bob the Killer Goldfish resurrects the god of all fish to help him conquer the universe. But, this evil pihranna only wants to mangle and devour "The Great Worm Spirit." Jim and Bob form an uneasy alliance to stop the fish from eating the great worm and destroying the universe.

programme.title: The Origins of Peter Puppy - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Jim has put up with Peter's monsterous alter-ego long enough, and seeks to cure him. However, the cure might turn Peter into a plain ol' dumb dog.

programme.title: Opposites Attack - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Evil Jim creates evil opposites of the Princess and Peter, which have some major flaws.

programme.title: Darwin's Nightmare - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Bob, the Killer Goldfish creates an device that sucks the "evolutionary energy" out of anything that it wraps around. Jim and Peter are made into idiots by it, and remain idiots for a large percentage of the episode.

programme.title: The Exile of Lucy - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Psy-Crow is tired of Queen Slug-For-A-Butt giving him orders, and seizes the throne of Insectika. Since Psy-Crow is an even worse ruler, Princess What's-Her-Name, Jim, Peter and Mrs. Bleveredge, must stop Psy-Crow and put the queen back on her evil throne.

programme.title: Evil in Love - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 1995 · TV-Y — Evil the Cat and Malice the Dog work together to summon The Fiend Which Dares Not Speak Its Name.

Meanwhile, Rolf enlists Kevin in jump-starting the power grid, and Edd overcomes his fear of the unsanitary sewers to conduct his own investigation.

programme.title: No Speak Da Ed - S05E07

programme.title: Cool Hand Ed - S05E08

Bored with his own house and family, Nicholas has more fun playing at a friend's house but his friend has more fun at Nicholas's house.

She works out her feelings and returns to the family. Nicholas goes steady for the first time, and finds going steady is not all fun when the girl is more interested in the bracelet he gives her than in him. Nancy gets tired of loaning money to the other Bradford children.

They pool their efforts, after competitive feelings are straightened out, to co-author his book. Nicholas gets his friend's mom a job helping with the book. Nicholas's friend is upset to learn that his mom works for Abby and not the other way around.

Fed up with the way that Tom divvies up the family's discretionary funds, Tommy takes over budgeting for it.

Though Tom disagrees, he still is able to encourage him, which brings them closer.

programme.title: A Little Triangle - S04E26
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Nicholas starts a dog-sitting service. Nancy falls in love with the 5-year-old daughter of the young widower she is dating, but doesn't fall in love with her father. Ernie can't find a date for the prom.

programme.title: Grad Night - S04E27
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Tom and Abby agree to let Tommy and a few friends have the house for a small party after graduation. Officers were called in to finally break up the party and Tom demands an explanation, thinking Tommy was being ignorant.

programme.title: And Baby Makes Nine (1) - S05E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Nicholas and Tom start boy scouts and Nicholas volunteers Tom to be the assistant scout master. Elizabeth considers moving in with her boyfriend. Susan keeps her pregnancy problems from Merle when his career takes a leap forward.

programme.title: And Baby Makes Nine (2) - S05E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — .

Joannie is promoted to sports anchor. Nicholas gets into trouble for selling peeks at Mary's medical books.

programme.title: Welcome to Memorial, Dr. Bradford - S05E04

programme.title: Generations - S05E05

programme.title: Holly - S05E06

programme.title: Bradfordgate - S05E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Tom is nominated for a political post by the governor. A political appointment for him ends up more than he can live with. Joannie goes undercover to do a story on a video dating service.

programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Abby is proud of the progress one of her students has made and invites her to the house for dinner. Jeremy falls for 16-year-old Darlene, who likes to flirt and cause trouble and he refuses to listen to Abby's advice about her.

programme.title: Second Thoughts - S05E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Joannie is tired of not getting any serious assignments at work and Abby encourages her to take a leave of absence to evaluate her career, and falls for a co-worker.

programme.title: David's Rib - S05E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Joannie involves David in the renovation of an old opera house. However, Janet is the legal counsel for the developer who wants to build low-income housing on the site.

programme.title: Vows - S05E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Tom and Abby decide to renew their marriage vows on their 3rd anniversary and they agree to let the kids handle the arrangements. David and Janet try to hide the fact that they have split up

programme.title: The Way We Were - S05E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Tommy and Ernie, back from college with a "preppy" look, run into Jill, Tommy's old girlfriend. When Jill picks Ernie over Tommy, David helps him realize that reliving the past is not the real world.

programme.title: If the Glass Slipper Fits... - S05E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Nancy's modeling career is about to take off but she needs to make an important decision as she later finds out she has to pose topless for a jeans ad.

programme.title: The Best Little Telethon in Sacramento - S05E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Joannie is chosen to organize a charity telethon and tries to get celebrities to appear on the show. She recruits the family to perform and Nicholas saves the day with his on-the-air speech and performance.

programme.title: Yet Another Seven Days in February? - S05E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — This year it's the boys' turn to meet new women. Tommy dates the daughter of a radio station owner in order to get his band some air time. Jeremy runs himself ragged trying to keep up with a beautiful sports athlete

programme.title: The Idolbreaker (1) - S05E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Just as Tommy's career is about to take off, his old girlfriend returns to tell Tommy she is pregnant after it is announced that his band has been booked for a national tour.

programme.title: The Idolbreaker (2) - S05E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Ellen tells Tommy that she doesn't want to marry him and Tommy isn't sure what he wants to do. At the last minute, they both realize it is not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Starting Over - S05E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — David and Janet consider getting back together.

programme.title: Goals - S05E21

programme.title: Father Knows Best? - S05E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 1977 · TV-G — Finally ready to be a father, Jeremy's father returns for a visit and wants to take him back to Los Angeles. David relives old memories when four of his old high school buddies return to Sacramento for their 10 year high school reunion.

programme.title: Hang-up - S01E10
programme.desc:
Action · 1972 · TV-G — John misses the end of an Adam-12 episode. A jewel thief is trapped in an air-conditioning duct. Two battered men continue their brawl in the hospital. NOTE: Features footage from the Adam-12 season 4 episode "Ambush".

programme.title: Crash - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — John and Roy bring in a football player who was tackled too hard. A burglar has a heart attack. John wants Roy to apologize for calling him "some kind of nut." programme.title: Kids - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — The station adopts a stray dog, which they name Boot. The firemen rescue a boy from a hole; he turns out to be an abused child. At a brush fire, Boot helps locate an injured hiker, then leaves with a hook and ladder truck.

programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A drunk driver rams a parked car, trapping a child inside. Chet pesters John about his Native American heritage. A sniper makes a scaffold rescue dangerous.

programme.title: Saddled - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — Dixie injures her toe. John decides he can make a lot of money by riding in rodeos. The squad goes to a hole-in-the-wall restaurant when a soda bottle explodes in a girl's face; later, they return for a gas explosion. After falling from a tree, a young boy lapses into a coma. The firemen rescue several children and a nun from a bus crash.

programme.title: Fuzz Lady - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — John falls for a lady deputy when called to treat a mugger. Items are stolen from Rampart. The firemen rescue an elderly man from a house fire. Boot returns to Station 51. A grandfather is injured by a model rocket. The paramedics rescue a boat thief trapped on a crane.

programme.title: Trainee - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A former Vietnam medic is now a paramedic trainee and constantly thinks he knows more than the doctors at Rampart. Roy, John, and the trainee interrupt a purse-snatching, rescue a man who fell down a cliff, help a woman overdosed on prescription drugs, and save a man with an insulin reaction.

programme.title: Women - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A woman journalist covers the Squad's rescues. A man trapped is in a truck under live power lines. Doctors treat a boy poisoned by wild hemlock and a girl addicted to drugs. The paramedics rescue a man trapped in a sofabed, a man wihose arm is stuck in a garbage disposal, and a man trapped in a bombed building.

programme.title: Dinner Date - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A woman almost hits a kid on a bike, who starts choking; she later has an epileptic fit. A man is shot by his father-in-law when he learns his daughter is married and pregnant. Roy tries to set John up with his wife's cousin. Three drug addicts are treated in the hospital: a woman with a gangrenous hand, a poison victim and a man showing signs of tetanus. In the field: an alcoholic, an obese man with a pacemaker, and a child whose arm is caught in a swimming pool drain.

programme.title: Musical Mania - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — After Chet cracks a joke about John playing the Squad horn, John takes up the bagpipes, trombone, and guitar. Paramedics help a gardener suffering from tetanus. A man working under his house is trapped.

programme.title: Helpful - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — Roy has an argument with his wife and Johnny tries to help. The firemen rescue a man from precarious auto wreck. A brilliant doctor's erratic behavior causes concern at the hospital. Doctors diagnose a woman's heart condition. Paramedics rescue a dog from a roof and two children lost in a rapidly flooding storm drain.

programme.desc: NCAAF 109 | Idaho Vandals at Idaho State Bengals | 6 PM ET | 11.21

Roy and John's former paramedic instructor dies, while Roy and John themselves teach a CPR class. A boy gets stuck inside a tree. A structure fire at a hotel is complicated by a cardiac victim on the third floor.

programme.title: School Days - S02E14
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A new trainee appears to be lacking in confidence; a bookcase falls on an elderly gentleman searching for a book; a baseball player is injured; an ambulance is hit by a car; a boy's chemistry set explodes in his face; students play a practical joke on a sleeping man; a man is injured at a junkyard.

programme.title: The Professor - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A man shows signs of schizophrenia for no apparent reason and the Secret Service won't give any clues. Roy has an admirer, yet John accuses him of having no charisma. The paramedics respond to a false alarm on a fireboat, and end up saving the victim of a plane crash; they also deliver a premature baby and rescue a man threatening to jump off a tall building.

programme.title: Syndrome - S02E16
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — John tries to convince Roy he has tonsillitis. An old flame of Dixie's, who is now a famous actor, is admitted to Rampart. Chet is injured during a rescue and is roomed with Roy, who has had his tonsils removed.

programme.title: Honest - S02E17
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A gas explosion results from a white lie, prompting Johnny to go on an honesty kick. At the hospital, doctors work to save a boy who is inexplicably choking to death. In the field, the paramedics rescue a teenage boy injured in a dive off a roof, and a baby and his blind grandfather trapped in a burning house.

programme.title: Seance - S02E18

A youth suffering side effects from tranquilizers is treated in the ER. The paramedics rescue a man pinned under a stack of heavy cartons and a driver trapped underwater in his car.

programme.title: Boot - S02E19
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — The firemen are puzzled by Boot's strange behavior. Meanwhile, paramedics rescue a woman whose sports car is pinned under a gas truck and investigate a series of unusual incidents in the home of a woman attempting to cook a meal for her boyfriend and his mother. An unconscious man is brought in to the hospital suffering from internal bleeding. Dr. Early deals with the victim of a curse. An explosion in a hospital lab endangers a number of workers and important records.

programme.title: Rip-Off - S02E20
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — Roy and John are accused of stealing money from a victim. A premature delivery and a blinded man result from a car crash. A perilous rescue involves a plane that might explode.

programme.title: Audit - S02E21
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — John is audited by the IRS. A man hit on the head wants to be treated by a doctor, not the paramedics. A child is rescued from a locked car. A pregnant girl has difficulty breathing. A professional medical con man shows up at Rampart. A construction worker is trapped when part of the building his crew is working on collapses, and he wants Roy to remove his leg before the rest of the building falls.

programme.title: Frequency - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — When Johnny's policeman friend is injured in a car crash, the paramedics can't reach the hospital because another squad is using the biophone. A child with a mysterious malady turns out to be drunk. Roy and John assist at the hospital when the victims of a motorcycle gang war are brought in for treatment. An artist becomes trapped in his own sculpture. A father and son are trapped in a collapse at a construction site.

programme.title: The Old Engine - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — Roy and John buy an old fire engine, and Station 51 gets a new engine. A woman overdoses on LSD and Roy tries to talk her down, leading the two paramedics on a chase to the top of a building. Brackett treats a resilient gunshot victim. A politician suffers a heart attack and the station responds to a warehouse fire.

programme.title: Alley Cat - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A stray cat decides to have her kittens on Johns bed at the station. A family is trapped in a down airplane. An old man gets his foot caught in a bear trap. A stage actress suffers an anxiety attack. A school develops a gas leak. Roy and John rescue the victim of a boating accident.

programme.title: An English Visitor - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A paramedic from England has a stint with Station 51 observing Roy and John whose rescues include a structure fire, a wild-west performer, a car accident and a man trapped in heavy machinery. The visitor saves John's life. At the hospital Dr Brackett treats a rock singer in a diabetic coma and Dr. Early has problems with a defiant nurse.

programme.title: Heavyweight - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — At a structure fire, the paramedics rescue a pregnant woman and Johnny injures his shoulder. After going into labor, the guilt-ridden mother is determined to abandon her deformed baby. Dr. Morton treats Johnny and gives him a bad time about his physical condition, sending Johnny on a fitness kick. Dr. Early treats an electrocuted child whose mother is on drugs. The son of a stabbing victim is more determined to shoot the assailant than get his father to the hospital. Roy and Johnny rescue a hanglider pilot trapped in a tree.

programme.title: Snake Bite - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — Returning from a fishing trip, Roy, John, and Chet help the victims of a car accident. On duty, after rescuing some joyriders whose car went over a cliff, John is bitten by a rattlesnake.

programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — Roy passes the Engineer's test, but accepting the promotion will mean leaving the paramedics. A bad fog leads to a multi-car accident on the San Diego Freeway. A young crash victim has a heart murmur. The paramedics have difficulty responding to an attempted suicide. At a structure fire, Johnny is injured and Roy must rescue both him and a security guard.

programme.title: Insomnia - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A boat has an explosion aboard en route to the marina. John obsesses about the lack of night runs and can't sleep. A man and his son are injured when they swerve to avoid a dog. Doctors race against time to save a marijuana smoker dying of an unidentifiable malady. A worker is pinned in a loading dock by a semi. A man child fall into a gravel pit.

programme.title: Inheritance Tax - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 1972 · TV-G — A child is trapped in a car under downed power lines. A stockbroker with heart problems is reluctant to be treated. An elderly woman that Roy and John treated the previous year dies and remembers them in her will. Dr. Early administers first aid to two young boys. A teenager loses a hamburger eating contest. The Paramedics treat a burn victim at an explosive structure fire.

programme.title: The Resurrection - S03E18

Feeling tense the day of the "Five Towns" premiere, Drama seeks relief at a massage parlor, but can't avoid Daily Variety. At the auto-body shop, Turtle meets a girl who shares his love for limited-edition sneakers, but her overbearing father hampers his game.

programme.title: The Prince's Bride - S03E19

programme.title: Adios Amigos - S03E20

programme.title: Welcome to the Jungle - S04E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-14 — A behind-the-scenes documentary about the filming of Medellín in Bogota, Colombia. Billy and Eric clash on the set about keeping the film on track. Billy becomes attracted to an actress which ends up disrupting the production. Drama tries to get Billy to give him a part in the film.

programme.title: The First Cut Is the Deepest - S04E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-14 — With the gang arriving back in America, Drama plans a party for Vince at his new condo. Ari learns that his son might not be accepted to an exclusive private school. Billy's insecurities may prevent Vince and Eric from seeing the first cut of Medellín.

programme.title: Malibooty - S04E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-14 — Billy submits Medellin to the Cannes film festival, leading Eric - who thinks the film needs work - to worry that it will get rejected. Drama rekindles an old flame, and brings Turtle in as his wingman. Vince gets in over his head in Malibu.

programme.title: Sorry, Harvey - S04E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2004 · TV-14 — Ari mistakenly mishandles a top-secret script, a mistake that lands him in jail. Drama fetes the mayor of Beverly Hills, with help from Vince. Eric has to go back on his word with Harvey Weingard, a Hollywood heavyweight, when Medellín is accepted into the Cannes Film Festival.

programme.title: Many Happy Returns - S01E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Carter and the other citizens of Eureka attend the funeral of Susan Perkins. Much to their surprise, Ms. Perkins makes a return to Eureka as a woman who is very much alive!

programme.title: Before I Forget - S01E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Jack Carter accidentally shoots Henry while suffering from short-term memory loss, meanwhile a visit from a noted scientist may hold clues into to his sudden memory loss.

programme.title: Alienated - S01E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Spencer is apparently abducted by aliens and then returned to earth the next day inside a crop circle. Also, the town is visited by the congressman whose committee is responsible for its government funding.

programme.title: Invincible - S01E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — After a lab accident, Global Dynamics researcher Carl Carlson is expelled from Eureka due to lack of results. Later, it is discovered that the accident has unlocked hidden abilities in Carl. Meanwhile, Jack does his best to avoid a physical.

programme.title: Dr. Nobel - S01E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — After Fargo and Spencer accidentally activate a doomsday device, Carter must help Dr. Irwin Thatcher, an aging scientist, to shut down the device.

programme.title: Blink - S01E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Carter investigates an unusual car accident. Meanwhile, Stark is under stress to produce results on a project.

programme.title: Right as Raynes - S01E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — When the return of Eureka's star pupil causes problems all over town, Stark is forced to make a hard choice. Carter attempts to track down Zoe who has run off with the former resident.

programme.title: Primal - S01E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Fargo invents a device that bridges the gap between computers and human brains

programme.title: Purple Haze - S01E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Strange behavior is affecting the whole town except Sheriff Carter and Zoe. The father and daughter team must find the cause while Stark makes a decision that could affect the world.

programme.title: H.O.U.S.E. Rules - S01E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — S.A.R.A.H - the artificial intelligence that runs Carter's house takes him and a group of residents hostage in an intervention to keep Carter in Eureka. Meanwhile her root program B.R.A.D activates and turns the situation deadly.

programme.title: Once in a Lifetime - S01E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Stark is given a chance to try the top-secret Artifact. Once it's tested, Eureka warps into the future and ends up in 2010, where the town is different.

programme.title: Phoenix Rising - S02E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — A man bursts into flames. Elsewhere, Carter and Deacon are reaccustoming to the timeline restored in "Once in a Lifetime."

programme.title: Try, Try Again - S02E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Carter requests Stark's help after Fargo accidentally activates a personal force field, which causes mayhem.

programme.title: Unpredictable - S02E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — An isolated deep freeze trigger causes a chain reaction of sudden weather changes in Eureka.

programme.title: Games People Play - S02E04
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — After receiving a hit to the head, Carter finds that he is in a parallel Eureka. He discovers that the residents of the parallel Eureka are disappearing.

programme.title: Duck, Duck Goose - S02E05
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Space debris threatens Eureka's existence after it accumulates into a large cloud. Carter investigates in an effort to avert potential disaster.

programme.title: Noche de Sueños - S02E06
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — A toxic spill seems to cause Eureka's residents to share their dreams. Initially the situation is amusing, but turns dire after the dream sharing is discovered to have a lethal attribute. The situation becomes more complicated, when Carter finds out that the spill is not the cause.

programme.title: Family Reunion - S02E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — A man who turns out to be Fargo's grandfather has been cryogenically frozen for 50 years. He is awakened from his slumber by accident with no recollection of how he was frozen. In addition to that, it seems that he is the father of lots of technologies at Eureka.

programme.title: E=MC...? - S02E08
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — An experiment about the big bang theory seems to be the cause for Eureka's finest to become dumber and dumber, including everyone involved in the experiment. When it comes to the verge of destroying Global Dynamics, the fate of the town lies in the hands of Jack Carter and the team of scientists he assembles, amongst them the newest member of the town, an anti-social genius.

programme.title: Sight Unseen - S02E09
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Strange happenings and spreading radiation at Global Dynamics lead to speculations that an abandoned research project concerning invisibility might have been revived. When Sheriff Carter accidentally becomes involved, the effects of invisibility threaten his life.

programme.title: God is in the Details - S02E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Zoe and her friends lose their voices, but whatever is causing the symptoms has an even worse effect on Allison and her only hope comes from an unusual source.

programme.title: Maneater - S02E11
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Eureka's air-conditioning system develops a fault, causing sexually tense situations, when the female residents suddenly become attracted to Carter due to bacteria.

programme.title: All That Glitters - S02E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — The town along with its residents mysteriously start to deconstruct. The prime suspect is an artist who couldn't get along with Stark when he was working at Global Dynamics.

programme.title: A Night at Global Dynamics - S02E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Carter and Stark must work together as an aggressive virus is sweeping across Eureka, while Kevin's life is in danger.

programme.title: What About Bob? - S03E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Sheriff Carter and Allison investigate the disappearance of a scientist from a sealed biosphere. Meanwhile, "The Fixer" attempts to make Eureka's ventures more profitable.

programme.title: Best in Faux - S03E03

programme.title: I Do Over - S03E04

programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — A mysterious "superhero" who can walk through walls is causing a ruckus in Eureka. Meanwhile, Zoe and her friends become stranded with Zane Donovan in an abandoned subterranean facility.

programme.title: Here Come the Suns - S03E07
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — The town's mayoral race is disrupted when Zoe's science partner inadvertently causes a second sun to appear over Eureka.

programme.title: From Fear to Eternity - S03E08

programme.title: Welcome Back, Carter - S03E09

programme.title: Your Face or Mine? - S03E10
programme.desc: Adventure · 2006 · TV-PG — Deputy Lupo stands in as the acting sheriff while Carter undergoes his annual physical, but she's not acting like herself.

programme.title: Insane in the P-Brane - S03E11

programme.title: It's Not Easy Being Green - S03E12

programme.title: Everybody Hates Mr. Levine - S04E11
programme.desc:
Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — When Rochelle orders a copy of her birth certificate, she realizes that she is actually one year younger than she thought she was and decides to start living her life with a new, younger attitude. After a complete stranger helps Chris to safety during a city-wide blackout, Chris decides to repay the older man by getting him out to meet new friends.
Meanwhile, Greg feels like he has no identity after realizing that everyone at school knows him only as "Chris and Greg."

programme.title: Everybody Hates Varsity Jackets - S04E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — Chris and Greg decide to join the wrestling team to earn a varsity jacket in order to impress the ladies. Meanwhile, Rochelle attempts to lose weight by drinking a popular weight-loss drink which gives Julius a money-saving idea and Tonya jeopardizes Drew's all-girl singing group.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Fake IDs - S04E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — In order to attend an age-restricted concert, Chris and Greg try to get themselves a fake ID. Elsewhere, Rochelle plans Julius' surprise party, and Drew tries returning a pair of faulty X-ray vision glasses he bought in the mail.

programme.title: Everybody Hates PSATs - S04E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — Rochelle inadvertently prevents Chris from "cramming" for an upcoming PSAT test by taking the family out to a social event. Knowing a good score will help him get into college, Chris resorts to cheating...

programme.title: Everybody Hates Boxing - S04E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — Coach Thurman spots Caruso bullying Chris and suggests he take up boxing to defend himself. Meanwhile, Julius has a new set of problems when he suspects Rochelle of adultery and catches the eye of a female neighbor...

programme.title: Everybody Hates Lasagna - S04E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — Chris reluctantly agrees to hide away some marijuana for a fleeing crook, and now must find someplace to store it before he gets in trouble. Meanwhile, Peaches helps Rochelle learn a new computer system at the beauty salon.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Spring Break - S04E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — While test driving a car, Chris accidentally hits Greg. Greg ends up in a hospital for a broken leg. Since Greg's parents are out of town, Rochelle drops her vacation plans to take care of him, which leaves Julius to entertain the kids at the shore where it usually rains each day.

programme.title: Everybody Hates the Car - S04E18
programme.desc:
Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — After Chris gets his driver's license, Rochelle and Julius give him permission to buy a car, but when the car is stolen and vandalized Chris realizes owning a car is a huge responsibility.
While looking for her secret stash of cigarettes, Rochelle comes across Julius' hidden racing form.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Back Talk - S04E19
programme.desc:

programme.title: Everybody Hates Sausage - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — When Julius buys a big crate of sausage, he makes everyone eat it with every meal. But Tonya refuses to, causing friction between the pair. While at school, Chris is sentenced to 3 days of detention after a rumour goes round about him beating up the schoo

programme.title: Everybody Hates Fat Mike - S01E05
programme.desc:
Comedy · 2005 · TV-PG — Chris lets a neighbourhood kid ride his bike, despite Julius's warnings, and he takes off with it.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Halloween - S01E06
programme.desc:

programme.desc:

programme.desc: Adventure · 2015 · TV-PG — In this episode, Josh Gates explores the remains of an American ship sunk by a Nazi U-boat during WWII. The quest takes a thrilling turn as he teams up with shark expert Tristan Guttridge, who introduces a groundbreaking approach: using sharks as underwater spies to uncover the wreck. This innovative strategy promises to shed new light on the shipwreck and the events surrounding its demise decades ago.

programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Join Action Bronson as he tours NYC to taste some of the BEST COFFEE known to man or woman.

programme.title: Rare Cheese Tastings and Strength Training at the Rap Concert with Action Bronson and The Alchemist - S06E03
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Join Action Bronson and The Alchemist as they stop in NYC while on tour to partake in a rare cheese tasting backstage and they enjoy a burger from SMASHED in the Lower East Side.

programme.title: 2nd annual FTD block party in Brooklyn - S07E01
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — The united nations of food…. an ethnic carnival. Action Bronson unites with L'Industrie Pizza , The Fortunato Brothers, Pizzeria Clementina, and The Mahendro Brothers to bring pizza, kebabs, chicken wings, cannolis and more amazing food to the streets of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Best Cannoli in New York City with Action Bronson - S07E02
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action Bronson continues his never ending quest to learn how to cook and bake and everything. This time we are in Brooklyn at Fortunato Brothers Bakery to learn how the best cannoli in New York City are made. Action's guide is Biagio Fortunato, a second generation pasticere and co-owner of the bakery. Bronson starts off with an espresso and a deliziosa, before trying his hand at rolling out the dough for the shells. After Action, Biagio, and the crew finish frying the cannoli shells, Bronson unveils his special flavor cannoli cream. Enjoy.

programme.title: The Never Ending Top Dishes of NYC - S07E03
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action Bronson kicks off his Never Ending Top Ten with a visit to three of New York City's best restaurants. The day starts off at Frenchette in TriBeCa for soft scrambled eggs, or brouillade as the French call it, with escargot. Then we head to Greenwich Village for seared tuna fat hand rolls with Thai chilis and scallions at Shuko. The only possible way to top this is sit down with the owner of Don Peppe in Ozone Park, Queens for the best baked clams you have ever had in your life. Enjoy!

programme.title: Rare Brazillian Beef at a Mom and Pop Butcher Shop - S07E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action Bronson treats the people of Long Island to an impromptu barbecue on the sidewalk. Bronson had asked his friends at Babylon Village Meat Market to track down a rare cut of beef called Cupim, the muscle on the back of Zebu cow, so he could make his first attempt at grilling the said piece of meat. While the grill is hot, Action's host at the butcher shop breaks out a wide array of dry-aged steaks for the feast. We even see Bronson freestyle a kebab on a chicken rotisserie skewer, to the delight of the many onlookers. Enjoy!

programme.title: The Never Ending Top Dishes of NYC Part 2 - S07E05
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action Bronson takes on a deeply personal food tour of some of the best off the beaten path restaurants in New York City. First up, Kew Gardens Chicken. Action has been eating here since he was a teenager and it still stands up. The next is a new spot on the Bronson list, but it holds the title for satisfying soulful food. The restaurant is called Ix, and it specializes in Guatemalan food, but with an international twist set in Brooklyn. We then head back to Queens, and feast at the incomparable Merguez and Frites. You have never experienced a mix grill, stewed chicken, and sandwiches like this in your life. Enjoy!

programme.title: The Never Ending Top Dishes of NYC Part 3 - S07E06
programme.desc:
Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — In Part 3 of Action Bronson's Never Ending Top 10 series, Nick Baglivo of L'Industrie Pizza joins him. In the episode, Bronson starts in Corona Queens at La Cabaña for chicharron de Pollo and boiled yuca. Then we move around the corner onto Roosevelt ave for some al fresco dining under the 7 train at Tlayuda Oaxaqueña Sr. San Pablo for tlayuda de cecina and some cafe de olla(Mexican spiced coffee.) Finally, to wrap up this unforgettable day, Action takes Nick to Michael Solomonov's incredible meat skewer restaurant Laser Wolf. Solomonov and his chef Mike Mayo treat Action and Nick to the whole menu. ENJOY!
P.S. Laser Wolf has the best French Fries in the world.

programme.title: Action Bronson Eats Boston’s Best Pizza & Kebabs + Sneaker Drop Party - S07E07
programme.desc:
Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action Bronson had some things to take care of surrounding the release of his first sneaker collaboration with New Balance in Boston. So Action took advantage by visiting the much-lauded Santarpio's Pizza in East Boston.
Don't let the name fool you; although the pizza is some of the best in the North East, the lamb and sausage bbq skewers seal the deal in making this place a must-visit every time Bronson's in Boston. Besides the pizza and kebabs, we also get an inside look at Action's creative process inside the New Balance offices. Enjoy!
P.S. The sneaker cookies were made by Eat Good NYC @eatgoodnyc www.EGNYC.com

programme.title: Champagne and New York City’s Best Burger with Action Bronson - S07E08
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — In this episode, Action Bronson visits his old friend Billy Durney at the Red Hook Tavern. Billy and his team treat Action to everything from Cosmo's to Steak Au Poivre made with Cambodian peppercorns. We also hear the story of the restaurant's legendary cheeseburger that took Billy eight months to perfect while sipping on incredible wines.

programme.title: Action Bronson Tries NYC’s Newest Pizza Obsession - S07E09
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — In this episode, Action visits acclaimed chef Wylie Dufresne at his newly opened pizzeria, Stretch. After Action reminisces about a dessert he once had at one of Wylie’s previous restaurants, he is treated to a smorgasbord of modern pizzeria delights. The highlights were the Ploughman pizza, the potato chip salad, and the incredible soft-serve sundae.

programme.title: Feasting in New York with Action Bronson, Marlon "Chito" Vera, The Alchemist & Larry June - S07E10
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — SoHo’s Best Middle-Eastern Food . In this episode of FTD, Action Bronson is reunited with his old eating pal, The Alchemist. The notoriously picky producer is joined by his latest musical collaborator Larry June. Together they have been on a little press run for their latest album, and Action invited them to try out the pop-up from the much sought-after site-specific cooking outfit LEV. If this weren't enough, the bantam-weight UFC sensation, Marlon "Chito" Vera, showed up with Action to help take down copious amounts of incredible food and wine.

programme.title: Discovering NYC Food Secrets Under The 7 Train - S07E11
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Have you ever wondered where the best Thai food, chicken samosa, and Chinese-Peruvian BBQ can be had? Well, if you are looking for this and more in NYC, get on the 7 train after watching this video. Action Bronson lays it out real nice, keeping three incredible spots within a one-mile radius in the world’s borough, Queens. Enjoy.

programme.title: Multiculturalism at Its Best - S01E01
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — In the series premiere, Action Bronson makes stops in Washington D.C., Atlanta and Miami, where he eats at one of the most popular restaurants in the country, tastes authentic southern barbecue and learns to make a bay scallop and papaya dish.

programme.title: New Friends in Strange Places - S01E02
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — A tour of the Pacific Northwest spotlights fresh salmon, grass-fed lamb and legal marijuana.

programme.title: Culinary Athleticism - S01E03
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Handball court pizza parties, Guyanese juice spots, the best falafel in NYC, and an impromptu flute performance at a Pakistani restaurant make this the best episode of food television shot in New York City.

programme.title: The Foundation - S01E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — With hyper-local meat centric dining in the UK, deli sandwiches in East New York, and Thai food in Amsterdam, FTD proves it is in a league of it's own.

programme.title: The Showdown in Lamb Alley - S01E05
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action and crew decide to head to Morocco. Inspired by lamb and leather, they head out to the markets to find the most succulent tagines, artisanal giraffe dolls, and instruments.

programme.title: Sidelined in the Yukon - S01E06
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — A concert in Alaska, fly fishing, eating with an Eskimo, and buying as much Carhartt gear as possible. Also, some emergency surgery.

programme.title: Long Time Friends - S01E07

programme.title: Can't Forget Paris - S01E08
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — The season ends with two sold out shows in Paris, between which Action and company visit a cultural heritage site, fly in a wind tunnel, and eat the best veggie burger in the world.

programme.title: In the Garden, To the Moon - S02E01
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — In Australia, Action and Mehyem find simple Italian fare in Melbourne; develop an appetite for fried chicken and natural wine in Sydney; Bronson cooks with renowned chef Ben Shewry.

programme.title: The Other City by the Sea - S02E02
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Where does Action go to dive for razor fish, learn a new wagyu beef recipe, and cruise in a drop-top Cadillac? The answer: the most isolated city in the world- Perth!

programme.title: My Fair Bagel - S02E03
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action makes his mighty return to Auckland, introducing Meyhem to his favorite burger truck. Between bagels and pork shanks, he debuts a new song in a sweaty strip club.

programme.title: The Gang's All Here - S02E04
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — The whole crew is reunited in Hawaii in a celebration of short ribs and boogie boarding.

programme.title: Ancient Feelings Stirred - S02E05
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action travels to Barcelona, where he performs at a music festival. Later, the crew learn Flamenco; and Meyhem and Action face off in a paella cook-off.

programme.title: A Love Like Wine - S02E06
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — The crew travel to Copenhagen for Roskilde Festival. Later, Action makes an octopus taco; Meyhem cooks fish; and Al's on his best behaviour.

programme.title: The Caesar Brothers - S02E07

programme.title: Durag vs. Bronco - S02E08
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Action shoots a video featuring Big Body Bes on a white horse; when not engaged in equine rap scenarios the two eat their way from West Hollywood to Watts.

programme.title: A New York Winter Fling - S02E09
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Let Action Bronson show you how to eat on a winter's day. On this episode the FTD crew take us on a culinary world tour while never leaving NYC.

programme.title: Bay Area Romp - S02E10
programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — Legendary Soul Food, Explosive Chicken, A Love Filled Burmese Restaurant, inventive California Cuisine, and Beer. We got it all on this episode of FTD.

programme.desc: Documentary · 2016 · TV-MA — The crew hits up everything from Michelin starred restaurants to Polish Festivals.

programme.title: Queens: A Food Thug's Paradise - S03E01

programme.title: A Royal Pain - S04E12

However, one evening when he takes her out to a dance, he leaves with another woman. This leads Blair to contemplate breaking off this "controlling" relationship with a man she claims to "love".

programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Jo has become close friends with her English teacher, Gail, even inspiring Jo to think about becoming a teacher herself. programme.title: Let's Party! - S04E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Tootie is excited about the impending visit of her brother Marshall, however is stay becomes one of fear when he invites the girls to a college party where beer is being served. programme.title: Best Sister (1) - S04E17

That fact is something Blair has a hard time dealing with. Meanwhile, Jo arrives back early after the car breaks down. She later has a spiritual experience and decides she too wants to become a nun.

programme.title: Best Sister (2) - S04E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Blair, Natalie and Tootie can't believe that Jo wants to become a nun and Blair accuses Meg of recruiting. programme.title: Guess What's Coming to Dinner - S04E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Mrs. Garrett is expecting a visit from a French chef whom she once was an understudy for. programme.title: Who's on First? - S04E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Natalie begins dating an attractive guy and begins spending all her time with him, which leaves Tootie out in the cold.

programme.title: Help from Home - S04E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Jo has been accepted at Langley College along with Blair but doesn't tell anyone that she has since she doesn't plan on going due to her and her parents financial situation. However, when she takes a trip home for the weekend, she learns that her entire family found out the truth and are now counting on her to do well.

programme.title: Take My Finals, Please - S04E22

They soon find out that studying is going to be hard with so many distractions, including Blair and Jo's fears of the future in college and Natalie's fear of an upcoming Chemistry exam in which she must memorize the atomic symbols.

programme.title: Graduation (1) - S04E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Blair and Jo share a common feeling of disdain toward their graduation from Eastland.

programme.title: Brave New World (1) - S05E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Jo and Blair have a hard time adjusting to college.

programme.title: Brave New World (2) - S05E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Ms Garret decides to re-open an abandoned department store and turn it into her own.

programme.title: Gamma Gamma or Bust - S05E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Blair is dying to join the sorority that's she pledging and she volunteers Mrs. Garrett to be the caterer for a rush party. However, when Mrs. Garrett begins making Mexican before consulting Blair, who wanted Chinese, Blair fires her without a second thought.

programme.title: Just My Bill - S05E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Jo's been dating, Bill, a plain guy who attends the same college as she does, but when she learns that he's a rich kid, Jo becomes resentful and angry that he didn't tell her the whole truth about himself.

programme.title: The Halloween Show - S05E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — A strange man tells the girls that years ago a murder occurred in the shop. Later, when the girls see Mrs. Garret with a knife they assume that she's possessed by the murderer's spirit and is out to get them.

programme.title: I'm Dancing as Fast as I Can - S05E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — For a birthday surprise, the girls take Mrs. Garrett to a club featuring male exotic dancers, but the one who's in for the real surprise is Blair.

programme.title: The Second Time Around - S05E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Jo begins seeing sparks between her divorced parents and immediately hopes they get back together. However, her hopes quickly become dashed when she learns that her father is planning to marry another woman.

programme.title: The Christmas Show - S05E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — The holidays bring joy to the girls when they all plan on going home for Christmas but when Jo's mother temporarily moves to Miami, Jo is stuck in Peekskill.

programme.title: The Chain Letter - S05E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — While Mrs. Garrett frets over an inspection by the Board of Health, the girls get involved with a chain letter and ignore their responsibilities.

programme.title: Crossing the Line - S05E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — Natalie starts dating a black guy, and Tootie thinks that Natalie hates him because of his color.

programme.title: Jazzbeau - S06E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 1979 · TV-PG — The death of a famous jazz singer brings back fond memories to Tootie and Natalie, who got to know him at a resort hotel where he worked as a waiter.

programme.title: Please Don't Feed The Turners - S08E10

programme.title: Lights Out - S08E11

Little does Timmy know, that when his godparents are kept in the dark for longer than eight hours, they become "Scary Fairies" and turn on their godchild.

programme.title: Dad Overboard - S08E12
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — After Mr. Turner gets lost while looking for their hotel and land on a deserted island, he struggles to make a boat to save his family, and to prove his masculinity he doesn't let anyone help him. Timmy wishes for relaxation items, (hammock,Ipod,Club sandwiches,etc).Meanwhile, Poof finds a nuclear bomb in the sand and Cosmo activates it, putting the Turners' life at risk.

programme.title: Old Man And The C- - S08E13
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — When Mr. Turner reveals he dropped off school at 5th grade, he attempts to graduate from Dimmsdale Elementary School to make his son proud.

programme.title: Balance of Flour - S08E14
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — Centuries ago, the Anti-Fairies and Fairies started an annual bake-off to determine which species gets godchildren, this year, Jorgen von Strangle's recipe is at risk, and Anti-Cosmo and Anti-Wanda are determined to make sure they make Timmy their godchild by stealing the recipe and cheating the fairies out of the competition.

programme.title: Poltergeeks - S08E15
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — Timmy has Cosmo, Wanda, and Poof pose as ghosts so that his parents can re-live their glory days as ghostbusters.

programme.title: Beach Blanket Bozos - S08E16
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — During a trip to Hawaii, Timmy wishes that his parents were the best surfers ever, but that wish starts a wish limbo, in which they won't stop fighting until only one prevails as best surfer ever in Hawaii.

programme.title: When Losers Attack - S08E17
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — Timmy Turner’s enemies collaborate to form the League of Super Evil Revenge Seekers (L.O.S.E.R.S.) in order to annihilate him. When the Fairy-clipse, a rare astronomical event that happens every million years, prevents Cosmo and Wanda from using their magic to save him, Timmy is forced to outwit the L.O.S.E.R.S. himself.

programme.title: Meet the OddParents - S08E18
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — Mom and Dad have finally realize that Timmy has fairy godparents! The question now is: How long can they all keep Jorgen Von Strangle in the dark so that he won't take Wanda, Cosmo and Poof away forever?

programme.title: Fairly Odd Pet - S09E01
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — Timmy adopts a mischievous and magical fairy dog named Sparky. However, owning a fairy dog proves to be a much bigger challenge than Timmy could have ever predicted.

programme.title: Dinklescouts! - S09E02
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — Timmy wishes Mr. Dinkleberg would replace Dad as Squirrely Scout leader.

programme.title: I Dream of Cosmo - S09E03
programme.desc: Adventure · 2001 · TV-Y — Cosmo loses his memory and mistakenly thinks he's supposed to grant wishes for Timmy's father.

programme.title: Colt's Angels - S01E05
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt is sent to the Mohave Desert to bring back a biker wanted for drug dealing, rape, and assault. He infiltrates the biker's club and competes with them in difficult stunts.

programme.title: The Human Torch - S01E06
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt is sent to a country town to pick up an arson suspect. The townspeople of Federalsburg, and the suspect's mother, insist he is dead and buried.

programme.title: Japanese Connection - S01E07
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Pursuing the Rio Brothers, two small time crooks, to Hawaii, Colt and Howie find that the pair have trod on the toes of a dangerous Japanese syndicate.

programme.title: No Way Out - S01E08
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — In Las Vegas at a cycle show, Shecky turns himself in to Big Jack and tells her he needs a bodyguard. Reluctantly, Colt takes the assignment.

programme.title: License to Kill (1) - S01E09
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt and company go to Hawaii to catch a man who turns out to be trying to stop an assassination. Things get mixed up and Colt becomes a target.

programme.title: License to Kill (2) - S01E10
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt and company go to Hawaii to catch a man who turns out to be trying to stop an assassination. Things get mixed up and Colt becomes a target.

programme.title: Goin' for It! - S01E11
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — A trio of small time crooks are using cars to smuggle jewels out of the country and hit a snag when one of them sells the cars to Howie to smash up for the movie.

programme.title: The Adventures of Ozzie and Harold - S01E12
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Harold had a run-in with his brother and now faces life as Ozzie, a homeless man. He witnesses a murder and becomes a target.

programme.title: Soldiers of Misfortune - S01E13
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt and Howie 'join up', as they go undercover to try and nail a master criminal who is a mercenary trainee. In the process, they meet a woman journalist with her own reasons for pursuing this story.

programme.title: Ready, Aim...Die! - S01E14
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — A woman says she must find her brother, a gambler with a big debt to a bookie who's sworn to make an example of him, before a hit-man does.

programme.title: Ladies on the Ropes - S01E15
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt tries to help a couple of pro-wrestling girls win a big championship match by disrupting the plans of their scheming manager and an avaricious team owner who wants their contracts. Colt's plans also involve Howie entering the arena as 'Handsome Howard'.

programme.title: The Snow Job - S01E16
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — In Aspen, a politician's wife tells Colt that she shot her husband in self-defense, but he is saying he did it himself.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Town? - S01E17
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — With Colt injured and laid up from a stunt accident, he reluctantly agrees to let Howie and Jody take the case of bringing in a criminal from a small rural town. The case is made more difficult by the fact that the wanted man is related to a local bigwig.

programme.title: Child's Play - S01E18
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt is sent to bring in a gambler who is to testify against the mob, only to find he is on the run from mobsters out to silence him, and ends up looking after his fiesty, young daughter, Libby.

programme.title: Charlie - S01E19
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt and the gang are in Las Vegas to attend a stuntman convention, where Colt meets up with old friend Charlie, a female stuntman whose brother is being hunted down by some heavies after becoming mixed up in a fraudulent scheme.

programme.title: Three for the Road - S01E20
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — A pretty jewel thief hops off to Mexico with Colt and his friends, joined by insurance investigator Kay Faulkner, hot on her trail.

programme.title: The Silent Partner - S01E21
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — To avoid being arrested for fraud, a country western singer frames his chauffeur for the murder of his ghost writer.

programme.title: Scavenger Hunt - S01E22
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Some naval officers were involved in a $5 million robbery in Hawaii and they are looking for the man holding the money. For some reason, they just can't find the money.

programme.title: Bail and Bond - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt and Howie are in Rio de Janeiro filming stunts for a spy movie, and find themselves involved in a real life James-Bond-style adventure when Terri assigns them to bring back a bail-jumper involved with money laundering.

programme.title: The Ives Have It - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Terri sends Colt to Aruba to bring back a burglar, but it turns out she is one of twins and had a good reason for the breaking and entering. But which one did it?

programme.title: Colt's Outlaws (1) - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — While shooting on location, Colt and his mentor Dan Wild go drinking and when they come out of the bar, the sheriff arrests Wild for being drunk. The next day, Colt learns that while in custody, Wild shot someone. Colt returns to L.A. and learns that the mayor of the town is crooked. He also finds out that the governor is trying to build a case against the mayor, but so far the only person willing to testify against him was the man Wild killed. Obviously Wild was set up. Colt then comes up with a plan. He organizes some of the stunt men who are Wild's friends, and they pose as bikers and go down to the town and tear it up.

programme.title: Colt Breaks Out (2) - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — After breaking Dan out of jail and with Mary who witness the murder Littlefield engineered, Colt goes back to L.A. to vindicate Dan. But when Littlefield learns that Mary's a witness against him, he calls someone in the National Guard and they capture Howie and the stunt men who were making their way back to L.A. So Colt can't let Mary testify, and with no other choice, he goes back to Littlefield with Dan and Mary to break Howie and the others. But Littlefield is ready for him.

programme.title: Mighty Myron - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt and Howie visit the circus to bring in a jewelry thief, only to find him murdered and an orangutan seemingly responsible. With the primate on the run, Colt and Howie must track him down and prove his innocence before he is put to sleep.

programme.title: Reluctant Traveling Companion - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt is sent to bring a woman back from the East Coast. The problem is that the woman is not going easy and refuses to go by plane. So they go by train, and she continues to be disruptive. And right next to them is Richard Burton. And it seems that someone wants her dead.

programme.title: A Piece of Cake - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Terri sends Colt to New York City to bring in a bail jumper, only for Colt to find himself stepping into the middle of an FBI stakeout to try and nail a syndicate member -- via any means necessary!

programme.title: Hell on Wheels - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — When Colt is sent in to investigate a criminal at a roller derby team, Jody is persuaded to go undercover and join the skating stars to try and root out the real culprit.

programme.title: How Do I Kill Thee...Let Me Count the Ways - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — A man is tricked into supplying computer tapes by using a fake auto accident and telling him the other victim died, thus making him a murderer. Two bumbling detectives take the case.

programme.title: Win One for the Gipper??? - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt's cousin and a friend are kidnapped by some army men who want to have a winning football team.

programme.title: Happy Trails - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt is filming stunts for a new Roy Rogers film. Howie finds himself accused of theft when he buys a car to be used for filming, not realizing it's stolen. Colt tries to uncover the con-men's auto-theft racket.

programme.title: Manhunter - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — Colt is sent off to Mexico to bring back two jewel thieves. An undercover private detective has the same objective.

programme.title: The Further Adventures of Ozzie and Harold - S02E13

programme.desc: Action · 1981 · TV-PG — When a jewel thief has plastic surgery and takes a cruise to recover, Colt and insurance investigator Kay Faulkner join the cruise along with Howie and Jody, who pretend to be an invalid and his nurse. Now if only they could identify the thief.
