programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — A year after Simon started the Annihilatrix, Killface is working on getting elected president. The Annihilatrix did the complete opposite of what Killface intended and pushed the Earth three feet away from the sun, completely ruling out global warming.

programme.title: The Opposition - S02E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The documentary crew catches up with Xander, now living in his own cardboard boxes.

programme.title: The Issues - S02E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface and Xander Crews compete to be better than each other to get elected president.

programme.title: The Image Problem - S02E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — To broaden their votes, Xander and Killface go to the North Fork Duck Hunt and get lost together.

programme.title: The Miracle - S02E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — In the aftermath of the latest assassination attempt, Killface finds religion and risks alienating the various groups that have supported him. In the middle of this, he learns a secret about someone very close to him.

programme.title: The Middle - S02E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface recovers from the latest assassination attempt, which was not Val this time. Xander continues to try to contact Fred Dryer, but his campaign may be derailed.

programme.title: The Debate (1) - S02E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface goes over the upcoming debate with Dottie and Wendell looks into alternative campaign funds. Awesome X finds himself a prisoner along with Ronnie on-board Xcalibur.

programme.title: The Debate (2) - S02E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — While Killface prepares for the Presidential debate, Xander makes a few stops with Ronnie before he arrives at the debate. Both Xander and Killface come to realize that neither of them are qualified or allowed to run for the Presidency due to discrepancies they've both overlooked. Killface decides to follow up on his original plan to destroy the world.

programme.title: A Take on 'Hooper' - S02E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — With the Annihalatrix in her possession, Sinn/Hooper forms the Sisterhood of Chaos and declares herself ruler of the world. But this idea does not sit well with others...

programme.title: Wendell Goes Undercover Again - S02E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface and Simon attempt to repair the burnt couplings on the Annihilatrix, while Stan and Taquil attempt an escape from their shot-down plane. Sinn and Val ask Watley to kill Antagone (due to increasing strains on their relationships with Antagone). Meanwhile, Wendell is sent by Xander to kill the giant ant baby. Both Wendell and Watley inadvertently fall in love with Antagone.

programme.title: Cody Gains a Namesake - S02E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Valerie kills Sinn and blames Wendell and Arthur. Xander learns he has an illegitimate daughter. She comes to visit after her mother dies from cancer. Xander bribes her never to contact him again. Wendell decapitates Arthur when he tries to propose to Antagone. Antagone finally gives birth to her monster ant baby, which then eats her head.

programme.title: Differences are Put Slightly Aside - S02E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Wendell rides Cody 2 around town... and he fornicates with it along the way. Everybody else races to the Annihilatrix while the Deceptacles make a stew out of Watley's decapited body in the motel swimming pool. Finally, Killface's alien brethren (and his mother) arrive to inquire about how the Earth has not yet been annihilated.

programme.title: Meet Killface - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface, supervillain extraordinaire and loving father, has just begun his quest to destroy the world by smashing it into the sun using the Annihilatrix, a massive jet engine. However, due to construction cost overruns, he is unable to strike terror into the hearts of the populace about his nefarious scheme, and must rely on a direct mailing campaign.

programme.title: Meet Awesome-X - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Billionaire tycoon Xander Crews (and his alter-ego, superhero Awesome-X) have a problem: billionaire tycoon Xander Crews has frittered away the (literally) billions of dollars amassed by his murdered parents. So he mortgages the company to produce a line of Awesome-X action figures. The only catch is, he needs a supervillain doll...

programme.title: Pimp My Revenue - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — In what can only be termed a colossal misunderstanding, the creators of Frisky Dingo somehow got involved in producing an episode that revolves almost entirely around the (quite lengthy) list of options available on the sporty new tC from Scion. Their tagline is "It's what moves you." You can learn more about the new Scion tC at scion.com.

programme.title: XPO - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface and his company attempt to win the Xander Crews Inventors Expo competition.

programme.title: Kidnapped! - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface, desperate for $12 billion to complete the Annihilatrix, decides to kidnap billionaire tycoon Xander Crews. But things quickly go south for our villain, starting just about the same time that Phil vomits in the minivan, and finishing up when plucky reporter Grace Ryan falls into drums full of super-intelligent, radioactive waste-covered ants.

programme.title: Emergency Room - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The entire Dingo gang, grievously injured in the collapse of the Annihilatrix's catwalk, have all ended up in the same emergency room. Killface muffs hitting on plucky reporter Grace Ryan, and then has an unpleasant interaction with a representative from his insurance company. Also, Xander Crews is nowhere to be found! Dun-dunnnn!

programme.title: Meet Antagone - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — So, come to find out, plucky reporter Grace Ryan is experiencing some pretty unpleasant side effects from falling into those drums full of super-intelligent, radioactive waste-covered ants: she sometimes turns into the ultra-wicked-bad supervillainess Antagone! And yeah, it's not the cleverest name in the world. But man, get a load of that rack...

programme.title: Blind Faith - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface is... oh! Killface got blinded when Antagone spit formic acid into his eyes. So now he's blind. And billionaire tycoon Xander Crews... oh! He got kidnapped by these robots called the Xtacles who work for billionaire tycoon Xander Crews' alter-ego, super- hero Awesome-X. But then he escaped. And so now he and Killface are best friends.

programme.title: The Odd Couple - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface and billionaire tycoon Xander Crews (operating under the nom de guerre of Barnaby Jones) are now roommates and bestest buds. But their friendship - even though it's based entirely on a lie - will be tested to the limit when Simon runs away with billionaire tycoon Xander Crews' robot pants. And also when Killface blinds Barnaby.

programme.title: Flowers for Nearl - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — The Xtacles, under threat of death at the hands of Stan (who, although we haven't mentioned him yet, is in just about every episode, and who is also impersonating superhero Awesome-X) have to find a replacement hostage for billionaire tycoon Xander Crews. Their search - somewhat predictably - leads them to Nearl, the local retarded wino guy.

programme.title: The Grate Escape - S01E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface (still blind) and billionaire tycoon Xander Crews (still blind, still naked, still doing business as Barnaby Jones) escape from the sweatshop to rescue Simon from the evil clutches of master criminal Torpedo Vegas. Down there in Chinatown. And everybody else winds up down there too, somehow, because of the death rabbit fights. And all.

programme.title: Penultimate Fighting - S01E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Equipped only with a map, a bag of radishes, and brand new eyes goggling about in their heads, Killface and billionaire tycoon Xander Crews (aka Barnaby Jones) attempt to rescue Simon from the evil clutches of master criminal Torpedo Vegas. Who instantly captures them. And then forces them to fight... to the death! Could this be the end?!

However, due to construction cost overruns, he is unable to strike terror into the hearts of the populace about his nefarious scheme, and must rely on a direct mailing campaign.

programme.title: Meet Awesome-X - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Billionaire tycoon Xander Crews (and his alter-ego, superhero Awesome-X) have a problem: billionaire tycoon Xander Crews has frittered away the (literally) billions of dollars amassed by his murdered parents. So he mortgages the company to produce a line of Awesome-X action figures. The only catch is, he needs a supervillain doll...

programme.title: Pimp My Revenue - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — In what can only be termed a colossal misunderstanding, the creators of Frisky Dingo somehow got involved in producing an episode that revolves almost entirely around the (quite lengthy) list of options available on the sporty new tC from Scion. Their tagline is "It's what moves you." You can learn more about the new Scion tC at scion.com.

programme.title: XPO - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface and his company attempt to win the Xander Crews Inventors Expo competition.

programme.title: Kidnapped! - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2006 · TV-MA — Killface, desperate for $12 billion to complete the Annihilatrix, decides to kidnap billionaire tycoon Xander Crews. But things quickly go south for our villain, starting just about the same time that Phil vomits in the minivan, and finishing up when plucky reporter Grace Ryan falls into drums full of super-intelligent, radioactive waste-covered ants.

programme.title: Havana Kill Castro - S03E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — McCool takes the Falcones to Cuba on vacation. Jimmy hates it for being a ‘Communist hell-hole’, but cheers up when he discovers that killing Castro can get him ‘Super-Made' and land him back on top in New York.

programme.title: Universal Prostitution and Pizza Fridays - S03E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy calls Cheech a ‘Bum', doing the worst thing one goodfella can do to another: telling him the truth about himself. Cheech decides to run for Mayor of Regina to prove he's not a bum.

programme.title: Just Stick It in That There Doo-Dad - S03E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — When Cookie finds a photo album of Jimmy’s gumars (girlfriends) from the old life (Cheech’s fault), Jimmy takes her away for a romantic weekend and they wind up at a swinger's convention (again, Cheech’s fault).

programme.title: Confetti Deathblow - S03E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Through a misunderstanding, Cookie starts to think Petey is gay. She does her best to support him, but is shocked when it turns out he's not gay, he's into LARP (Live Action Role Playing).

programme.title: Jimmy Gets Goosed - S03E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy's boss Toby makes him take anger management then invites Jimmy over for dinner to meet his horrible mother. Cheech starts dating Greta, but Jimmy thinks he’s only trying to steal a valuable statue she owns.

programme.title: Casino Loyale - S03E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy convinces Regina Tourism to open a casino. He winds up being a big casino boss, but gets into a rivalry with Cookie when she gets hired to run the native casino. Petey gets accepted into the popular group at school.

programme.title: Vagina's Got Talent - S03E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Cookie enters Theresa in Regina's Got Talent to stick it to a rival mother who's son is a three-time winner. Theresa wants to do her own songs, but Cookie makes her do middle-of-the-road stuff to impress the judges.

programme.title: New York State of Blind Drunk - S03E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy, Cheech, and McCool get hammered one night and awaken in Jimmy's old house in New York. They have to get out of New York but keep running into the mob. Petey finds an old picture of Cookie with a man who looks like him, who he thinks is his real dad.

programme.title: Cookie's Ovary-Actin' - S03E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — When Cookie gets baby fever and wants another kid, Jimmy refuses to sleep with her. Problem is, he “feels the need” but can’t find a place to “empty the tanks”. Theresa, Gina, and Petey house-sit for one of McCool’s colleagues.

programme.title: Royal Canadian Groping Pariah - S03E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — When Jimmy sees a seemingly compromising picture of McCool with Theresa (it’s totally innocent), he ruins McCool’s life and gets him kicked off the force. Petey’s iPhone app is stolen by Richard Wheatthin’s company.

programme.title: What the Fuck is the Grey Cup? - S03E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy and Cheech become big CFL fans and invite the Saskatchewan Rough Riders over for a barbecue. The entire team gets food poisoning on the eve of the Grey Cup. Jimmy forms a team to play the Grey Cup in their place.

programme.title: Sasquatchewan - S03E12
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy and Petey go on a hunting trip and come home with a Sasquatch (Dave Foley). Jimmy learns how hard McCool's job is when he has to babysit the Bigfoot. Meanwhile, Cheech winds up as a seeing eye dog for a blind woman he's attracted to.

programme.title: Nonna You Business - S03E13
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy’s aged great-grandmother from Italy is dying so McCool arranges for her to visit Regina. Jimmy and the family have to fool Nonna (Andrea Martin) into thinking they still in live in New York and are mafia bigshots.

programme.title: Layin' Some Pipeline - S03E14
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy and Cheech help the premiere of Saskatchewan pass a controversial law that brands anti-oil pipeline protestors as terrorists. Problem is, Petey was protesting the pipeline and is now a wanted man. Jimmy has to go on the lam with Petey.

programme.title: Keepin' Up with the McFelchers - S03E15
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy’s new neighbor turns out to be a Quebec biker who’s also in witness protection. Jimmy is banned from associating with him, but then realizes his new pal is about to commit a heist. Jimmy has to stop the robbery… or join in.

programme.title: Hot, Wet, Amphibious Summer - S03E16
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Petey gets a summer job at the tourism bureau and lies about Regina history while running a bus tour. His lies prove so popular that Petey is promoted and becomes Jimmy’s boss. When Jimmy is disobedient at work, Petey fires him.

programme.title: Horse Springs Paternal - S03E17
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Horse gets Jimmy and Cheech’s new racehorse pregnant so they sue McCool. In order to pay the boys back, McCool must track down his deadbeat dad, Staunch McCool. As McCool reconnects with his dad, Jimmy realizes the guy is a con-man who’s taking advantage.

programme.title: An Unmarried Bra Whisperer - S03E18
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — When Cookie discovers that Jimmy was engaged to someone else when he met her, but never mentioned it, she moves out. Now living on her own, Cookie finds a job as a bra-fitting consultant and proves to be a genius at the job.

programme.title: Spicy Apocalypse - S03E19
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — In an effort to raise money to send Petey to an underwater science school, Jimmy sells a formula Cheech invented for spice neutralizer to Wheatthin. When the formula is stolen, the family must investigate the crime and find the culprit.

programme.title: Vengeance Wore a Unitard - S03E20
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Carlo Gambini tracks the Falcones to Regina. He’s there to kill Cheech… or is he there just to see Gina again. Gina’s faced with a choice: side with the only boy she’s ever “like-liked” or save Uncle Cheech from certain death.

programme.title: Hate Crime Legislation is for Pussies - S01E01
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy and Cheech take Petey to a boxing gym but he proves to be hopeless at sparring - until his opponent insults his politically-correct views.

programme.title: The Full Mountie - S01E02
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — After losing a game of Poker to Jimmy, McCool take on a series of humiliating jobs in order to repay the debt. Jimmy and Cheech use the Mountie’s debt to their advantage.

programme.title: Screw You, Mr. Wonderful - S01E03
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy becomes jealous when Petey befriends a wealthy businessman. Gina convinces Theresa to pose as her mother to collect a baby bonus check.

programme.title: The Man With No Ass - S01E04
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — After a failed attempt to smuggle Canadian candy into the States, Jimmy winds up in a rodeo competition against McCool. Petey seeks Theresa’s advice to get girls.

programme.title: Cousin Sammy Dies in the End - S01E05
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy’s cousin Sammy from New York comes to live with them after the mob orders a hit on him, but the family’s witness protection is put in jeopardy.

programme.title: Rainbows and Painted Hos - S01E06
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — After he causes Cookie to miss a concert that could reunite her with her sister, Jimmy is kicked out of the house and forced to live with Special Agent McCool.

programme.title: Chokin' and Tokin' in the Queen City - S01E07
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — After Jimmy has an out-of-body experience where he finds himself denied entry into heaven, he becomes a vigilante to make up for his past bad deeds.

programme.title: Al Capone Wears Ladies Underwear - S01E08
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy and Cheech take Gina to search for Al Capone’s hidden vault. Theresa is rejected by a blind classmate who can’t see how hot she is.

programme.title: Petey Gets God'd - S01E09
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Petey discovers God when Jimmy sets him up with a hooker, but his newfound religious zeal drives everyone nuts and Jimmy is forced to reveal the truth about the girl.

programme.title: The Oracle of Vagina - S01E10
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy helps Cookie open a fortune-telling business as a legitimate scam’, but when one of her predictions miraculously comes true, she believes she has ‘the gift’.

programme.title: The Horny Bastard - S01E11
programme.desc: Animation · 2012 · TV-MA — Jimmy opens Regina’s first strip joint, but is shocked when his daughter starts working there as a stripper.

programme.title: There's No Place Like Springfield (1) - S01E64
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra drugs Shipwreck to make him think he is in his hometown of Springfield, 6 years in the future. Cobra is vanquished forever, G.I.Joe is disbanded, he is married to his lost sweetheart, Mara (who is cured of her aquatic transformatin) and they have a daghter.

programme.title: There's No Place Like Springfield (2) - S01E65
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Shipwreck discovers that he is really in a facsimile of Springfield on the island of Temple Alpha during the present and finds out that it's people are really synthoids.

programme.title: Arise, Serpentor, Arise! (1) - S02E01
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — A surprise attack by Cobra, using the new BATs, reveals that the Joes have gotten sloppy. General Hawk asks Sergeant Slaughter to help whip the team back into shape. Meanwhile, a series of dreams prompt Dr. Mindbender to concoct a plan to build a new Cobra leader from the DNA of long-dead conquerors. A package downed Night Raven reveals that Zartan has been asked to expand his team of Dreadnoks so he turns to his siblings, Zandar and Zarana for help, and the Joes investigate and discover the plan, only to be cornered by Thrasher and his Thunder Machine.

programme.title: Arise, Serpentor, Arise! (2) - S02E02
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The Joes send teams out to guard the tombs on Zartan's list, but each team is defeated in turn: by Zarana in Egypt, the Crimson Twins in Paris, the Dreadnoks in the Yucatan, and the Baroness in Transylvania. Duke's team and the Oktober Guard are in a standoff with BATs while defending the tomb of Ivan the Terrible.

programme.title: Arise, Serpentor, Arise! (3) - S02E03
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra takes DNA from the tombs of Ivan the Terrible and Alexander the Great. Sergeant Slaughter retrieves a DNA pack from Cobra's raid on Sun Tzu's tomb, and from it the Joes surmise that Cobra is building a new breed of soldiers. Dr. Mindbender intends to use Slaughter's DNA as a replacement, and so feigns defeat as a ploy to retrieve the sarcophagus of Genghis Khan and capture Slaughter.

programme.title: Arise, Serpentor, Arise! (4) - S02E04
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra Commander sabotages Dr. Mindbender's first experiment, and it rises as a hideous monster. Sergeant Slaughter briefly escapes, then is recaptured but manages to destroy his DNA sample. The second attempt is successful, and Serpentor is created. Meanwhile, a Joe search party is sent to Cobra Island to rescue Slaughter and learn more about Cobra's plans.

programme.title: Arise, Serpentor, Arise! (5) - S02E05
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Seargent Slaughter and the rescue team escape Cobra Island, but Serpentor captures Washington D.C. just as the Joes learn about the new leader. But Serpentor's lack of experience in modern warfare puts Cobra at a disadvantage when G.I. Joe stages a counterattack.

programme.title: Last Hour to Doomsday - S02E06
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Lady Jaye disguises herself as the Baroness in order to learn about a Cobra weapon created to form whirlpools and tidal waves.

programme.title: Computer Complications - S02E07
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — When the Joes seek to recover a sample of anti-matter from a sunken ship, Zarana is sent to their headquarters to sabotage the operation. She and Mainframe discover they have feelings for each other. In the aftermath of a battle, the USS Flagg is sunk.

programme.title: Sink the Montana - S02E08
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — An aging admiral learns that his ship is to be scrapped, and he turns to Cobra for help. Cobra renders his ship impervious to electronic vessels, so G.I. Joe must use the two-hundred-year-old USS Constitution to defeat him.

programme.title: Let's Play Soldier - S02E09
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra discovers an Asian tree sap that brainwashes people, and uses it to enslave the native population. Leatherneck must care for four orphans while the other Joes try to prevent Cobra from marketing the sap as chewing gum.

programme.title: Once Upon a Joe - S02E10
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — When an orphanage is accidentally damaged during a battle, Shipwreck and other members from G.I. Joe volunteer to help repair it. While doing so, Shipwreck is dragged into telling the children a fairy tale...a typically cockeyed Shipwreck extravaganza!

programme.title: The Million Dollar Medic - S02E11
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Bree Van Mark, a cute wealthy woman, develops a crush on Lifeline after he rescues her and her father from a sinking yacht during a battle between G.I. Joe and Cobra. Lifeline discovers that Cobra is after Bree's father, a wealthy industrialist whose holding include a defense company. But the Joes think that Bree is working for Cobra since some of her gifts, including a gold plated helicopter, have backfires. She flies off in a Tomahawk taking Lifeline with her. They head to a cabin in the Rockies and are followed by Cobra. Lifeline, who is a pacifist, must fend off Cobra until the rest of the Joes arrives.

programme.title: Cobrathon - S02E12
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra stages a telethon to raise money for a computer virus that will bring down all the computer systems in the world, as the Joes try to rescue Sci Fi and Lifeline...

programme.title: The Rotten Egg - S02E13
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Leatherneck attends graduation ceremonies at a new academy and discovers it run by former enemy Buck McCann, who is loyal to Cobra. Leatherneck must foil McCann's plan to destroy Parris Island Marine Academy.

programme.title: Glamour Girls - S02E14
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Madame Vail (voice- Mary McDonald Lewis) agrees to sell her youth transference machine, which makes people young (and beautiful), in return for kidnapping some of the world's top models, who's youth and beauty will be transferred to the machine's user. One of these models is Low Light's sister, Una...

programme.title: Iceberg Goes South - S02E15
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The Joes visit an arctic region where Icebergs Girlfriend is collecting samples of animals tissue for her Uncles research at the Tropadome. Icebergs goes to the Trapadome only to be captured by Doctor Mindbenders new mutant animal army...

programme.title: The Spy Who Rooked Me - S02E16
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — International superspy Matthew Burke volunteers his services in helping the Joes transport nerve gas to a safe facility.

programme.title: Grey Hairs and Growing Pains - S02E17
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra steals Madame Versalles youth treatment. The Joes try to figure out why and that leads them to the Ageless Care Spa, where lady Jaye, Mainframe and Dial Tone are turned into seven year olds...

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper - S02E18
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Sergeant Slaughter accompanies Sci-Fi to a science fiction convention, where Dr. Mindbender recruits a handicapped scientist to repair his latest weapon. Mindbender's false promises to enable the scientist to walk again lead him to walk all over his brother.

programme.title: My Favorite Things - S02E19
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Wet-Suit and Leatherneck have never, ever got along but their heated rivalry must take a backseat when Serpentor begins collecting artifacts from his former lives to gain power, and Leatherneck is poisoned trying to stop him. Wet-Suit has to prove he doesn't have any hard feelings for Leatherneck, as he and Lifeline risk their lives trying to recover an antidote from Serpentor's blood.

programme.title: Raise the Flagg! - S02E20
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The Joes stumble upon an oil platform being used by Cobra to try to salvage the anti-matter pod that went down with the USS Flagg and the Cobra helicarrier. The Joes investigate, followed by Zartan and the Dreadknocks, but both teams are captured by an insane Cobra cook named LaCar...

programme.title: Ninja Holiday - S02E21
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Sergeant Slaughter is captured by Cobra Commander and goes through a series of blood sports with the prize being to assassinate Serpentor...

programme.title: G.I. Joe and the Golden Fleece - S02E22
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — There is a Joe/Cobra battle over the Suez Canal when a spacecraft flies overhead and drops a glowing coil. When Joe and Cobra teams are dispatched to investigate, they are sent back to Ancient Greece...

programme.title: The Most Dangerous Thing in the World - S02E23
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra takes advantage of General Hawk going to a NATO meeting in Europe and infiltrates the Department Of Defense's computers and promotes Lifeline, Dial Tone and Shipwreck (who's not even in the army) all to the rank of Colonel. The three can't cooperate and are not quite officer material which creates utter pandemonium at G.I. Joe Headquarters. Cobra capitalizes on the situation and attacks a research lab near the Joes' base. The Joes are defeated easily and fall back to Joe HQ. Hawk arrives in the nick of time and organizes a counter offensive, pushing Cobra back.

programme.title: Nightmare Assault - S02E24
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — All of the Joes are having nightmare involving a huge snake attacking them. At first they feel that it is due to the stress of the situation. As the nightmares continue, it begins to affect the Joes performance fighting Cobra. In fact, Cobra is controlling the Joes' dreams in an effort to disable them...

programme.title: Second Hand Emotions - S02E25
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — A group of Joes are attending Lifeline's sister's wedding while other Joes are at a nearby weapons depot testing new armor. The Dreadnoks are able to attach small receivers to the back of the Joes' necks and capture Roadblock. Dr. Mindbender uses an organ to send signals to the receivers that controls the Joes emotions...

programme.title: Joe's Night Out - S02E26
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Wet Suit, Leatherneck, Dial Tone and their dates attend the grand opening of a trendy new night club. The club turns out to be on a Cobra rocket and is sent into orbit around earth. Serpentor demands that Dr. Mullaney surrender himself and his nitrogen fuel engine over to Cobra or they will detonate the club. Wet Suit goes outside the club and with Leatherneck's help, disables the bombs. Meanwhile, Dr. Mullaney surrenders to Cobra. The Joes use the Nitrogen engine to bring the Club back to Earth and Dr. Mullaney escapes, when all of the Cobra jets with the new engines crash thanks to the unstable Nitrogen fuel, turning all the Cobra jets into fire bombs.

programme.title: Not a Ghost of a Chance - S02E27
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Lady Jaye and Hawk are on the tv show Twenty Questions (hosted by Hector Remerez(voice- Neil Ross)) debating with Cobra Comm, Serpentor and Dr. Mindbender whether or not Cobra shot down a prototype jet, the Ghost. Meanwhile, both Joe and Cobra forces search for the two pilots who ejected...

programme.title: Sins of Our Fathers - S02E28
programme.desc:
Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra Commander tries to communicate with the creature in the pit at Destro's ancestral home in Scotland and fails. Meanwhile, Dial Tone is discharged from the Joes and is hired to work on a communications project that turns out to be communicating with the creature. Flint is sent to spy on Dial Tone in disguise. Dial Tone gets the machine to work and Cobra Commander tells it to destroy Serpentor...
(Destro's "ancient chant" is reversed speech, revealing a humorous message poking fun at the then-relevant backmasking concern when played in reverse.)

programme.title: In the Presence of Mine Enemies - S02E29
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Slipstream in his Conquest intercepts a Cobra message, which contains an important command code. A squadron of Night Raven are sent after him. He and one of the Night Ravens crash land on an remote island Cobra base. The Stratoviper, a lady named Raven, is injured and not very friendly towards Slipstream. But when BATs land on the island and start firing on both of them, the are forced to team up and enter the abandoned Cobra base, with Doctor Mindbender watching...

programme.title: Into Your Tent I Will Silently Creep - S02E30
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The Joes are highly annoyed by Cross Country's country music are glad when his tape deck is destroyed during a Cobra battle. When his new tape deck is stolen back at HQ, he intends to find out what's going on and sets a trap. He spots a robotic rat stealing the tape deck and he follows it to a Cobra meeting of the Coil, a group against Serpentor lead by Cobra Commander...

programme.title: Operation Dragonfire: Day 1 - S03E01
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — G.I. Joe is acting as the Peace Corps helping a poor village, when they met journalist/cameraman Leonard Michaels aka Scoop who joins the Joes. Cobra attacks a monastery to get the secret to the Dragonfire, a mysterious energy in the earth. Destro dumps the Baroness for Zarana, so Baroness plots with Gnawgahyde to return Cobra Commander to human form to get revenge. Scoop turns out to be a Crimson Guard commander spying on GI Joe...

programme.title: Operation Dragonfire: Day 2 - S03E02
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra has a map showing the locations of Dragonfire around the world, and the Joes and Cobra battle over one of the locations in a mountain. Baroness and Gnawgahyde use the Dragonfire to DNA convert Cobra Commander back into human form. The Joes manage to get inside the mountain base, but are flooded out...

programme.title: Operation Dragonfire: Day 3 - S03E03
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Next location is a jungle temple in South America, and there's three factions: Serpentor, the Joes, and Cobra Commander. Scoop finds out he was tricked into joining Cobra and turns against them. But the Joes discover he's a Cobra. Cobra Commander uses the Dragonfire to turn monkeys in Ape Warriors that attack the Joes...

programme.title: Operation Dragonfire: Day 4 - S03E04
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Scoop returns to Cobra to try to defeat them. Gnawgahyde steals a Conquests and blasts the Joes. Cobra Commander starts fusing animals with vehicles and creates Python Patrol. Serpentor is defeated and fused with Gnogahide's pet iguana. The Joes return to base while Low Light stays behind. Destro dumps Zarana for the Baroness...

programme.title: Operation Dragonfire: Day 5 - S03E05
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The final location is a mesa. Cobra links all of the Dragonfire bases together through their satellite to create an energy weapon and to supercharge their vehicles with the Dragonfire energy. Finally the Joes have their own Dragonfire after Freedom finds a Native American man who knows how to active it. Scoops sends the Joes the frequency to disable Cobra's Dragonfire and causes a chain reaction that destroys all of Cobra's Dragonfire bases.

programme.title: United We Stand - S03E06
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra Commander threatens to unleash a deadly mind numbing gas on the world unless they surrender to Cobra...

programme.title: Revenge of the Pharaohs - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Night Creeper Leader is hit on the head during a battle with the Joes in Egypt and begins to believe he is the reincarnated Pharoah and attempts to take over Egypt...

programme.title: Granny Dearest - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Metal Heads Grandmother comes to visit, who believes he is the leader of Cobra, much to Cobra Commanders disgust...

programme.title: Victory at Volcania (1) - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The Joes are on vacation at Volcania, also known as 'Club Joe', also on the Island of Volcania is General Hawk, who has been reassigned because his superiors believe he is too old. Cobra launches an attack on Volcania and assumes control of the Island, Destro has created new weaponry which Cobra Commander threatens the world with. When they do not meet his demands, Cobra Commander becomes angered and fires on the California River bridge...

programme.title: Victory at Volcania (2) - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The United Nations do not believe Cobra Commander really destroyed the bridge, and send a fleet to Volcania. General Hawk rescues the Joes and they attack the Cobra Command centre hidden within the Volcano, the command centre is destroyed and takes Destros space gun weapon with it. Cobra Commander and his troops pursue the Joes until reinforcements and the UN fleet arrives, allowing the Joes victory once more.

programme.title: The Nozone Conspiracy - S03E11
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra plans to destroy the Ozone layer and have people buy Cobra Commanders deadly new sun tan lotion...

programme.title: Pigskin Commandos - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The Joes play a football match against Cobra, with Sgt.Slaughter as the ball...

programme.title: Cold Shoulder - S03E13
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra and the Joes race to recover a satellite which comes down in the arctic after Cobra attempts to destroy the worlds satellites...

programme.title: Injustice and the Cobra Way - S03E14
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra Commander disguises himself as a new superhero named Serpent Man in an effort to humiliate G.I Joe...

programme.title: General Confusion - S03E15
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — When G.I Joe are told they are exceeding government funding they have to report to The Battle World proving grounds to learn how to fight cost efficently under the supervision of Dr.Carday who is secretly Zarana in disguise. Meanwhile Cobra Commander plans to steal a new weapon named 'The General'...

programme.title: Night of the Creepers - S03E16
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Low Light faces supernatural beings, while Night Creeper Leader plans to regain favour with Cobra Commander...

programme.title: That's Entertainment - S03E17
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra Commander tries to make a break into the world of stand up comedy by impersonating a famous comedian while planning a trap for the Joes...

programme.title: I Found You...Evy - S03E18
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Ambush finds his lost love Evy, only to find she has now joined Cobra...

programme.title: An Officer and a Viperman - S03E19
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Pathfinder, Ambush and Topside infiltrate a Cobra training camp when Cobra suddenly seems to know their every move...

programme.title: D-Day at Alcatraz (1) - S03E20
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Cobra Commander, Destro and Metal Head allow themselves to be imprisoned in Alcatraz so that they can gain access to a highly powerful weapon on the Comstock Lode submarine outside of the prison...

programme.title: D-Day at Alcatraz (2) - S03E21
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — The Cobras escape from Alcatraz and prepare to use their new weapon to take over the world, now GI Joe has to stop their most devious scheme yet...

programme.title: The Mind Mangler - S03E22
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Duke is captured by Gnawgahyde who uses a device called the Mind Mangler to try and break into Dukes brain, but a girl named Megan helps Duke escape, little does he know that Megan is really a disguised Zarana planning to steal GI Joes secrets...

programme.title: BIOK - S03E23
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Destro creates a super computer named BIOK, which infiltrates every computer system in the world, but soon BIOK turns on them and has plans of its own to take over the world...

programme.title: Stuck on You - S03E24
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — After a battle, Cobra Commander and Pathfinder become lost in the Jungle with a enraged Gorilla in pursuit...

programme.title: The Eliminator - S04E01
programme.desc: Action · 1983 · TV-Y7 — Overkill receives an upgrade and becomes The Eliminator, and sets out to destroy the Joes.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — Gabby and Pandy take a travel adventure using a train, plane, cruise ship and hot air balloon — but they can't forget to take pictures for CatRat.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — A glowing lantern leads Gabby and Pandy to a Fairy Fly House! But to meet their new neighbor, they'll need to prove they're helpful, kind and welcoming.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day. But with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create!

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — SunnyCat invites Gabby to a Mermaid Sparkle Party in Mermaid-Lantis! But to attend, she needs to bring MerCat's blue crystal — and her special sparkle.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — The Box Family welcomes its newest member: Benny Box! When Mama Box needs a nap, Gabby and Pandy teach Baby Box how to babysit her new brother.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — Gabby's going on a mermaid cruise! There are a ton of fun activities to do aboard the ship, like making mer-mazing crowns, tails and treats.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — Gabby and Pandy follow clues and solve riddles to find sparkly treasures on an a-meow-zing Dollhouse Treasure Hunt. Can they find all three?

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — When Gabby receives a fishbowl in her Meow Meow Mailbox, CatRat wants to use it as a home for his itty bitty kittyfish. But they keep hiding!

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — When Gabby and Pandy score party passes to DJ Catnip's music festival, they board a groovy bus to watch shows featuring all their favorite Gabby Cats.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — After messing up his hug attack and getting a hole in his Pandy Pack, Pandy realizes he's having a bad day — but things just keep getting worse.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — Gabby receives a Crafty-riffic Adventure Kit in her Dollhouse Delivery, which comes in handy when CatRat spends the day crafting silly bad guys.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — Gabby brings her Silly Kitty Cubes with her to the dollhouse, where all the Gabby Cats play along by making up fun stories based on what they've rolled.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — It's the day of Carlita's A-meow-zing Race! After choosing their racers, Gabby and her friends speed around solving puzzles to win a special surprise.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — CatRat wants to plan a party for Gabby's birthday, but Gabby can't decide on a theme. Will she make up her mind in time for his big surprise?

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — There's a new Gabby Cat in town: Marty the Party Cat! Gabby and Pandy show Marty all the fun features in the party room to make him feel welcome.

programme.desc: Adventure · 2021 · TV-Y — It's CatRat's birthday! Help Gabby and the gang plan a super-secret surprise party for their feline friend and his very special guest, Fluffy Flufferton.

programme.title: American Gangster - S01E01
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — American Gangster is the story of Frank Lucas and Leroy "Nicky" Barnes - their rise from street punks to the top of New York's 1970's high-flying drug market. The two men were considered the drug czars of Harlem at the height of the drug-fueled decade. Lucas and his gang "The Country Boys" claim to have smuggled heroin from Asia in the caskets of fallen American soldiers. Barnes, the leader of a cartel of African-American drug dealers called "The Council," made the cover of New York Times Magazine. The headline read "Mr. Untouchable." President Carter was so incensed, he personally ordered the Attorney General to go after him. The story is a violent, action-filled chronicle of Harlem and its kingpins.

programme.title: You Rat, You Die - S01E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — In 2003, the body of a pregnant, teenaged informant was found along the banks of the bucolic Shenandoah River. She'd been repeatedly stabbed - her head nearly severed. Brenda Paz had been supplying the authorities with first-hand accounts of MS-13's operations. Paz had been one of 3,000 MS-13 members in the Washington, DC area. The increasingly violent and fast-growing gang operates from the sleepy, middle-class suburbs ringing the city.

programme.title: Code Of Conduct - S01E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Five bodies, riddled with bullets, found in a small apartment on the East Side of Los Angeles. Among the dead are a five-year-old boy and an infant girl, each shot in the head and chest. The mother and father of the children lay beside them on the floor, also soaked in blood. The target of the hit was the family's patriarch, Anthony "Dido" Moreno. He had dropped out of one of California's most notorious prison gangs and this was his payback. No witnesses, was the order. The gang he deserted was the Mexican Mafia. Since it's inception in the 1950's the "Black Hand" has been the prison system's most active shot-callers, controlling thousands of "foot soldiers" on the streets of Southern California. Most laws enforcement officials estimate that 300 homicides per year in LA County have some connection to the Mexican Mafia.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines - S01E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — The Hells Angels are the most powerful and well-known biker club on the planet, boasting over 2500 members worldwide. In April 2002, a riot in a Nevada casino between the Hells Angels and their rivals, the Mongols, kills three gang members and creates headlines around the country. Federal authorities seize the opportunity and send a team of undercover agents to infiltrate the outlaw biker group. Along the way, they uncover a world of sex, rampant drug use, and vicious violence - employed to ensure the Hells Angel's place at the top of the biker world.

programme.title: Race Wars - S01E05
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Home to 900 street gangs and over 80,000 gang members, the city of Los Angeles has the dubious title of "Gang Capital of the World." Territory means power and every gang in LA wants to expand their neighborhood boundaries by any means necessary. Since the 1990's, an ugly new development has surfaced in the gang wars of LA: Gangs are dividing by race. In neighborhoods such as Harbor Gateway, Highland Park, and Firestone, Hispanic gang members are targeting black civilians in an attempt to keep their territory free of the rival race.

programme.title: Kings Of New York - S01E06
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — King Lil Man," was found decapitated, dismembered, and burned in a bathtub. His Latin King's tattoo had been cut from his skin, his head and hands were never found. According to former Assistant U.S. Attorney Richard Zabel, his murderers, fellow Latin King gang members, were "...actually driving around town in a cab with his head because "King Blood," their leader, needed proof of the murder." By the mid-1990's, the New York chapter of the Latin Kings had grown into the most violent and largest street gang every seen in the city. Lead by the murderous "King Blood," they left a path of mayhem that was only brought to an end by "Blood's" 18 guilty verdicts - eight of them for murder. His conviction was largely based on the 20,000 plus letters he wrote detailing the crimes the New York Latin Kings were perpetuating.

programme.title: Stone To The Bone - S01E07
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Graffiti reading: "Terror Town," "Cold Stone Soldier" and "Stones Run It" litters Chicago's Southside neighborhoods. It's the work of BPS, Chicago's second largest street gang. The gang has a long and colorful history with their founder - Jeff Fort - convicted in 1987 of plotting to carry out terrorist acts against the US government with the support of Libyan government. The FBI classified the group as a "terrorist threat," in the wake of 9/11.

programme.title: Hate Nation - S01E08
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Called the "shock troops" of the revolution, Skinheads form a particularly brutal element of the white supremacist movement. Violent hate-crimes are their method of intimidation and a preview of the race war they see as inevitable. It's a culture driven by the violent lyrics of racist rock, and fueled by hate.

programme.title: Gangster City - S01E09
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Gangs have been in existence for as long as there have been humans. Daryl Gates, former Los Angeles Chief of Police suggests that there is something about human nature that draws many toward gangs-- the need for respect, security and acceptance. It makes little difference whether the country is totalitarian or democratic, whether the time is feudal or current.

programme.title: Blood In, Blood Out - S01E10
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Nuestra Familia. As the predominant Hispanic gang in Northern California, Nuestra Familia, or NF is primarily a prison gang. Compared to other prison gangs, NF's numbers on the inside are relatively small, yet they distinguish themselves through discipline and fear. They have adopted the battle cry "blood in, blood out," and made their rules official, scribing a 50-page constitution laying out their bylaws. Among them, "an automatic death sentence will be put on family member that turns traitor, coward or deserter. " NF also have tens of thousands of loyal followers on the streets known as Nortenos or Northerners. The main rival of NF has always been the Mexican Mafia, with their followers being the Surenos or Southerners.

programme.title: Basic Training - S01E11
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — "Basic Training" takes an inside look at the infiltration of street gangs into the United States military. Gang members in uniform are participating in serious criminal activity on or near U.S. military installations around the world. Our national security may be at risk as these gang members steal advanced weaponry, learn military tactics, distribute drugs and even commit murder.

programme.title: Blood Oath - S01E12
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — During the late 1990's, the New York Metropolitan area was plagued by the random violence of a new breed of street gang: The United Blood Nation. Created in 1993 by Rikers Island inmate, Omar Portee, the UBN emulated the Bloods street gang on the West Coast, but was more randomly violent. Portee formed the UBN in an effort to unite the African-American prisoners against Hispanic gangs like the Latin Kings. Better known as "OG Mack," Portee led the UBN from behind prison walls, and eventually on the streets of New York. By the mid 1990's, like an epidemic, the Bloods had taken over the tri-state area, which had historically belonged to the Latin Kings. By the year 2000, the Bloods were the most violent gang on the East Coast- and OG-Mack became known as the Godfather of the East Coast Bloods.

programme.title: Root Of All Evil - S01E13
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Gangland takes a look at the Drugs and Prostitution rackets run by MS-13.

programme.title: Maniacal - S02E01
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Chicago's second-largest Latin gang, The Maniac Latin Disciples rule the northwest side of Chicago. Since their beginning in the early 1960's, the MLD's have grown so big, that in 2005, the US Attorney for Illinois, Patrick Fitzgerald, testified before Congress that the Disciples should be considered a "super gang." The gang has had to rely on strong leadership to control the thousands of foot soldiers on the streets. Revenge and betrayal are characteristics of the MLD's and the streets are battlefields for rival Hispanic gangs. Gangland takes you inside the twisted world of the MLD's.

programme.title: Deadly Triangle - S02E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Raymond "Shrimp Boy" Chow is a survivor in the gangland of San Francisco's Chinatown. In 1976, the 16-year-old moved to San Francisco with his family and quickly joined the Hop Sing Boys gang. On September 4, 1977, he was at the Golden Dragon restaurant when 3 Joe Boys gang members killed 5 innocent patrons after storming the popular restaurant looking for revenge against their rivals, the Wah Ching. The attack made international news and forever changed the landscape of Chinatown's underworld. In the ensuing years, and after two stays in California's prisons, Chow's power and influence was on the rise. In 1989, he partnered with Peter Chong, a leader of the Wo Hop To triad, to first consolidate all the gangs in San Francisco's Chinatown and then expand their criminal empire nationally. Although federal and local law enforcement would bring the group down, Chow would eventually end up back on the streets of San Francisco after testifying against his former friend and partner. Raymond Chow says he is now a changed man, but only time will tell if he's given up the life of a gangster.

programme.title: Biker Wars - S02E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Throughout the early 1990's, a war waged behind the scenes between the two largest motorcycle gangs in America - the Outlaws and the Hells Angels. The Outlaws traditionally made the Midwest their stronghold but now the Angels were pushing into their territory and courting another regional club, the Hell's Henchmen, to join them. The Outlaws responded viscously and decisively. By the time the war ended bikers from all three clubs had been murdered and the third largest car bomb in US history had exploded on a crowded Chicago street during rush hour. Federal and local law enforcement began vigorously pursuing the Outlaws culminating in successful prosecutions that exposed the violent world of these notorious 1%er's. Within a decade, two international presidents would be serving life sentences and Outlaws members could be found on both the FBI and ATF's most wanted sites. For a while, it seemed the Outlaws Motorcycle Club would fade from relevance but recent arrests this year - and continuing investigations - show that they are still functioning and once again expanding their influence through blood and violence around the world.

programme.title: Texas Terror - S02E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — The Texas Syndicate. They are the most feared Tejano gang in the Lone Star State, yet few have heard of them. The Syndicate is managed like an elite business, with a reach that extends from behind prison walls to the far corners of Texas. They will break any law to generate revenue but the gang's bread and butter is drug trafficking for the Mexican cartels. Now Gangland unearths how the Texas Syndicate rose to power, and the destruction the left behind to get there.

programme.title: Crip Or Die - S02E05
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — "Crip or Die" exposes one of the most infamous and brutal street gangs- The Crips. The gang started as a rag-tag group of youth on LA's Eastside and quickly grew into a terrorizing force in South Central. Today, the Crips are the largest black gang in LA with over 10,000 members. Gang members give an inside look at the lifestyle called Crippin' where it is survive or die--kill or be killed.

programme.title: Lords Of The Holy City - S02E06
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Many gangs are organized, and some even incorporated, but not many can claim to have had federal funding, like the Vice Lords. This is just one of the many unique chapters in the 50 year history of this Chicago street gang. The Vice Lords are divided into many separate factions throughout the city of Chicago and the Unites States - although two men tried to unite the factions into one nation, one through legitimate means and community activism and another through intimidation, drugs and violence. Both failed - one ended up a legend and one in a wheel chair.

programme.title: Murder By Numbers - S02E07
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Gangland examines one of the largest and most violent gangs in Los Angeles County. It's estimated that 18th Street has more than 20, 000 members in Los Angeles alone with additional sets that extend all across the nation and even overseas.

programme.title: Mongol Nation - S02E08
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Mongols MC was created in 1970 by a group of disaffected, Hispanic Vietnam veterans. Almost 40 years later, the Mongols have gone from being party-hearty outlaws to hell-bent gangsters: many that came directly from some of Southern California's most violent street gangs - creating a conflict of allegiance with the powerful Mexican Mafia.

programme.title: Gangster, Inc. - S02E09
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — Through the 1980's, Chicago's most powerful street gang expanded at an unprecedented rate, with its membership eventually numbering some 30,000. When the city of Chicago wasn't enough territory, the gang spread to other cities throughout the Midwest, like Milwaukee. The GDs quickly gained control of smaller towns using the tried and true methods of fear, intimidation and violence. When the crack-cocaine epidemic hit, the Gangster Disciples were ready to take full advantage. The GD organization operated much like a Fortune 500 company, raking in profits estimated at one hundred-million dollars a year. In 1995, however, everything changed. A federal indictment took down 40 leaders of the Gangster Disciples, including the Chairman of the Board, Larry Hoover. After that, it was every man for himself. Through the eyes of Gangster Disciples we watch the rise and fall of a drug empire as greed and violence wash over an army of Gangsters.

programme.title: One Blood - S02E10
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — "LA Bloods" gives the viewer an inside look at one of the most notorious and volatile black street gangs in the country. Through original interviews with law enforcement, interventionists, victim's family members and active and former gang members, the program examines the life, history and the vicious crimes perpetrated by the Bloods.

programme.title: Sin City - S02E11
programme.desc: Crime · 2007 · TV-14 — "Sin City" gives a firsthand account of the violent rise of street gangs in Las Vegas. Through interviews with the founder of the GQ's - the first bona fide West Coast - style street gang to take hold in Las Vegas - law enforcement, historians, victim's family members, and former gang members; the program examines the life, history, and future of Sin City's gang culture.

programme.title: Gavin & Stacey: A Fond Farewell - S00E18
programme.desc:
Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — An uplifting and touching documentary telling the story of one of Britain’s best loved sitcoms as it comes to an end after 17 years. Charting the journey of a little-known sitcom that started life on BBC Three which, with its blend of relatable characters and infectious catchphrases, and how it grew into a must watch show that captivated the hearts of the nation.
Featuring unprecedented access to creators James Corden and Ruth Jones as well as the cast and crew as they film the final episodes together as they all say goodbye to this much cherished show.

programme.title: The Phone Call - S01E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — After a huge misunderstanding on the phone, Stacey thinks Gavin has finished with her. He drives to Wales to explain and ends up taking her home with him. Having never been further than Bridgend before, Stacey's trip to Essex is an eye-opening experience that ends with the biggest surprise of all.

programme.title: Engagement Party - S01E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — After his initial angry reaction to Stacey's news, Uncle Bryn agrees to drive them all to Essex to meet the Shipmans. Pam has laid on a cracking spread and the party goes with a bang. But then Gavin and Stacey make an announcement that throws all the bonhomie out the window.

programme.title: The Big Secret - S01E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — The Shipmans drive down to Wales for the wedding fayre. After an eventful trip to church to hear the banns being read, Nessa confides in Stacey her big secret.

programme.title: Hen Night for Stacey - S01E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stacey's brother Jason arrives home early, much to Uncle Bryn's horror. Stacey has her hen night and Gavin has two stag nights, the second of which reveals something about Stacey that could jeopardise the whole wedding.

programme.title: The Big Day - S01E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — The wedding day has finally arrived, but will they go through with it? Will Uncle Bryn finally admit to what happened on the fishing trip and will Nessa do what she knows she must?

programme.title: They're Back - S02E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stacey and Gavin return from honeymoon to a big welcome from both families. But Smithy seems none too happy with his best mate and Nessa has a confession to make that throws the whole evening into disarray.

programme.title: On the Run - S02E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Devastated by the news he's to become a father, Smithy goes AWOL. The boys finally track him down, but can he be persuaded to do the right thing? Stacey is shocked to hear of Gwen's new domestic arrangements as the prospect of living in Essex finally hits her.

programme.title: The Scan - S02E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stacey feels dejected because she cannot get a job and Pam tells her she needs to get out more. Smithy needs Gavin's shoulder to cry on because his girlfriend split with him over Nessa's pregnancy and told him she was seeing a younger man anyway. Gavin, Stacey and Smithy head for Barry so that Smithy can go for the scan with Nessa. Smithy lodges with Bryn, who has turned his spare room into a gym and sets about getting Smithy into shape.

programme.title: House Hunting - S02E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stacey is miserable and homesick because she still hasn't got a job, or her own home. She feels she's getting under everyone's feet, especially when Pam interrupts her during her shower. Gavin tries to console her but she says he just doesn't understand. Pam admits to Dawn that having the newlyweds staying in her house is getting a bit much. (Dawn and Pete are still looking for a threesome.) Gavin and Stacey go to view a potential flat and are shown round a tiny, dirty studio by over-enthusiastic estate agent Duncan.

programme.title: Birthday Party - S02E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stacey and Gavin are still in conflict over where they should live…with Gavin refusing to even consider the idea of living in Barry. Smithy admits to Gavin that he had another fling with Nessa and realises he's going to have to face her again at the surprise party Bryn is throwing for Gwen. Bryn is panicking because he wants to keep the surprise barn-dance themed party a surprise…but he's also having trouble getting enough people to attend.

programme.title: Boys' Night Out - S02E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Gavin seeks counselling for his marriage troubles from Smithy, but Smithy’s idea of relationship therapy is to organise a surprise lads night out at a nightclub foam party. While the lads are knee deep in foam, Stacey is with her family at a bingo night.

programme.title: The Baby - S02E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stacey travels to Essex and back into the arms of Gavin. Everything seems perfect until Pam and Mick offer to cover the down payment on a house for Gavin and Stacey. Stacey tells Gavin that it can’t work between them because they both need to live in their own towns. If they were truly meant to be together, this wouldn’t matter, they would even think about it…but that clearly isn’t the case. She gives him her wedding ring back...

programme.title: Christmas Special 2008 - S00E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — As Nessa and the Wests head to Essex to spend Christmas with the Shipmans, Gavin and Stacey have a startling announcement to make.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Christmas - S00E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — A behind the scenes look at the making of the Christmas episode.

programme.title: The Christening - S03E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Gavin starts his new job in Cardiff and Stacey is thrilled to be at home again. Smithy comes to terms with life in Essex without his best mate, whilst Nessa is adjusting to life in Dave's caravan down Sully. The weekend brings with it a big reunion, as everyone meets up for the christening of baby Neil. But how will Smithy react to news from Nessa that it is a double celebration? And what will Gavin's answer be to Stacey's request?

programme.title: Job Interview - S03E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stacey is trying for a new job whilst ensuring Gavin sticks to his recent promise! Dave is not a happy bunny when Nessa tells him she is taking Neil the baby to Essex to see his dad. Meanwhile, over at the Shipman's house, Dawn and Pete have joined Pam and Mick for a beer-and-curry night of huge proportions - at the Billericay house of fun.

programme.title: Cardiff - S03E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Pam and Mick are having second thoughts about the conservatory, whilst Bryn is in his element as he awaits the arrival of his house-guests - all the Essex boys down for a big night out in Cardiff - and having a sleep-over at his place! Smithy gets in a state about seeing Nessa after their most recent embarrassing meeting, and Stacey makes a worrying discovery. But is telling Gavin the right thing to do?

programme.title: Wedding Vows - S03E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Gavin is uncomfortable with Gwen and Bryn knowing the ins and outs of his and Stacey's sex life, and Smithy goes beyond the call of friendship by making a staggering suggestion. Meanwhile, Pete and Dawn prepare to renew their wedding vows and everyone heads to Billericay to help them celebrate. But how will Dave react to the bombshell revelation about the curry night in Essex?

programme.title: The Beach - S03E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — It's Bank Holiday Monday, and the Essex contingent arrives for a sunny day out at the beach - even Doris is wearing her sundress! Gavin's heart-to-heart with his dad gives him something more to think about, and a dark cloud looms on the horizon when Dave arrives to find Nessa and Smithy enjoying all the fun of the fair.

programme.title: Nessa's Wedding - S03E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Nessa and Dave's wedding is fast approaching and the preparations are in full swing. Stacey breaks some life-changing news to Gavin, whilst Bryn and Jason finally put their big secret to bed. Smithy takes care of Neil the baby and wishes Nessa all the best, as she makes her way to the church to marry Dave.

programme.title: The Outtakes - S00E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — Stars and writers Ruth Jones and James Corden look through the best outtakes from all three series and the 2008 Christmas special of the award-winning Gavin and Stacey.

programme.title: Christmas Special 2019 - S00E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2007 · TV-14 — The families get together once again for Christmas. Bryn is cooking dinner, Dawn is in shock, and there are revelations in the pub on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Christmas Punch - S03E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — At Christmastime, George will stop at nothing to convince Max to continue believing in Santa Claus.

programme.title: Why You Crying? - S03E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — George and Angie react with rage after Benny disciplines Max for talking back and acting out at school.

programme.title: The Trouble with Ricky - S03E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George discovers Max's friend, Ricky, has a rough home life, Ernie offers to lend a hand.

programme.title: God Needles George - S03E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — George is reluctant to keep his promise to Max when a miracle seems to save the family dog from being put to sleep.

programme.title: Benny and Randy - S03E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — George interferes with Benny and Randy's relationship, causing Randy to break up with Benny. Benny starts to mope around so George goes to have a talk with Randy. George sees that Randy really does love his mother, so he tricks Benny into admitting she cares about Randy, but is just afraid he'll run off like George's father. Randy proposes and Benny accepts.

programme.title: Weekend at Benny's - S03E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Angie goes away on a business trip, George sends the kids to Benny's house for the weekend, to teach them tough love.

programme.title: Jason Tutors Max - S03E18
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — Max gets an incredibly sexy new tutor and Carmen has dating troubles with Jason, subsequently resulting in the house turning into a teenage angst.

programme.title: Angie Gets Tanked - S03E19
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George and Angie fill in at the dunk tank for a school fundraiser, a student's prank puts Angie in a very embarrassing position. Meanwhile, George becomes fiercely competitive when N.Y. Yankee Kenny Lofton pitches in to raise money for handicapped children.

programme.title: The Art of Boxing - S03E20
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — Vic and George prompt Max to take up at boxing at Laila Ali\'s school to help him relieve stress. But when he gets a black eye, they must face telling Angie the truth.

programme.title: George's House of Cards - S03E21
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Vic loses in poker, he won't pay George and instead opts to just take off $50 from money George owes him.

programme.title: Dance Fever - S03E22
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — After receiving an award for excellence in business management, George humiliates himself dancing at a congratulatory party in front of his entire staff in order to gain approval from his mom. Meanwhile, Carmen tries to protect the baked goods she's prepared for the Great American Bake Sale from Max, but neglects to protect them from George.

programme.title: She Drives Me Crazy - S03E23
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — After Benny proves to be irresponsible while teaching Carmen to drive, George reluctantly takes it upon himself with disastrous results.

programme.title: George Goes to Disneyland - S03E24
programme.desc:
Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Max wins an award at school, Angie says she will take him to Disney World. Finally off for a weekend to go, George attempts to get out of it because of other commitments, but in reality, he just doesn\'t want to go and see all the things he missed as a child. Carmen also finds a new guy in Zack Powers.
NOTE: This episode featured Mickey mouse logos everywhere and the person who found the most won a trip to Disneyland. See below for more.

programme.title: Bachelor Party - S03E25
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — Amy returns and attempts to break up the soon-to-be married Benny and Randy.

programme.title: Wrecking Ball - S03E26
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — Still furious about her break-up with Randy, Benny takes a golf club to the hood of her boss' car. So when the Powers Aviation factory is vandalized, Benny gets the blame for this too - but it's a crime she didn't commit.

programme.title: What George Doesn't Noah (1) - S03E27
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George discovers Carmen's new boyfriend is cheating on her, he does some snooping to find out who the other girl is. But he is surprised to find there isn't another girl........

programme.title: Now George Noah's Ex-Zack-ly What Happened (2) - S03E28
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — George and Angie attempt to convince Carmen to dump Zack when he reveals his interest is only in sleeping with her. Randy attempts to win Benny back with a little help from the Commodores. Max finally reaches his goal and graduates the 5th grade.

programme.title: George Searches For A Needle In A Haight-Stack - S04E01
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — With Carmen still gone, George goes on a hunt for her and eventually finds her in San Francisco with rapper Chingy. He finally gets her to return home, but the problems aren't over yet...

programme.title: Landlord Almighty - S04E02
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Carmen crazily redecorates her room, George snaps. When Carmen claims she should be able to do to her room what she wants, since she is an adult, George concocts a plan to get her to give up that thought. If Carmen wants to be an adult, she will act like one. She'll pay rent, bills and get her own food. But his plan soon backfires when Carmen doesn't relent and even resorts to getting a roommate who is a little over the edge.

programme.title: George of the Rings - S04E03
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — After George forgets he and Angie's anniversary, he goes to drastic measures to make it up to her. He takes her to a jewelry store, but the ring she picks is far out of George's price range and he must find a way to pay for it - or feel Angie's wrath.

programme.title: Home Sweet Homeschool - S04E04
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Carmen's school refuses to let her back in, the recently laid-off Angie agrees to home school her. But the money cut also forces a postponement of George and Angie's wedding.

programme.title: Leave It To Lopez - S04E05
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When a janitor with no life insurance dies at work, Angie finds out that George has been lying and does not have life insurance either. As Angie hounds him, he dozes off to classic TV which leads to a spoof of such classics as The Munsters, The Jetsons and Leave It To Beaver.

programme.title: Sk8r Boyz - S04E06
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Max starts hanging out with a new group of friends, everything looks like it is going up for the socially plagued boy. But the friends prove to be a little bit darker than Max, and it ends up getting him in trouble.

programme.title: The Simple Life - S04E07
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George decides a new job opportunity may be for him, he takes the family to a little town in Colorado on "vacation". But when he gets the job, resistance from Angie as well as springing the news on the kids makes George reconsider his idea. And in a moment of romance, Benny and Vic kiss, to the horror of Ernie.

programme.title: Trouble in Paradise - S04E08
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — A horrible dinner that features a drunk Carmen and dirty secrets about the town, convinces the Lopez's that L.A. is till the place for them.

programme.title: E.I.? E.I. OH (aka Cold Opening) - S04E09
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George mistakenly thinks he is going to be named VP of Powers Brothers, he whips out his "VP Dance", only to find the company has merged with another corporation and jobs such as Benny's and Ernie's need to be cut. Plus, George is appointed a new co-manager, a beautiful and cunning woman who George fears will take his job.

programme.title: A Clear and Presentless Danger - S04E10
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George thinks back to the lousy Christmas presents from his mother, he gets worried since she drew Max for the family's "Secret Santa" presents. So as a backup, George buys Max a great present, only to find after he gives it to him that Benny has finally come through with a great present.

programme.title: Prescription For Trouble - S04E11
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Carmen asks for birth control, George is immediately angry with her reunited boyfriend Jason. But when Jason informs him it was Carmen's idea, George goes on a search to find out the real story, where the birth control seems to be everyone BUT Jason's idea.

programme.title: Friends Don't Let Friends Marry Drunks - S04E12
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — George is nervous to tell Ernie that his new pregnant girlfriend may not have been faithful to him.

programme.title: George to the Third Power - S04E13
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George becomes frustrated with Max's dentist, he lobbies to have the company's dental plan changed.

programme.title: George Gets Assisterance - S04E14
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When George finds out money cuts are forcing Max back into normal classes, he goes to a PTA meeting to voice his opinion, but accidentally spills the beans to his unknowing sister about their family connections.

programme.title: Sabes Quake - S04E15
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — An earthquake unearthes some childhood fears in George that shake the rest of the family.

programme.title: George Takes a Stroll Down Memory Pain - S04E16
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — When Benny demands money for a box of George's old things, he is shocked to learn Benny (unbeknownst to him) helped he and Angie start up a life, but she also owes George money from a source he never knew about.

programme.title: George Buys a Vow - S04E17
programme.desc: Comedy · 2002 · TV-PG — George uses a fake wedding for his boss as a cover to renew his vows with Angie, but with Angie planning the fake wedding, she begins to ask too many details.

programme.title: George's Relatively Bad Idea - S04E21

programme.title: George Gets a Pain in the Ash - S05E01

programme.title: The Mess of Adrian Listenger - S05E18
