programme.title: Where the Wild Things Were - S06E11
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Eve goes on a mission to take on the mysterious force she saw in the mirror and finds herself in unfamiliar territory. When the gang discovers what she has done, Nick finds a way to join her. Meanwhile, an uneasy alliance is established when Capt. Renard is brought in to help and discovers this all may be connected to the person he cares for the most, Diana.

programme.title: Zerstörer Shrugged - S06E12
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — The prophecy that was uncovered comes to pass when a dark force arrives in Portland with its eyes set on Diana. In an effort to protect her, Nick, along with Capt. Renard and Adalind, returns to the scene of his first investigation as a Grimm. Back at the Spice Shop, Monroe, Eve and Rosalee make a discovery that uncovers the origins of the mysterious stick. Meanwhile, Hank and Wu are called to a crime scene that is connected to the gang's greatest threat.

programme.title: The End - S06E13
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — In the series finale, Nick faces off against his greatest foe yet as it seems no weapon can defeat him. At the Spice Shop, Monroe, Rosalee and Eve search for answers and stumble upon a rare potion that may help the fight. Elsewhere, Capt. Renard and Adalind try to keep Diana and baby Kelly safe as the threat has its eyes set on the children.

programme.title: Pilot - S01E01
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — After the mysterious brutal attack of a local college co-ed, Portland homicide Detective Nick Burkhardt discovers he is descended from an elite line of criminal profilers known as "Grimms", charged with keeping balance between humanity and the mythological creatures of the world. As he tries to hide the dangers of his new found calling from his fiancée, Juliette Silverton, and his partner, Hank Griffin, he becomes ever more entrenched in the ancient rivalries and alliances of the Grimm world. With help from his reluctant confidant, Monroe, a reformed Grimm creature himself, Nick must navigate through the forces of a larger-than-life mythology.

programme.title: Bears Will Be Bears - S01E02
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — After a case of breaking and entering has one of the intruders go missing, Nick and Hank talk to a mysterious family whose cultural background blurs the line of right and wrong. Meanwhile, Nick tasks Monroe with the safeguarding Aunt Marie, who was almost killed the night prior by a hexenbiest.

programme.title: Beeware - S01E03
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — The station is abuzz as Nick and Hank are called to a case where an innocent flash mob results in a gruesome homicide. As Nick delves further into the investigation, he learns more about his unique family history, and finds himself at odds when he and Hank are assigned to protect a dark character from his recent past.

programme.title: Lonelyhearts - S01E04
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — After investigating a strange cluster of female deaths and disappearances, Nick sends Monroe undercover to get a whiff of a hypnotic suspect. In the meantime, a stranger shows up looking to avenge the death of his friend at the hands of a Grimm, but he'll have to get past Captain Renard.

programme.title: Danse Macabre - S01E05
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Nick and Hank's investigation of a dead high school teacher leads them to the school's outcast, Roddy. Meanwhile, Nick learns that his presence is beginning to affect the creature world.

programme.title: The Three Bad Wolves - S01E06

While Monroe wrestles with restraining his wild side, it's up to Nick to keep everything from going up in flames.

programme.title: Let Your Hair Down - S01E07

programme.title: Game Ogre - S01E08

programme.title: Of Mouse and Man - S01E09

programme.title: Organ Grinder - S01E10

programme.title: Tarantella - S01E11

programme.title: Last Grimm Standing - S01E12

programme.title: Three Coins in a Fuchsbau - S01E13

Meanwhile, a mysterious old friend of Aunt Marie’s comes to Nick with information about his family and what led to his parent’s death.

programme.title: Plumed Serpent - S01E14
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — While investigating an arson-related homicide with Hank, Nick finds himself in the heated world of Portland fire-dancing where he meets a woman who might just be too hot to handle. With Monroe’s help, Nick will have to find out if he can investigate the case without getting himself or those close to him burned.

programme.title: Island of Dreams - S01E15
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — After the grisly murder of a familiar shop owner, Nick joins forces with Monroe to help solve the murder. Meanwhile, Sgt. Wu unwittingly becomes entangled in Adalind’s dastardly plan.

programme.title: The Thing with Feathers - S01E16
programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Nick pulls out all the stops to plan a romantic getaway for Juliette in an attempt to get their relationship back on track. It’s left to Nick to keep everyone safe. Back in Portland, Hank and Monroe each find themselves on the brink of new romantic relationships.

programme.desc: Crime · 2011 · TV-14 — Nick and Juliette join Hank for dinner, where Nick discovers Hank’s mystery date is none other than Adalind, the same Hexenbiest who tried to kill Aunt Marie. Meanwhile, Captain Renard takes matters into his own hands when a visit from foreign representatives of his royal bloodline threatens his position. Elsewhere, Monroe and Rosalee are called into action when the lives of Hank and Sgt. Wu hang in the balance.

Stapp has promised to lead Jesse to the man who killed his father so he can avenge his death, but the young man is tragically unaware of Stapp's true intentions

programme.title: Mavis McCloud - S03E07
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — On her way to Dodge to marry, Mavis McCloud sends a telegram to the Marshal of Dodge City. Chester and Doc want to know "Is she coming here to marry Matt" or is something else going on?

programme.title: Born to Hang - S03E08
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Joe Digger is nearly killed by two men who tried to lynch him. Now he is giving Matt until midnight the next day to bring them to jail, or he will track them down and kill them both.

programme.title: Romeo - S03E09
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — A powerful landowner threatens to wipe out Dodge when his daughter falls in love with the son of his archenemy. Matt has to find a way to stop it.

programme.title: Never Pester Chester - S03E10
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt sets out with a vengeance to capture two trouble-making Texas cowhands who dragged Chester and left him near death.

programme.title: Fingered - S03E11
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Losing his first wife when she disappeared, Jim Cobbett tries marriage again. All seemed fine until she turned up missing too. Did he have something to do with her absence as some think he did with his first?

programme.title: How to Kill a Woman - S03E12
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt investigates why a gunman is harassing station master Jesse Daggett by killing his passengers in cold blood, when things reach a climax after a female passenger is shot dead.

programme.title: Cows and Cribs - S03E13
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — An impoverished but hardworking woman's plans to adopt an orphan baby are jeopardized when Matt discovers that her improvident husband is involved in cattle rustling.

programme.title: Doc's Reward - S03E14
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Doc kills a man who shoots his horse. The man's brother comes looking for Doc because he thinks Doc killed his brother for reward money.

programme.title: Kitty Lost - S03E15
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Kitty takes a buggy ride with a dandified stranger. When he makes a pass, her spirited rejection of it results in her being left alone on the prairie.

programme.title: Twelfth Night - S03E16
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — A feud begun between two families when they lived in the Ozarks continues with fresh bloodshed, and Matt gets caught in the middle.

programme.title: Joe Phy - S03E17
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt and Chester travel to the small town of Elkader to arrest would-be killer Kerry Post, but find they must first expose a bogus U.S. Marshal in order to lure him into town.

programme.title: Buffalo Man - S03E18
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Doc finds a half-dead man on the side of the road and tells Matt. Matt and Chester ride out to a buffalo hunter's camp but before they get far, the occupants show up not treating them much better than the man the doc found.

programme.title: Kitty Caught - S03E19
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Kitty is taken hostage during a bank robbery and killer Jed Gunther warns everyone not to follow them, or he will use Dillon's gun to kill her.

programme.title: Claustrophobia - S03E20
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt and Chester find a man shot in back in his lonely cabin and the immediate suspects are two men who have been trying to force him to sell his land.

programme.title: Ma Tennis - S03E21
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — A strong-willed, shotgun-wielding matriarch helps her son escape from Matt's custody, but the Marshal is equally determined to see the young man tried and sentenced for killing an unarmed man.

programme.title: Sunday Supplement - S03E22
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — "There's no law west of Dodge." Two writers in from New York want to see if that's true. When a Pawnee Indian uprising seems to be brewing, they may have found their story.

programme.title: Wild West - S03E23
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — On the prairie, Matt meets up with a young boy who tells him that some men tied up and abducted his father the night before.

programme.title: The Cabin - S03E24
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — To escape a potentially lethal blizzard, Matt seeks shelter in a cabin in which two psychopathic bandits have enslaved and repeatedly molested a young woman after murdering her father.

programme.title: Dirt - S03E25
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — The only man who didn't treat Beulah like dirt is marrying another woman, whose brother doesn't want him in the family. When the groom is shot leaving the church, everyone suspects the new brother-in-law.

programme.title: Dooley Surrenders - S03E26
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Addled hide skinner Emmett Dooley believes that he killed a man and demands to be put in jail. Matt is convinced that Dooley was not the culprit and tries to lure the real killer into giving himself away.

programme.title: Joke's on Us - S03E27
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — A horse thief is headed for a rope. At least that's how his friends see it. They find out too late they may have the wrong man. The joke may be on all of them now as someone is killing them one by one.

programme.title: Bottleman - S03E28
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — There's a new Faro dealer at the Long Branch. When the town drunk, the meekest man in town, tries to attack him, the dealer swears he'll kill him if he ever tries that again. But he also swears he "never seen him before in his life."

programme.title: Laughing Gas - S03E29
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — When town bully Cloud Marsh experiences public humiliation during a laughing gas show, he and his surly brothers assault proprietor Earle Stafford and attempt to molest his kind-hearted wife.

programme.title: Texas Cowboys - S03E30
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — A headstrong Texas trail boss is determined to prevent Matt from learning which one of his men was responsible for murdering another by shooting him in the back.

programme.title: Amy's Good Deed - S03E31
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Amy Slater gets to Dodge and tells Matt she came to die. He suggests seeing Doc Adams, she says she's not sick but that Matt could help. When asked how, she says "you're going to kill me." Learning the truth, he decides how to handle it.

programme.title: Hanging Man - S03E32
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Someone keeps hanging people in Dodge and making it look like suicide.

programme.title: Innocent Broad - S03E33
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Lou and Linda met in St. Louis and are engaged to be married. Lou is waiting in Dodge for her but a man he says he never met rides in on the stage too and makes Matt suspicious when Lou says he doesn't know him.

programme.title: The Big Con - S03E34
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Mr Shaneways wants Mr Papp at the bank to loan him $20,000 for a poker bet. Doc gets kidnapped.

programme.title: Widow's Mite - S03E35
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt is strongly suspicious of the character and the intentions of gentleman gambler Leach Fields, especially when he proposes marriage to a recently-widowed woman who may know the location of $10,000 in stolen money.

programme.title: Chester's Hanging - S03E36
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — When Jim Cando is thrown in jail by Matt, for a robbery and murder, he orders his partner to get him out by any means, or he will implicate him in the crime too.

programme.title: Carmen - S03E37
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — When an Army payroll is stolen and two soldiers are murdered, the commanding officer of Fort Dodge threatens to put Dodge City under martial law unless Matt can capture the perpetrators within 48 hours.

programme.title: Overland Express - S03E38
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — After capturing suspected murderer Jim Nation, Matt has to eventually trust the suspect to help out when he and other stagecoach passengers are held at gunpoint by an outlaw.

programme.title: The Gentleman - S03E39
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Suave and enigmatic gambler Marcus France falls in love with Long Branch hostess Boni Damon. France is curiously unwilling to marry Boni, though he is willing to risk death to protect her from the unwanted advances of vicious Tiller Evans.

programme.title: Matt for Murder - S04E01
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt resigns as Marshall after Tom Samples accuses Matt of killing an innocent man;however, Doc and Matt's old freind Wild Bill Hickok come up with a plan that might clear Matt of this erroneous charge of murder.

programme.title: The Patsy - S04E02
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — After a young man is shot in the back, people think it was young Fly Hoyt. Holly Fanshaw was the only person who saw the murder happen and she tells Matt that Fly Hoyt committed the murder The Older Brother (Joe Thorp)vows revenge for the murder of his Brother. After Holly gives this information to Matt, Matt and Chester set off to bring in Fly Hoyt for murder. After Matt talks to Fly Hoyt, Matt thinks that Fly did not commit the murder and attempts to prove Fly's innocence. Fly gets into this deeper when Holly is shot. Hoyt claims someone shot Holly and the person who shot Holly also knocked Hoyt in the head from behind. Kitty thinks Hoyt is the murderer and can not understand why Matt is supportive of Hoyt. Matt's lawman's instincts and experience determine that Hoyt did not commit these murders. Matt's investigation finally brings him back to Joe Thorp again.

programme.title: Gunsmuggler - S04E03
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — When renegade Pawnee Indians attack some local ranchers, Matt and Major Evans think that white gunrunners supplied the Renegades the rifles. Matt, Chester and Indian scout Tobeel, go the scene of the massacre to pick up the trail of the renegades in the hopes that the Indians will lead them to the camp of the gunrunners. One thing that the gunrunners were not counting on was that the riffles that were sold to the renegades were an outdated Henry 44. Matt thinks that once the Indian renegades find out that they have been cheated and have purchased outdated rifles that no longer have the ammunition in supply, the Indians will go after the gunsmugglers. The Indians do take out revenge on one of the Gunsmugglers, but the other man tries to flee. With the information supplied by a cowboy on the prairie, Matt finally arrives in the camp of the remaining gumsmuggler to confront the man.

programme.title: Monopoly - S04E04
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Two murders result when an unscrupulous Eastern businessman named Ivy hires a psychotic killer to help him establish undisputed control of Dodge City's freight shipment business.

programme.title: Letter of the Law - S04E05
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — When Matt is forced to serve an eviction notice on farmer Brandon Teek, Matt tries every way he can to help the farmer. Matt tries to speak with Judge Rambeau in the hope the Judge will stop the eviction process in the proper legal manner. When the Judge refuses to stop the court order eviction of Brandon Teek, Matt refuses to serve the eviction. The Judge hires another man to evict Teek, but the man finds the job of evicting Brandon Teek harder than he ever thought it would be. The man hired to evict Brandon Teek meets resistance from Brandon Teek and a scuffle ensues. Brandon's pregnant wife, Sarah Teek, is injured in the scuffle and loses her child because of the injuries suffered.

programme.title: Thoroughbreds - S04E06
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt and Chester, out of water while riding back to Dodge, come upon a man with two fine horses who is not very trusting. When they meet him later in Dodge, he is much different: friendly and spending money freely.

programme.title: Stage Hold-Up - S04E07
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — A stagecoach on which Matt and Chester are riding is robbed and another passenger is murdered. Matt utilizes a ruse to incriminate the thieves when a "cowboy" appears and offers to show him where one of the thieves may be buried.

programme.title: Lost Rifle - S04E08
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — Matt refuses to arrest his friend Ben Tiple without more evidence, when the man he has been feuding with is found shot in the back.

programme.title: Land Deal - S04E09
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — When a stranger leading some immigrants planning on settling outside of Dodge wants Matt to give him a badge to avert trouble, he gets suspicious and rides out to their camp to see what is really up.

programme.title: Lynching Man - S04E10
programme.desc: Action · 1955 · TV-G — After mild-mannered Hank Blenis is "lynched" by the two men who stole his horse, self-righteous Charlie Drain decides to take the law into his own hands and is led tragically astray by the culprits.

programme.title: Search - S04E09
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Donna faces a professional crossroads; Joanie takes a trip; Joe unveils Comet's new look; Cameron asks a favor from a one-time collaborator.

programme.title: Ten of Swords - S04E10
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — In the series finale, Donna celebrates a milestone with her closest allies; Cameron contemplates saying goodbye as Joe confronts an uncertain future.

programme.title: I/O - S01E01
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Cardiff Electric gets a new employee. He's apparently worked for the likes of IBM. But after he gets the new job, it's clear that he is not exactly what he claims to be.

programme.title: FUD - S01E02
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — After surviving a visit from IBM, Joe's team must overcome internal differences and begin the technical feat of building the new machine.

programme.title: High Plains Hardware - S01E03
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Gordon and Cameron struggle to make Joe's vision a reality; Joe and Bosworth seek the funds to make the new machine.

programme.title: Close to the Metal - S01E04
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — As Cameron nears completion of the BIOS, a crisis threatens the project's future and requires all hands on deck to save the machine.

programme.title: Adventure - S01E05
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Cameron bristles under a new manager as Joe and Gordon attempt to procure a key piece of new technology for the computer.

programme.title: Landfall - S01E06
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — A breakthrough by Cameron places her at odds with Gordon, leaving Joe to make a tough decision. Meanwhile, Hurricane Alicia spurs some personal revelations.

programme.title: Giant - S01E07
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — A visitor from Joe's past threatens his newfound connection with Cameron. Meanwhile, with Donna out of town, the toll of Gordon's work catches up with him.

programme.title: The 214s - S01E08
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Scandal hits Cardiff Electric as the team finalizes preparations for COMDEX. Meanwhile, Bosworth makes a sacrifice for the good of the PC program.

programme.title: Up Helly Aa - S01E09
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Unforeseen opponents and new complications threaten to derail the Cardiff Electric team's work at COMDEX.

programme.title: 1984 - S01E10
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — As Gordon and Joe prepare to ship the Giant, a suspicious defect calls their partnership into question. Cameron takes her future into her own hands.

programme.title: SETI - S02E01
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Cameron and Donna's gaming company, Mutiny, reaches a critical stage; Joe and Gordon are reunited.

programme.title: New Coke - S02E02
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Joe begins a new job after meeting Sara's father. Gordon grapples with his newfound freedom. Donna is jolted by Cameron's surprising hire at Mutiny.

programme.title: The Way In - S02E03
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — The Clarks receive a surprising invitation as Bosworth tries to reconnect with his former life. Meanwhile, a problem from within Mutiny threatens its survival.

programme.title: Play with Friends - S02E04
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Joe and Gordon work together to bring about Joe's vision. There is tension between Cameron and Donna.

programme.title: Extract and Defend - S02E05
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Cameron and Joe clash, leaving Cameron in a tailspin. Gordon attempts to deal with some difficult news.

programme.title: 10Broad36 - S02E06
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Gordon is back in California, hoping to reconnect with his brother. Joe uses the leverage that he has.

programme.title: Working for the Clampdown - S02E07
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Gordon and Donna harbor secrets from one another as Gordon launches a new venture. Meanwhile, at Mutiny, an acquisition puts Cameron's principles to the test.

programme.title: Limbo - S02E08
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Cameron and Tom try to come to terms at Mutiny's user picnic. Meanwhile, Gordon searches for answers, as Joe and Sara say goodbye to Dallas.

programme.title: Kali - S02E09
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Left reeling by the launch of a rival, Mutiny takes measures to ensure its survival. Meanwhile, Gordon pays a price in an attempt to quell his paranoia.

programme.title: Heaven is a Place - S02E10
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — When the Clark family descends into crisis, Gordon helps Joe. Cameron envisions a new future for Mutiny.

programme.title: Valley of the Heart's Delight - S03E01
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Donna and Cameron explore their options to expand beyond chat. Gordon settles in at Mutiny and Joe launches his latest product.

programme.title: One Way or Another - S03E02
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — While Cameron and Donna struggle to find venture capital, Joe hires a key coder, leaving the rest of the team at a loss.

programme.title: Flipping the Switch - S03E03
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Tensions rise at the office, as Gordon and Donna's personal life spills into work. Joe meets with the MacMillan board.

programme.title: Rules of Honorable Play - S03E04
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Donna and Cameron have a hard time coming to a mutual agreement on their acquisition. Gordon discovers the importance of teamwork through laser tag.

programme.title: Yerba Buena - S03E05
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Gordon and Donna decide to treat themselves to a vacation at home instead of camping. Bos and Cameron return to Texas. Ryan and Joe have a revelation.

programme.title: And She Was - S03E06
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Tensions rise over an offer to buy Mutiny. Donna has a weekend alone, while Gordon and Cameron bond over video games. Joe has a standoff with the board.

programme.title: The Threshold - S03E07
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Joe and Ryan deal with the consequences of Joe's decision. Cam and Donna fight about the future and Gordon has a crisis of conscience.

programme.title: You Are Not Safe - S03E08
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Diane, Bos, and Donna hit the road in hopes of building support for Mutiny; everyone else awaits the big day, and Joe approaches Cam for a favor.

programme.title: NIM - S03E09
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Donna tries to bring everyone together at Comdex with her vision of the Internet's future, and Gordon faces a strong-willed Joanie.

programme.title: NeXT - S03E10
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — While Donna's vision inspires a spirited discussion about the next big thing, the end result may not make everyone happy.

programme.title: So It Goes - S04E01
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — As the fourth and final season opens, Gordon enjoys success while Joe works to keep their web project afloat. Cameron extends a business trip while Donna launches a new venture.

programme.title: Signal to Noise - S04E02
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Joe and Cameron talk on the phone; Donna promotes her assistant; Gordon's business buckles under pressure from a larger competitor.

programme.title: Miscellaneous - S04E03
programme.desc: Drama · 2014 · TV-14 — Cameron promotes her game at an industry conference; Donna squares off against old rivals; Gordon struggles to support Joe's newest idea.

programme.title: Visitor from the Grave - S01E11
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Charlie Willoughby tries to rape Penny, an unstable young American living in England, and in defending herself she shoots and kills him. Her boyfriend, Harry, helps Penny cover things up and buries Charlie's body in the woods. Then, however, Penny thinks she hears and sees Charlie, still alive - but a trickster is up to no good and wants something from Penny.

programme.title: The Two Faces of Evil - S01E12
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — The Lewis family, Martin and Janet and their son David, is driving off on holiday. As they go through a severe rainstorm, they almost fail to see a man in the road, missing him by inches. Martin stops and offers the sober-looking stranger a lift. Back on the road again, the stranger suddenly attacks Martin, causing a terrible crash. Janet and David wake up in hospital and find that Martin has also survived, badly scarred and changed... As time goes by, Janet starts to wonder whether the man who is now her husband is Martin at all. Could it be the stranger?

programme.title: The Mark of Satan - S01E13
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Edwyn Rord, a young man working in a hospital morgue, pricks himself with a needle while working on the body of a man who thought he was possessed by the Devil. As a result, the Devil chooses Edwyn as his next disciple - or is it all in Edwyn's mind? In any event, Edwyn becomes obsesses by numerology and kills his mother, and the local Vicar takes a strong line on it all.

programme.title: Witching Time - S01E01
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — The beautiful Lucinda Jessop turns up in David Winter's barn, claiming to be a witch from the 17th Century who has escaped being burnt at the stake by travelling forward in time, and it's not long before he is under her spell - much to the alarm of his wife, Mary.

programme.title: The Thirteenth Reunion - S01E02
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Journalist Ruth Cairns is given the job of writing about a weight loss programme at the Chesterton Clinic, a place with a strange reputation. After checking into the Clinic, Ruth investigates rumours of limbless torsos and body snatching.

programme.title: Rude Awakening - S01E03
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Estate agent Norman Shenley has a dream about murdering his plain, bad-tempered wife, which leaves him free to chase his secretary, Lolly. Later that day, a man approaches Norman wanting to sell an old house called Lower Moat Manor. From that point on, real life and fantasy start to become intertwined...

programme.title: Growing Pains - S01E04
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Ten-year-old William tragically dies by eating food intended for his father's research rabbits. His parents, Terence and Laurie, subsequently adopt another boy, James. But James is a weird, aloof child from the beginning and shocking things happen around him.

programme.title: The House that Bled to Death - S01E05
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Emma and William Peters and their young daughter, Sophie, move into an old house that has been empty for many years. Unknown to them, Number 42, Colman Road, has not been lived-in since an old man murdered his wife there. As severed hands and kukris materialize, echos of the house's grisly history begin to terrorise the new occupants.

programme.title: Charlie Boy - S01E06
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — A young man, Graham, inherits his uncle's collection of native art, including an African black magic doll which he and his girlfriend, Sarah, call 'Charlie Boy'. Ignorant of its power, Graham inadvertently uses 'Charlie Boy' to kill a dangerous driver but also accidentally sets in motion a fatal curse directed at those closest to him.

programme.title: The Silent Scream - S01E07
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — A hard-up young convict, Chuck Spillers, strikes up a friendship with Martin Brueck, an elderly prison visitor who owns a pet shop. When Chuck is released, he is glad to take a job working in the shop where Martin reveals he keeps a number of large cats in cages and is experimenting in controlling animals by electrical force fields and bells. Unfortunately for Chuck, his desperate need for money lures him into danger.

programme.title: Children of the Full Moon - S01E08
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — A friend lends Tom Martin a country cottage for a holiday with his wife, Sarah. On the way there, Tom's car runs out of control and he can't stop it. The car ends up at a house in the woods, where Tom and Sarah meet eight beautiful Hungarian children and their Nanny, Mrs Ardoy. That night, they have an experience which will change their lives.

programme.title: Carpathian Eagle - S01E09
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — A man is murdered by a female hitch-hiker who cuts out his heart with a sharp hook. While noting its similarity to another recent killing, Police Inspector Clifford hears on the radio about a book by local writer Natalie, concerning a 17th Century countess who kept an eagle that tore out her husband's heart after he locked her up, in addition to her many subsequent lovers. Clifford contacts Natalie to find out more and his suspicion soon falls on Mrs Henska, an elderly European who is descended from the count...

programme.title: Guardian of the Abyss - S01E10
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Australian antique dealer Laura Stephens buys an old mirror in a job lot at an auction. While she and fellow dealer Mike Roberts are looking at it, the sinister Simon Andrews makes a high offer for the mirror, but Laura turns him down. On the drive home, Mike Roberts picks up a runaway called Alison, who says she has escaped from the sinister Choronzan Society. During their chat she identifies the mirror as a 'scrying glass', a fact that leads Mike into a world of human sacrifice and devil worship.

programme.title: Visitor from the Grave - S01E11
programme.desc: Drama · 1980 · TV-MA — Charlie Willoughby tries to rape Penny, an unstable young American living in England, and in defending herself she shoots and kills him. Then, however, Penny thinks she hears and sees Charlie, still alive - but a trickster is up to no good and wants something from Penny.

programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Miley and Jackson have to figure out a way to get things back to normal in their school after Mamaw takes over as the cafeteria lady.

programme.title: What I Don't Like About You - S03E13

programme.title: He Could Be the One (1) - S03E18

programme.title: Super(stitious) Girl - S03E20

Miley believes the missing jewelry is a good-luck charm and is desperate to get it back. At home, Jackson opens a large package after Robby forbids him to do so, and he suffers the consequences.

programme.title: I Honestly Love You (No, Not You) - S03E21
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Miley is desperate to keep Lilly and Oliver together after she mistakenly concludes that Oliver is falling in love with her instead.

programme.title: For (Give) a Little Bit - S03E22

programme.title: B-B-B-Bad to the Chrome - S03E23

programme.title: Uptight (Oliver's Alright) - S03E24
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Miley and Lilly think Oliver has a crush on the school nurse, but they inadvertently find out that he is visiting her office because he has diabetes.

programme.title: Judge Me Tender - S03E25

Robbie and Jackson must fight the law, when Jackson keeps receiving tickets for traffic violations that he didn't commit.

programme.title: Can't Get Home to You, Girl - S03E26
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — An apologetic Miley plans to make up for the fiasco that Hannah caused at Lilly's last birthday with a special girl's night out. programme.title: Come Fail Away - S03E27
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Hannah assumes that she will take to voice over work like a duck to water. Jackson is tired of Robbie treating him like a child. Rico outfits the Surf Shack with high tech equipment.

programme.title: He Could Be the One (2) - S03E19
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Miley's scheme to get Jake back into Robbie's good graces works out beautifully and she believes that they are headed for a happy ending. Things change, however, when Miley realizes that Robbie misjudged Jesse's true nature and she now finds herself drawn to the handsome musician.

programme.title: Got to Get Her Out of My House - S03E28

programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Miley offers to share her own room with Lilly after Lilly's Mother gets a job in another state, but being roommates quickly takes a toll on the girls friendship.

programme.title: Miley Says Goodbye? (1) - S03E30
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Miley starts to miss her old life in Tennessee. Oliver gets an offer to go on a concert tour, but his joy is dampened when realizes that he won't be able to see Lilly for six months. Jackson decides that it is time for him to leave home.

programme.title: Miley Says Goodbye? (2) - S03E31
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Jackson makes himself at home in his new bachelor pad, but quickly finds out that the place is a crumbling wreck. Miley mulls over the idea of going back to the simple life in Tennessee. Oliver contemplates giving up the tour to be with Lilly, while Lilly tries to figure out what she will do without Oliver and Miley in her life.

programme.title: Sweet Home, Hannah Montana - S04E01
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Miley is forced to make an unwanted trip down memory lane after Robbie has her room redecorated. Jackson becomes a believer in the golden rule once he lays eyes on his new neighbor.

programme.title: California Screamin' - S04E03

programme.title: De-Do-De-Don't Tell My Secret - S04E04
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — When Siena sees Hannah Montana outside the house, Jackson threatens to tell Siena the secret against Miley's wishes. Meanwhile, Robby uses fishing to get Rico to relax.

programme.title: It's the End of the Jake as We Know It - S04E05
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Oliver comes to visit Lilly and shows her a picture of Jake cheating on Miley. They try to keep this news from Miley, but when Miley says she wants Jake to come visit, they decide to tell Miley the truth.

programme.title: Been Here All Along - S04E06
programme.desc: Children · 2006 · TV-G — Robbie's feelings are hurt when Miley starts spending less time with him.

programme.title: Love That Lets Go - S04E07
